title: Area Vice President, Strategic Sales
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

The Okta Sales Team

Okta has a vision to free anyone to safely use any technology by providing a secure, highly available, enterprise-grade platform that secures billions of Workforce log-ins every year. As an Okta AE, you will drive territory growth through both net new logos and cultivating relationships to develop and grow existing Okta Platform customers. With the support of your Okta ecosystem, your focus will be on consistent results and an unwavering commitment to our customers.

Strategic Sales Team

We have a team of highly experienced sellers who are targeting Okta’s largest customers. This segment represents one of the biggest opportunities for growth at Okta. Each Strategic Account Executive is responsible for maintaining high activity standards; daily prospecting, pipeline growth, prospect qualification, and delivering assigned monthly sales revenue targets.

The Strategic Area Vice President Opportunity

The Area Vice President of Strategic Sales will define market tactics to meet annual business goals. They will establish and lead a cross-functional team of experienced sales leaders and account executives in growing a productive and sustainable sales pipeline across the complex Eastern territory. This person will help transform and integrate all GTM functions, evolving an already world-class field operation, while achieving significant revenue growth annually. In addition to requisite passion, skills, and experience, the successful candidate will have a measurable track record in building and managing large, high-performing sales organizations. This individual will play a key role in driving a significant share of revenue for Okta.

  • Attract, recruit, hire, and mentor the Strategic sales leadership team. Manage a team of Strategic front-line leaders and partner closely with other cross-functional teams (SEs, PS, Channel/Alliances team, Legal, Deal Desk etc.).
  • Build a results driven culture through leading by example, setting expectations, providing coaching and mentorship and holding teams accountable
  • Consistently deliver and overachieve against targets, holding your leadership team accountable for operationally sound delivery and results

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Who are we?

At UpGuard, we are replacing manual security bottlenecks with AI-driven precision. Fresh off a US$75M Series C, we are scaling our infrastructure to process 100 billion risk signals daily. This isn’t just growth; it’s a total reimagining of how the world manages cyber risk.

We build the Cyber Risk Posture Management (CRPM) platform that security teams actually love. By integrating security ratings, threat intel, and agentic AI, we empower organisations to stay ahead of an ever evolving attack surface.

We aren’t just building another tool; we’re defining a category. We provide the autonomy to ship world-class technology and the resources to do it at a global scale.

Why are we hiring for this role?

Due to continued growth, the Customer Success team is expanding and we require a Customer Success Manager to join our high-performing team to onboard and enable our customers. The ideal candidate will be experienced in leading customer interactions, detail-oriented, articulate, and credible with the ability to listen effectively and provide clear advice.

As a Customer Success Manager, you'll report to the Head of Customer Success, EMEA, and analyze the causes of your customer’s greatest pain points and work closely to mitigate them using UpGuard technology. You will solicit constant feedback from both customers and colleagues, helping improve UpGuard over time, and you’ll work with customers around the world, from early contact to successful deployment, gaining constant, and unique, insight into the world's most important industries and institutions.

What will you accomplish?

  • You will onboard and manage UpGuard customers to ensure they understand how best to use UpGuard effectively to meet their goals.

  • You will engage your customers early and frequently, to help them get the most out of UpGuard from day one and continue to drive engagement.

  • You will translate your customers’ requirements by understanding their risk management frameworks to offer a tailored solution on how best they can utilize UpGuard.

  • Advocate for the customer; Provide updates to internal cross-functional partners (Product, Sales, and Marketing) on customer perspectives, risks, strategic insights, issue resolution activities, expansion, and cross-sell opportunities.

Why Housecall Pro?

Help us build solutions that build better lives. At Housecall Pro, we show up to work every day to make a difference for real people: the home service professionals that support America’s 100 million homes. We’re all about the Pro, and dedicate our days to helping them streamline operations, scale their businesses, and—ultimately—save time so they can be with their families and live well.

While our headquarters are based in Denver, Colorado, our team spans the globe, with teammates across Brazil, Poland, the Philippines, Mexico, and beyond. We care deeply about our customers and foster a culture where our company, people and Pros grow and succeed together—no matter where they’re based. title: Chief Technology Officer
description:
At Submittable, we are transforming how organizations create social impact. Our platform empowers thousands of mission-driven organizations, from nonprofits to government entities, to make a difference in their communities and beyond. In 2024, our innovative software helped organizations worldwide run 30,000 programs, welcomed 1.2 million applicants, and facilitated the distribution of more than $10 billion in funding through our products on behalf of our clients.

  • Champion product stability and platform resilience as a top engineering priority

  • Drive cross-border collaboration and communication practices to close gaps between distributed teams

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Partner with Product on roadmap prioritization and technical feasibility
  • Work with Sales and Customer Success to address technical escalations and enterprise requirements
  • Represent engineering in ELT strategic planning, budgeting, and board-level initiatives

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
At SiteMinder we believe the individual contributions of our employees are what drive our success. That’s why we hire and encourage diverse teams that include and respect a variety of voices, identities, backgrounds, experiences and perspectives. Our diverse and inclusive culture enables our employees to bring their unique selves to work and be proud of doing so. It’s in our differences that we will keep revolutionising the way for our customers. We are better together!

What We Do…

We’re people who love technology but know that hoteliers just want things to be simple. So since 2006 we’ve been constantly innovating our world-leading hotel commerce platform to help accommodation owners find and book more guests online - quickly and simply.

We’ve helped everyone from boutique hotels to big chains, enabling travellers to book igloos, cabins, castles, holiday parks, campsites, pubs, resorts, Airbnbs, and everything in between.

And today, we’re the world’s leading open hotel commerce platform, supporting 50,000 hotels in 150+ countries - with over 130 million reservations processed by SiteMinder’s technology every year.

About the Senior Sales Executive role...

Are you ready to take the next step in your SaaS Sales career? Do you want to be part of the technology shaping the future of the travel industry? Join our international, dynamic and outgoing team in Barcelona!

You will become a trusted advisor to hotel owners, building awareness about how our products can benefit their property. You will have the chance to learn about the challenges that accommodation providers face, and offer a solution that will bring value to their day-to-day and bottom line. Joining SiteMinder as the leader in dynamic hotel revenue management, you will be at the forefront of innovation in the sector.

We won't throw you into the deep end - you'll be trained on our products, industry and sales processes. We have a month-long sales training and onboarding program to make sure you are set up for success. You will be supported by a dedicated sales coach and a buddy, as well as your team leader, who will coach and motivate you to achieve your professional goals.

We know that an attractive compensation package is a key motivator in sales. SiteMinder offers you not only this, but also a working environment that represents ambition, collaboration, self-development and customer-centricity. If you identify with our core values (We Hustle, We Come Together, We Grow, We Make Things Simple) and you are a sales hunter at heart, we want to hear from you!

What you'll do...

  • Client acquisition - Create new opportunities and upsell current customers. You will be responsible for the full sales cycle, from outreach to demo and closing.

  • Achieving sales KPIs and targets

At Intuitive, we are united behind our mission: we believe that minimally invasive care is life-enhancing care. Through ingenuity and intelligent technology, we expand the potential of physicians to heal without constraints.

As a pioneer and market leader in robotic-assisted surgery, we strive to foster an inclusive and diverse team, committed to making a difference. title: Customer Support Representative (M-F/Night Shift)
description:
Redefine the future of customer experiences. One conversation at a time.

At Nextiva, we’re reimagining how businesses connect, bringing together customer experience and team collaboration on a single, conversation centric platform. Powered by AI, driven by human innovation.

Our culture is forward thinking, customer obsessed and built on the belief that meaningful connections drive better business outcomes. Whether it’s through our signature Amazing Service®, the technology we create, or the experiences we cultivate, connection is at the core of who we are.

If you’re ready to collaborate with incredible people, make an impact, and help businesses everywhere deliver truly amazing experiences, this is where you belong.

How You’ll Make an Impact

As a Technical Support Representative at Nextiva, you’ll be on the front lines of delivering exceptional customer experiences. You’re not just solving issues, you’re uncovering the “why,” guiding customers to the right solutions, and making their day easier.

As a Technical Support Representative, you will deliver Amazing Service® through high-quality technical support services by processing and resolving requests received across various communication channels; while continuously growing your skills in a fast-paced, learning environment. title: Legal Counsel - Regulatory Compliance, Product and Privacy
description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of globally-distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 80+ countries and very few roles based in offices. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder led, profitable and growing. We are privately held with the intention to list on a public exchange.

We are expanding our in-house legal team, creating an opportunity for an exceptional lawyer as Legal Advisor or Legal Counsel. The successful candidate will be a rigorous and effective practitioner with a track record of academic achievement and social engagement. At Canonical, you will have the opportunity to work on a variety of compliance and privacy matters in the technology and enterprise software realm, as well as cutting-edge questions of technology, law and product development. In this role we are looking for someone with some experience in compliance, privacy and product development, paired with an ability to learn and tackle new challenges and complex questions. You should be able to demonstrate good commercial judgement and provide high-quality legal and compliance advice. If you have a rigorous work ethic, capability to grasp details, and the ambition to identify opportunities for improvement, this role is for you.

Location: This role is home-based in EMEA or the Americas, with an option of working from our London office.

The role entails

  • Drafting and reviewing corporate policies, spearheading process change and deploying controls to meet compliance regulatory requirements globally
  • Helping develop, maintain and scale global privacy programs. This includes conducting PIAs, ROPAs and supporting operational initiatives
  • Working with cross functional with teams to evaluate the impact of privacy and data protection laws and regulations, including AI regulations 
  • Providing legal support to various internal clients across the company, including Canonical’s product teams
  • Working with local counsel in many countries to seek and implement advice

What we are looking for in you

  • An exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • A degree in law, JD or equivalent, and active licence to practise law or current progress towards that
  • Drive and a track record of going above-and-beyond expectations
  • Professional written and spoken English with excellent drafting and presentation skill

title: Channel Partner Sales Executive, UKI

Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

Canonical is growing its channel sales team to capitalize on rapidly growing demand from channel partners, leveraging their expertise and connections to bring open source technology to organizations across a multitude of industries.

The role requires a mix of both farming and hunting capabilities. The successful candidate will be responsible for achieving assigned annual growth quotas.

The successful candidate must be comfortable owning and leading initiatives in an unstructured, startup-like environment. This individual must be able to sell open source, cloud, virtualization, and technical software solutions.

Although the role is focused primarily on reseller and distributor channel partners, the successful candidate must be capable of and comfortable with initial customer discovery calls and presentations as appropriate.

  • Develop and execute channel strategy for distributors and resellers within the assigned territory
  • Increase awareness of Canonical as a lead player in Open Source and Cloud (Private, Hybrid, Multi, and Public models) 
  • Identify and recruit new potential partners in assigned territory
  • Leverage personal network and prospecting skills to engage new partners and build on Canonical’s already-successful relationships
  • Guide partners through onboarding and enablement 
  • Develop mutually beneficial go-to-market plans and commitments with partners
  • Arrange and execute sales and pre sales trainings to these resellers
  • Drive and manage channel pipeline through recurring partner interactions
  • Support partner’s satisfaction and act as trusted advisor and point of contact
  • Maintain a regularity/frequency of contact with priority resellers and distributors.

  • Bachelor's level degree, preferably in a technology field
  • Experience in software or technology sales from the specified market

title: Strategic Account Executive
description:
Bloomreach is building the world’s premier agentic platform for personalization.We’re revolutionizing how businesses connect with their customers, building and deploying AI agents to personalize the entire customer journey.
  • We're taking autonomous search mainstream, making product discovery more intuitive and conversational for customers, and more profitable for businesses.
  • We’re making conversational shopping a reality, connecting every shopper with tailored guidance and product expertise — available on demand, at every touchpoint in their journey.
  • We're designing the future of autonomous marketing, taking the work out of workflows, and reclaiming the creative, strategic, and customer-first work marketers were always meant to do.
And we're building all of that on the intelligence of a single AI engine — Loomi AI — so that personalization isn't only autonomous…it's also consistent.From retail to financial services, hospitality to gaming, businesses use Bloomreach to drive higher growth and lasting loyalty. We power personalization for more than 1,400 global brands, including American Eagle, Sonepar, and Pandora.

As a Strategic Account Executive at Bloomreach, you will lead new-business sales in multi-stakeholder environments and manage end-to-end, complex deal cycles. You’ll own the full sales cycle—from prospecting and qualification through pricing, negotiation, and close—delivering new revenue across the Spanish market.

You’ll collaborate cross-functionally with SDRs, Solutions Consultants, and key internal teams, as well as external partners, to open, advance, and win strategic opportunities. Your work will be pivotal in driving our growth in the region.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute a targeted cross-regional sales strategy to penetrate key prospects (C-level), acquire new logos, and drive revenue growth
  • Act as the CEO of your territory by assembling and leading a cross-functional virtual team to execute go-to-market strategies, including entering new markets or developing green markets when required.
  • Hand over the deals to the Account Management to ensure a seamless customer experience

title: Clinical Operations Lead (Clinical Trial Manager)
description:
Responsible for the clinical operations of a project within a defined regional/global level. Provides oversight of project deliverables, assigned Clinical Research Associate (CRAs) and Investigator sites in accordance with the Monitoring Plan, Protocol, Good Clinical Practice (GCP), ICH guidelines and local regulations. The COL acts as a primary liaison between the CRAs and the clinical project team. Additional responsibilities include project specific training of CRAs, conducting assessment visits with CRAs, implementation of enrollment and recruitment strategies, preparation of the monitoring plan and other structural documentation and the oversight of monitoring visit scheduling, site and monitoring performance metrics, issue escalation and corrective actions. The COL will develop study tools for site and CRA use, review visit reports, review and track protocol deviations, and support other objectives for clinical operations and the clinical project team.

Project Oversight

  • Overall oversight of (a group of) regional CRAs to ensure (site) compliance with study protocol, study plans, ICH-GCP, local regulations and study timelines.
  • Monitoring support visits (Co-monitoring), per project requirements, to aid the site/CRA in the satisfactory performance and compliance with standards mentioned above.
  • May support clinical project team by providing oversight of study deliverables related to other departments (e.g. Data Management, TMF Operations, etc.)
  • Oversee regional startup and feasibility activities.
  • Assist in vendor management activities as required per project.
  • Perform review of visit reports for quality, compliance and appropriate site management.
  • Assure compliance with high quality and timely project deliverables according to the project requirements and the monitoring plan.
  • Proactive management of site and country performance (recruitment, data collection, document collection, TMF review etc.) and inform clinical project team on progress.
  • Contribute to financial project management processes as applicable. May include but may not be limited to input on revenue recognition, site payments, and site pass-through expense review.
  • May be required to manage/oversee investigator sites including CRA responsibilities, on a temporary or permanent basis.

Project Liaison

  • Conduct regular global CRA calls with the monitoring and site management team, as well as individual/country CRA calls
  • Attend meetings with Study Sponsor to provide status updates on country and site progress
  • Provide operational support and guidance to the monitoring team throughout project.
  • Provide project training/mentoring to regional CRAs on study procedures, clinical plans and guidelines, and timelines for the study. Ensures study specific training requirements are completed and documented.

title: Growth Manager - Short-Form Content (Instagram & TikTok)
description:
Wir sind XO, eine Creator-Management-Agentur. Als Growth Manager übernimmst du die Short-Form-Strategie von 2-4 Creators von A bis Z: Scripts, Shot Lists, Feedback an Creator und Editoren, und ständiges Testen bis die Zahlen stimmen. Dein einziges echtes Ziel: Views, die zu echter Reichweite werden.

Aufgaben

Virale Short-Form-Videos analysieren, verstehen warum sie funktioniert haben, und das für unsere Creator adaptieren.

Scripts und Shot Lists schreiben, die deine Creator dann aufnehmen. Ihnen präzises Feedback geben, was gut war, was nicht, was sich ändern muss.

Editoren und Poster steuern. Du besitzt das Ergebnis, sie führen aus.

Jeden Post analysieren: warum hat das eingeschlagen, warum ist das gefloppt, worauf setzen wir diese Woche.

Mutige Ideen schnell testen, wegwerfen was nicht funktioniert, skalieren was funktioniert.

Qualifikation

Das ist kein 9-to-5. Wenn Sonntagabend ein Reel viral geht, bist du dran. Wenn unter der Woche um 22 Uhr ein Account gesperrt wird, kümmerst du dich. Das Wochenende ist normalerweise frei, aber bei Emergencies springst du ein, ohne Diskussion. Wenn dich das abschreckt, ist der Job nichts für dich.

Was wir wollen:

Besessenheit von Short-Form. Du schaust täglich stundenlang freiwillig TikTok und Reels und kannst erklären, warum ein Video funktioniert. Du lernst das nicht erst, du lebst es schon.

Ownership-Mentalität. Du behandelst die Accounts deiner Creator wie dein eigenes Business. Keine Ausreden, kein "der Editor hat nicht geliefert", du machst es möglich.

Analytischer Blick. Du kannst dir 20 Videos anschauen und uns sagen, welches Muster die erfolgreichen verbindet.

Fließend Deutsch und gutes Englisch. Nicht verhandelbar.

Bonus, kein Muss: Erfahrung im Aufbau von IG- oder TikTok-Accounts, Agentur- oder Marketing-Hintergrund. Uns zählt Drive und Gespür mehr als dein Lebenslauf.

Benefits

2.500 EUR Grundgehal

title: Customer Experience Manager
description: Smart Pack is looking for an experienced people leader to take ownership of our Customer Service and Sales Support teams, based at our head office in Kelvin Grove, Palmerston North.     This is a new role, so there’s plenty here to make your own. We’ve got good people and a growing business, but we also know there are areas where clearer accountability, better processes and stronger coordination will make a real difference.     We see this as ideally a full-time role, but we’re open to reduced or flexible hours for the right person. If this sounds like a great fit but full-time hours don’t work for you, we still want to hear from you.     About the role:     Reporting to our Sales Director, you’ll lead our Customer Service and Sales Support teams, look after a defined customer segment, and help shape how we deliver a better customer experience.     This is a hands-on management role, so while you’ll be responsible for leading and developing the team, you’ll also stay close to the day-to-day work, have direct contact with customers and step into enquiries, issues and escalations when needed.     You’ll help set clear expectations, improve the way the team works and make sure customer priorities don’t get lost between departments. You’ll work closely with Sales, Operations and the wider business to improve communication and handovers, so responsibilities are clear and things get followed through.     We’re not looking for someone to come in and simply keep things ticking over. We want someone who will get to know the business, see where things could work better and have the confidence to do something about it. There’s plenty here to build, and we’re genuinely interested in the experience and ideas you’ll bring with you.      Ideally, you’ll bring:      3+ years’ experience leading Customer Service, Sales Support or a similar customer-facing team  Proven experience developing people and improving team performance, processes and service standards  Sound judgement, confidence making decisions and the ability to have direct conversations when needed  A practical approach to problem solving, with a track record of seeing things through  Confidence using technology and data to work efficiently and make improvements, including Microsoft Office, AI tools and business systems      Because this is a new role, there’s plenty of room to have an impact. You’ll be trusted to shape how these teams work, find better ways to understand what our customers need and introduce new ideas and approaches.     Since starting in 2015, Smart Pack has grown significantly and established itself as a leading supplier in the flexible packaging industry. We work with customers across New Zealand, Australia and beyond, with a strong focus on quality, innovation and adding value to the brands we support. We’re a close-knit, energetic team who enjoy finding better ways to do things and making a difference for our customers.     If this sounds like you, we’d love to hear from you.

description: En Ega Consultores estamos seleccionando para importante grupo industrial líder en el diseño, fabricación y desarrollo de proyectos a medida para clientes nacionales e internacionales con sede en A Coruña:       Key Account Manager (entorno industrial)      Buscamos incorporar un/a Key Account Manage r  para una compañía industrial consolidada que desarrolla soluciones y proyectos a medida para clientes de primer nivel.     La posición combina dos vertientes: por un lado,  hacer crecer y consolidar la relación con clientes estratégicos  y, por otro,  identificar nuevas oportunidades de negocio de forma selectiva.   No buscamos un perfil de venta puramente transaccional. La persona que se incorpore trabajará con proyectos industriales complejos, en los que es necesario entender las necesidades del cliente, coordinarse con las áreas técnicas y productivas y acompañar todo el proceso hasta su desarrollo.      ¿Cuál será tu reto? Identificar y desarrollar nuevas oportunidades comerciales.  Participar en la preparación de propuestas y en los procesos de negociación.  Realizar el seguimiento de los proyectos, actuando como nexo entre el cliente y las distintas áreas internas.  Mantener interlocución con perfiles técnicos, compras, operaciones y dirección.  Construir relaciones comerciales sólidas y de largo plazo.       ¿Qué perfil buscamos?   Para esta posición necesitamos una persona que conozca  el entorno industrial y la fabricación de proyectos o soluciones a medida.   Es imprescindible aportar experiencia previa como Key Account Manager, Responsable Comercial o en posiciones similares dentro de compañías industriales.     Valoraremos especialmente:   Conocimiento de procesos relacionados con  fabricación metálica, mecanizado, soldadura, corte y plegado  o  fabricación de soluciones personalizadas.   Experiencia gestionando proyectos comerciales de cierta complejidad, más allá de la venta de producto estándar.  Capacidad para desenvolverse con diferentes interlocutores dentro de las organizaciones cliente: áreas técnicas, compras, operaciones y dirección.  Experiencia en la gestión y desarrollo de grandes cuentas.  Inglés a un nivel mínimo de B2       ¿Qué ofrece el proyecto   La incorporación será a una  compañía sólida, reconocida y en crecimiento , con proyectos de elevada complejidad técnica para clientes y marcas de primer nivel.  Es una posición con recorrido, exposición a proyectos relevantes y trabajo en un entorno dinámico e internacional.  Retribución fija: en torno a 45.000- 50.000 € + variable

title: Customer Success & Retention Manager
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Success & Retention Manager based in Switzerland.   As Customer Success & Retention Manager, you will own the customer experience from the first purchase onward, with direct responsibility for retention, refunds, customer satisfaction, winback, and brand reputation. You will lead three customer-facing functions through their supervisors, focusing on strategy, performance, and scalable team structures rather than day-to-day ticket management. The role combines people leadership, customer lifecycle strategy, data analysis, and operational execution in a fast-growing digital healthcare environment. You will identify the drivers behind churn and refunds, build programs to improve customer loyalty, and measure their impact on lifetime value. You will also oversee the systems, processes, and quality standards that support customer care and retention. This is a high-ownership role for a data-driven leader who can balance commercial performance, customer experience, and healthcare compliance.  Accountabilities    Lead the Support, Retention, and Winback teams through their respective supervisors, setting clear objectives, performance standards, and operating structures.   Build scalable workforce-management processes covering staffing, scheduling, coverage, and headcount planning as the customer base grows.   Own retention and churn performance end to end, monitoring churn rate, retention by cohort and product, save rate, and customer lifetime value.   Analyze why customers leave and develop targeted retention strategies, lifecycle programs, and save plays designed to reduce avoidable churn.   Own refund performance and identify the underlying drivers, distinguishing between healthy cancellations and refunds caused by poor customer fit or experience.   Develop and manage the winback strategy, including offers, communication cadence, product-level performance, and return-on-investment analysis.   Set and improve customer satisfaction and support-quality standards, monitoring CSAT, response times, resolution rates, and communication quality.   Develop loyalty, referral, and lifecycle programs designed to increase customer engagement, retention, and lifetime value.   Manage external brand reputation across review platforms and public feedback channels, ensuring authentic review generation and professional responses to negative feedback.   Own and optimize the customer support and retention technology stack, including Zendesk or comparable platforms, ensuring clean configuration, reliable reporting, and effective workflows.   Establish data-driven reporting that allows leadership to understand customer behavior, identify revenue leakage, and measure the effectiveness of retention and winback initiatives. description: Bras droit du Head of E-commerce sur la réinternalisation complète du CRM (Klaviyo, Wax, Recharge). Audit et refonte des flows Klaviyo  : welcome series, post-achat, panier abandonné, win-back, réactivation abonnés, construits de zéro, pas de template repris.     Conception des templates emails dans Figma  et intégration dans Klaviyo.     Pilotage de la segmentation et des A/B tests  sur l'ensemble des flows.     Gestion du planning éditorial  et reporting hebdomadaire sur ce qui progresse réellement.     Optimisation de la rétention sur Recharge  : relances intelligentes, upgrades de formule, réduction du churn.     Exploitation de la donnée client  pour personnaliser les campagnes, pas pour remplir des slides.     Suivi des KPIs clés  : abonnés actifs Recharge, LTV 12 mois, repeat rate, open rate et CVR des flows.          Télétravail 1 jours / semaine    Tickets restaurants    Compléments alimentaires (100€/mois)    Espace Sauna           + de 3 ans d'expérience sur un poste CRM ou e-commerce, en environnement DTC ou DNVB. Tu as idéalement évolué dans l'univers des compléments alimentaires, de la santé, de la beauté ou du sport, tu connais les codes de ce marché et les contraintes réglementaires qui vont avec.    maîtrises Klaviyo de bout en bout : tu construis des flows de zéro, tu sais lire un rapport de délivrabilité, tu segmentes finement au-delà des critères évidents. Tu es autonome sur Figma, tu conçois tes templates toi-même et tu les intègres proprement.    Tu as déjà géré un outil d'abonnement type Recharge. Tu sais ce qui fait bouger un taux de rétention et tu ne traites pas un client qui suspend comme un client qui résilie.    Tu connais le produit que tu portes. Tu ne pousses pas un email générique, tu construis une offre pertinente pour le bon segment, au bon moment.    Tu penses en hypothèses, tu testes, tu valides par la donnée. Un taux qui stagne te dérange, et tu sais quoi faire pour le bouger.    Tu es à l'aise en petite structure. Tu prends des décisions sans attendre trois validations, et tu reportes ce qui avance vraiment, pas ce qui fait bien sur un slide.    Une bonne connaissance de Shopify et du parcours client est un plus : elle t'aide à envoyer chaque flow vers la bonne page. description: We’re Hiring: Retention Manager | iGaming / Fintech      We’re looking for a  Retention Manager  to join our international fintech team and take ownership of merchant retention, portfolio growth, and long-term client relationships.  If you understand payments, know how to spot churn risks before they become a problem, and can turn existing merchant relationships into sustainable growth, we’d like to hear from you. You’ll have real ownership of your portfolio and a clear goal:  keep valuable merchants active, growing, and engaged with us.       What we offer:     •  100% remote work    •  Competitive salary + performance-based bonuses  tied to clear and measurable results  • A  strong international team  with solid expertise in fintech, payments, and iGaming  • Direct communication and quick decision-making without unnecessary bureaucracy  • Real ownership of your merchant portfolio and the freedom to influence results  • Opportunity to work with international merchants, markets, and payment solutions  • Professional growth in a fast-moving fintech environment  • A role where your impact on retention, revenue, and portfolio growth is visible and recognized

description: About Oper    Oper, a European Fintech company, is a leader in cloud-based digital mortgage software. We provide personalized journeys for borrowers and lenders. Oper's technology streamlines the mortgage application process, eliminates paperwork, and increases transparency.   The fastest growing part of our business is  Herman , our AI agent for mortgage origination. Herman reads documents, checks them, and works a credit file the way an analyst would, inside the regulated workflow of a real bank. It runs on sovereign EU infrastructure, because our clients cannot send mortgage data anywhere else. Phase by phase, it automates more of the origination process: first employed borrowers, then the self-employed, and onward. This is not a chatbot bolted onto old software. It is agentic software doing real work in a regulated environment.   A passionate and engaging team of around 30 stellar Fintech operators works vigorously to transform European mortgages by enhancing efficiency and alleviating borrower anxiety. Backed by Bessemer Venture Partners and Motive Ventures, we have raised EUR 14 million, placing Oper at the forefront of revolutionizing mortgages in Europe. Oper currently has offices in Zürich, Switzerland, and Antwerp, Belgium.   The  AI-Native Implementation Manager  role sits at the centre of how we deliver Herman, and the broader platform around it, inside the bank.    Your Mission    You bring Oper's software into large financial institutions. And you help build the services organisation that delivers it. This is a builder role. You shape how we work, alongside the founding and management team, while running real implementations from day one.   Delivering Herman means understanding both the bank's reality and what the agent can actually do, then closing the gap between them. You do not need to be a delivery veteran. Drive change inside the institution, not just feature delivery.   Feed the roadmap, not just the delivery. Your field experience directly informs our agentic product strategy, and the team learns from it.   Use AI to shape your own work. description: Deine Rolle als Migration Manager – DataPower Ablösung   Als Migration Manager übernimmst du die End-to-End-Verantwortung für die Ablösung einer bestehenden IBM-DataPower-Umgebung. Du planst und steuerst den gesamten Migrationsprozess, koordinierst interne und externe Beteiligte und stellst sicher, dass die betroffenen Schnittstellen und Services kontrolliert auf die neue Plattform überführt werden.  Mit deinem Organisationstalent, deinem technischen Verständnis und deiner klaren Kommunikation sorgst du dafür, dass Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig erkannt, Entscheidungen rechtzeitig getroffen und die Migrationsziele zuverlässig erreicht werden.         Das erwartet dich:    Du verantwortest die Planung und Steuerung der DataPower-Ablösung von der Vorbereitung bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.  Du entwickelst eine realistische Migrationsstrategie und strukturierst die Umsetzung in geeignete Migrationswellen.  Du koordinierst cross-funktionale Teams sowie interne und externe Partner über verschiedene Fach- und Technologiebereiche hinweg.  Du steuerst Prioritäten, Backlogs, Sprints und Delivery-Pläne und sorgst für Transparenz über Fortschritt, Risiken und Abhängigkeiten.  Du bereitest Entscheidungen strukturiert vor und stellst eine klare Kommunikation mit allen relevanten Stakeholdern sicher.  Du begleitest Tests, Cutover und Hypercare und stellst einen kontrollierten Übergang auf die neue Plattform sicher.       Deine Aufgaben:    Erstellung und laufende Pflege des übergreifenden Migrations-, Wave- und Delivery-Plans.  Koordination der Migration betroffener APIs, Schnittstellen und Services auf die neue Integrationsplattform.  Steuerung der beteiligten Projektteams, Fachbereiche, Plattformverantwortlichen und externen Dienstleister.  Aufbau und Pflege des Jira-Backlogs sowie Priorisierung und Planung der anstehenden Arbeitspakete.  Planung und Moderation von Workshops, Abstimmungen, Reviews und Entscheidungsterminen.  Identifikation, Bewertung und aktive Steuerung von Risiken, Problemen und Abhängigkeiten.  Überwachung von Terminen, Ressourcen, Budget und vereinbarten Lieferergebnissen.  Erstellung von Statusberichten, Entscheidungsgrundlagen und Management-Updates.  Planung und Koordination von Testphasen, Cutover-Aktivitäten und Hypercare.  Unterstützung des organisatorischen und technischen Change Managements während der Migration.  Sicherstellung einer vollständigen und nachvollziehbaren Projekt- und Migrationsdokumentation.       Was du mitbringst:    Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Projekt-, Programm- oder Migrationsmanagement in einem anspruchsvollen ICT-Umfeld.  Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Planung und Steuerung komplexer Migrationen oder Technologieablösungen.  Sehr gute Kenntnisse in agilen Vorgehensweisen, insbesondere Scrum, Backlog Management sowie Sprint- und Delivery-Planung.  Erfahrung im Umgang mit Jira oder vergleichbaren Planungs- und Steuerungswerkzeugen.  Fundierte Erfahrung im Stakeholder Management und in der Koordination cross-funkt

Team Supervision: Supervise administrative staff, manage office schedules, and assist HR with onboarding new employees       Tender & Estimation:    Maintaining an updated tenders-Log with estimated submission date (Reasonable & within time frame) along with communication of the same with sales team / client.  Opening and briefing of Packages (RFQs)  Responsibility of BOQ creation and accuracy to the scope. (If In-house)  Price breakdown of each Item to set budgets for each activity. (Creation of project Brief with detailed budgeting for each assigned project)  Selection of material that is suitable and can meet project needs. (Proposal of suitable alternative material & assumption of possible VEs)  Maintain an updated material price list for the raw material in coordination with the procurement team.  Pricing of related Vos, if any.  Issuance of Price Quotations with the agreed general terms & conditions. (Mentioning an approximate / estimated duration of completion)

title: Junior Manager Treasury (m/w/d)

Dann könnte diese neu geschaffene Position genau das Richtige für dich sein. Qui sommes-nous ?

Télécom Paris, école de l’IMT (Institut Mines-Télécom) et membre fondateur de l’Institut Polytechnique de Paris, est une grande école du top 6 des écoles d’ingénieurs généralistes françaises.

La Raison d’Être de Télécom Paris est de former, imaginer et entreprendre pour concevoir des modèles, des technologies et des solutions numériques au service d’une société et d’une économie respectueuses de l’humain et de son environnement.

Nous recherchons une Post-doctorante ou un Post-doctorant en apprentissage statistique et IA générative pour rejoindre le département Image Données Signal (IDS) à Télécom Paris.

Le sujet spécifique de ce post-doc porte sur la calibration des modèles génératifs pour des données. C’est pourtant un pré-requis pour utiliser l’IA générative dans des domaines critiques tels que la santé ou la sécurité. Le post-doctorat explorera ce nouveau sujet à la lumière des outils récents de calibration en commençant pour la génération de données multivariées et étudiera à terme comment l'approche choisie peut être étendue à des données non euclidiennes telles que les graphes.

  • Assurer des missions de recherche dans le domaine de l’Apprentissage statistique

Basés en plein cœur de Paris, nous faisons bouger l’industrie des jeux en ligne.   • Concevoir le template générique et les API associées : cycle de vie d'une session, actions du joueur, résultats

title: Senior DevOps Lead
description:
Location: Berlin, Germany Remote Status: Fully Remote (#LI-Remote)

LivePerson (NASDAQ: LPSN) is a leader in trusted enterprise conversational AI and digital transformation. The world's leading brands use our award-winning Conversational Cloud platform to connect with millions of consumers. We power nearly a billion conversational interactions every month, providing uniquely rich data analytics and safety tools to unlock the power of conversational AI for better business outcomes. Fast Company named LivePerson the #1 Most Innovative AI Company in the world.

Position Overview

The Observability Platform team is building a state-of-the-art observability ecosystem for logging, monitoring, and tracing across cloud and on-premises data centers. We’re looking for an experienced Senior DevOps Lead to lead our Logging and Monitoring initiatives and drive the development of robust, scalable observability solutions within Google Cloud Platform (GCP).

In this role, you’ll help build systems that give software engineers greater visibility into the health, performance, and reliability of their applications and services.   • Lead the design, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of LivePerson’s observability platforms across logs, metrics, traces, alerting, and synthetic monitoring.
  • Own and optimize large-scale observability pipelines processing high volumes of telemetry data daily, leveraging technologies such as Filebeat, Kafka, Logstash, Elastic Cloud, Prometheus, OpenTelemetry, Grafana Labs, Zabbix, Anodot, and related tools.

  • Provide technical leadership and mentorship

description:
Finance bekommt Ihre Handschrift.

Was würden Sie aufbauen, wenn Sie Finance für ein wachsendes Deutschlandgeschäft gestalten könnten?

Als businessnaher Senior Finance Manager entwickeln Sie die Finance-Funktion der deutschen Niederlassung eines internationalen Generikaherstellers. Air freight carries less than 1% of world trade by volume and more than a third of it by value, around $22.7 billion of goods every single day. Crane Worldwide and Yusen Logistics are rolling it out across their global operations.

AI-led engineering is how we build. Engineers write specs and acceptance criteria, agents do much of the implementation, and the engineer owns the architecture, the review and what ships.

title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer
description:
YOUR MISSION

 

A software engineer today uses Claude Code or Cursor. A mechanical engineer designing the next jet engine still searches Excel sheets and asks whoever has been around longest.

 

We are building the AI co-engineer for physical products: one that works natively in 3D and learns from real engineering decisions. We are in production with major European manufacturers, with real revenue and customers who tell us when we are slow.

 

The problems are open ones. Getting an agent to reason usefully about geometry, making 3D search work on real customer part libraries, and figuring out what the interface even looks like when an engineer asks why a bracket failed. There is research to borrow from and very little product to copy.

 

Senior or staff level depending on experience.

 

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

 

You will own large problems end to end, across the stack. We cannot say exactly what that looks like in month three, but here is what the last two years have actually involved.

 

  • A multi-agent orchestration SDK, built from scratch. Nothing off the shelf handled what we needed: long-horizon execution that runs for hours and survives restarts.

title: Founding Legal Engineer
description:
About Grubel

Grubel is a research lab that builds AI for high-stakes knowledge work, starting with law. Legal matters require specialized expertise, and each one involves its own facts, practices, parties, and institutions. General-purpose AI applies the same system to every legal matter, varying only what goes into a limited context window.

To meet the depth and diversity of legal work, we let every matter build its own AI: engineer the right data for the matter, adapt the model and agent to it, and track what improves. We combine the three into a matter-specific improvement loop that runs until the system delivers what the matter demands.

Grubel was founded in 2026 by Moritz Hardt, director at the Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems and formerly a UC Berkeley professor and Google Brain researcher; and Reinhard Heckel, professor of machine learning at the Technical University of Munich, on leave to build Grubel. The founding team includes engineers with PhDs in computer science and experience in foundation-model pretraining at Mistral and legal AI research at Thomson Reuters. The lab has offices in Munich and Tübingen.

Point Nine led an oversubscribed pre-seed funding round with backing from leading AI researchers and founders, including Jeff Dean, Chris Ré, Ion Stoica, and Harvey co-founders Gabe Pereyra and Winston Weinberg.

You are a skilled lawyer ideally with experience on building legal AI software eager to shape the technological future of your field. As a Founding Legal Engineer, you impact how we scope, build, and evaluate AI systems for complex legal work, and how these systems enter legal practice.

As a Senior Prototyping Engineer – Thermal Systems & Cooling Integration, you will become an integral part of our Prototyping team, supporting the development of our Reliant platform – a next-generation long-range eVTOL unmanned aerial system designed for demanding ISR and logistics missions. Reliant combines exceptional endurance, modularity, and operational flexibility to deliver mission-critical capabilities in the most challenging environments.

In this role, you will be responsible for the integration, development, and validation of thermal management and cooling systems for the aircraft. You will develop efficient cooling concepts for hybrid propulsion components, power electronics, avionics, and other heat-generating systems by optimizing airflow, aerodynamic cooling, and thermal integration. Working closely with mechanical, propulsion, and systems engineering teams, you will ensure reliable operation across demanding flight and environmental conditions.


What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Lead the integration and development of thermal management and cooling systems for UAVs.

  • Design, build, and commission prototype cooling test rigs and instrumentation for system validation.

  • Plan and execute thermal, environmental, endurance, and performance test campaigns.

  • Analyze thermal performance, airflow distribution, and system efficiency, implementing improvements based on test results.

title: Firmware Engineer
description:
termios builds smart thermostats for real estate. Our product — termios Pro — replaces standard radiator thermostats in existing buildings, performs hydraulic balancing via a self-learning algorithm, and cuts heating energy consumption by up to 30%. No battery, no retrofitting: the device harvests energy from the temperature differential between radiator and room air (thermo-harvesting) and communicates over LoRaWAN.

The system runs at scale across multi-unit residential portfolios. Each thermostat is a constrained embedded device operating autonomously, syncing state through a LoRaWAN gateway to a cloud backend that runs the optimization logic. We're 35 people, growing, and the firmware team is small — your work ships directly to devices in real apartments.

Tasks

The firmware running on our smart thermostats — from first commit to field rollout. You write code, solder, measure, debug. No handoffs to someone else when it gets hard.

  • Thermostat firmware development and optimization
  • LoRaWAN communication stack (implementation + maintenance)
  • Low-power / energy harvesting optimization
  • OTA update mechanisms
  • Automated Hardware-in-the-loop test infrastructure (build, operate, extend)
  • Release process, Definition of Done, RED/CRA compliance
  • Field monitoring dashboards and post-rollout quality

Requirements

Must-haves:

  • 5+ years embedded/firmware development in C / C embedded
  • ARM Cortex-M architecture (bare-metal and/or RTOS)
  • Experience in Low-power design and energy efficiency
  • Knowledge of common communication protocols such as UART, I2C, SPI and hardware debugging: JTAG/SWD, logic analyzer, oscilloscope
  • Python for test automation and data analysis
  • Embedded security fundamentals
  • Degree in related engineering field

Nice-to-have:

  • LoRaWAN ha

Wir suchen die Person, die LAMOUR mit uns groß macht.

Wir sind in Frankreich aufgewachsen, wo Crêpes einfach zum Alltag gehören, von den Crêperien der Bretagne bis zu den Straßenecken von Paris war das immer ein Stück Zuhause. Im September 2024 haben wir dieses Zuhause nach Berlin geholt und LAMOUR am Helmholtzplatz eröffnet. Ohne einen einzigen Tag Gastro-Erfahrung. Einfach gemacht.

title: Trade Relationship Manager
description: About Tapi   Tapi is a high-growth SaaS company revolutionising property maintenance with innovative software solutions. With a strong presence in New Zealand and Australia, we help property managers streamline their operations through seamless automation and smart integrations.  Tradies get a rough deal out of property maintenance. They chase the quote. They chase access. Then they chase the money - and do the invoicing at the kitchen table after dinner.  Tapi helps trade businesses run maintenance work without the admin grind. We’re building software that makes it simpler to quote, schedule, communicate, invoice and get paid — and we’re on a mission to improve the property maintenance experience for everyone.  The job  You own Tapi’s trade network in New Zealand — who’s on it, how well they use it, and how fast it grows.  We build market by market: bring great trade businesses onto Tapi across every category in a city, help them see real value quickly, get the network humming, then go again somewhere new. You’ll be on the ground in each one.    Sign the growing ones. Our sweet spot is the trade business with a few vans, where the owner’s still quoting at nine at night and wondering whether it’s time to hire someone for the office. Tapi is the alternative to that hire.  Win the big ones. You’ll open doors, earn the meeting and show larger operators why Tapi is worth changing how they work for.  Get them using Tapi. A signature is only the start. You’ll make sure new trades get set up, get value early, and keep using Tapi when the novelty wears off. You’re their person: the number they call when something’s not right.  Write the playbook, so every market is quicker than the last.    You’ll be measured on market coverage — the share of trade categories with enough active trades using Tapi — plus how many of your trades are still active at 90 days, how fast they say yes, and the quality of the network you build.  What you’ll bring  You’ve sold to tradies, and you were good at it. Hardware, building supplies, repping a brand, telco, fuel cards, equipment hire, software — the industry matters less than the buyer. You’ve sat across from an owner-operator and got a yes. And you found them yourself. Nobody handed you a list.  Straight up: this isn’t a job about knowing everyone. Beers or coffees help. Being liked helps. Neither is the job. The job is getting the right trades onto Tapi and helping them make it part of how they work.  You’ll run your own pipeline without being asked twice, hold a straight conversation about money without folding when someone pushes, and still be going hard in month nine when the easy yeses are gone. Been on the tools yourself? Useful. Not required, and no substitute for closing.  We hustle with class and we back ourselves. Persistent, never a pest — a tradie who says no today should still take your call next month.  How we work  We have five values. title: Teamleder til Fælles Kundecenter i Kolding
location: Kolding, Region of Southern Denmark, Denmark
description: E r du en struktureret og tillidsskabende teamleder med stærke administrative kompetencer? Motiveres du af at stå i spændingsfeltet mellem kunder, kontrakter og interne samarbejder – og vil du være med til at sætte retningen for et centralt kundecenter?   Bravida søger en Teamleder til vores Fælles Kundecenter med base i Kolding. Kundecentret spiller en central rolle i Bravidas daglige drift af vores strategiske kunder og fungerer som et vigtigt bindeled mellem kunder, drift og andre dele af vores organisation.  Stillingen er en nøglefunktion med ansvar for at sætte retning for afdelingen og sikre høj kvalitet i håndteringen af kontrakter, fakturering og kundeprocesser. Du bliver en central drivkraft i udviklingen af kundecentret og får en hverdag med både ledelse, koordinering og tæt samarbejde på tværs af vores drift-organisation.  I rollen får du ansvar for at skabe struktur, sikre fremdrift og opbygge stærke relationer – både internt i Bravida og eksternt med kunder.   Dine arbejdsopgaver vil inkludere   Du får en central rolle i den daglige drift, hvor du sikrer struktur og kvalitet i kundecentrets processer:    Daglig ledelse og udvikling af teamet  Ansvar for kontraktoprettelse, kontraktstyring og fakturering  Sikring af strukturerede arbejdsgange og høj kvalitet i administrative processer  Omsætning af strategi til konkrete initiativer i afdelingen  Tæt dialog med kunder og interne samarbejdspartnere  Sikring af sammenhæng mellem kundernes behov og Bravidas leverancer     Hvem er du?   Vi leder efter dig, der er en tydelig og tillidsskabende leder med et stærkt overblik og evne til at skabe struktur i komplekse sammenhænge. Du trives i en rolle med mange interessenter og arbejder naturligt med koordinering og samarbejde.  Vi forestiller os, at du har:    En administrativ uddannelse eller tilsvarende erfaring  Erfaring med ledelse eller koordinering af teams  En stærk systemforståelse og struktureret tilgang til arbejdet  Erfaring med kontrakter, fakturering og administrative processer  Evne til at kommunikere professionelt og opbygge stærke relationer  En tillidsskabende og samarbejdsorienteret tilgang     Hos os får du   Hos Bravida bliver du en del af Nordens førende leverandør af tekniske installations- og serviceydelser. I Fælles Kundecenter arbejder vi tæt sammen om at understøtte forretningen og sikre en professionelle og værdiskabende leverancer.  Du bliver en del af en organisation, hvor samarbejde på tværs er en styrke, og hvor vi arbejder som ét Bravida. Du får et stærkt fagligt netværk, gode udviklingsmuligheder og en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel og et godt arbejdsmiljø.  Vi har en kultur præget af engagement, ansvarlighed og enkelhed – og hvor der er plads til både faglig og personlig udvikling.   Lyder det som noget for dig?   Så send din ansøgning og CV allerede i dag – vi holder samtaler løbende.  Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Palle Andersen på Palle.H.Andersen@bravida.dk.

title: Souschef til Q8 Farum, 37 timer
location: Farum, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
description: Ansøg senest: 10. oktober 2026    On-site      Jobbeskrivelse    Vil du være med til at udvikle andre    ,   samtidig med at du selv vokser med ledelsesopgaven? Så står vi klar med en lederstilling, hvor du får reel indflydelse på at forme hverdagen og skabe rammerne for succes på din servicestation. Det kan være dit livs måske vigtigste job. Seriøst.   ”Du får både muligheden for at udvikle servicestationen, nye og erfarne kolleger – og ikke mindst dig selv. Her sker altid noget nyt, og der kan godt være fart på. Det holder hverdagen spændende”  – souschef, Kim. Vi arbejder aktivt for at reducere vores klimapåvirkning og er i gang med at omstille vores forretning til fremtidens mobilitet.  Du og din nye servicestation bliver altså en del af noget større, og det kommer du til at mærke i hverdagen. For du får et tæt samarbejde med forretningschefen og kollegerne på hovedkontoret. Så selvom ansvaret er stort, kommer du aldrig til at stå alene.  Som souschef hos os får du en grundløn, og derudover får du en bonusordning, pension, sundhedsforsikring, gode fordele, rabatter samt 5 feriefridage pr. år.   En hverdag med kundeservice, ledelse og praktisk drift   Du er med til at sætte retningen og sikre, at alt spiller – både på gulvet og i baglokalet. Og din tilgang får stor betydning for både kundeoplevelsen og teamets trivsel, da du er rollemodel for den gode kultur. Du arbejder 37 timer om ugen og ligesom resten af holdet, kan du få vagter alle ugens dage. Stillingen er månedslønnet og din løn vil fastsættes efter kvalifikationer og aftales individuelt.  Du kommer bl.a. til at:    tage ansvar for driften, fx ved at udarbejde vagtplaner, bestille varer og følge op på salgsmål  være synlig på gulvet, hvor du guider teamet, motiverer dine kolleger og sikrer, at kunderne får en god oplevelse  være med til at rekruttere nye kolleger og stå for onboarding og oplæring  tage ansvar for implementering af nye kampagner, koncepter og produkter  løse dagligdagens praktiske opgaver og sørge for, at alt fra ovne og pølsegrills til sikkerhedsprocedurer spiller.      ”Der sker mange uforudsete ting på stationen, så der kan være et højt tempo, men jeg elsker de mange forskellige udfordringer, jeg møder hver dag. Det kræver en vis modenhed, men du skal ikke bare bange for at springe ud i det.”  – Souschef, Mathilde  Dine kvalifikationer   Du kan booste både salgstal og trivsel   Vi forventer ikke, at du har ledelseserfaring. Det vigtigste er, at du har lyst til at være med til at skabe gode kundeoplevelser, og at du har blik for, hvordan en servicestation fungerer bedst – både som arbejdsplads og forretning. description: The Company  PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade. title: Utvecklingsledare med fokus på invånarupplevelsen
description: Jönköpings kommun är en stor arbetsgivare med hundratals olika yrkesroller. Vi växer i takt med att kommunen utvecklas med fler invånare, fler bostäder och större utbud. Vi är alltid på jakt efter ny kompetens - medarbetare med olika bakgrunder och erfarenheter, med den gemensamma drivkraften att vilja skapa en bättre kommun att besöka, leva, verka och bo i.  Vill du vara med och utveckla hur Jönköpings kommun möter och ger service till våra invånare? Nu söker vi en utvecklingsledare till kommunikationsavdelningen med uppdrag att utveckla kommunens service utifrån invånarens perspektiv.  I rollen utgår du från hela invånarresan och identifierar var kommunens service kan bli enklare och mer sammanhållen. Du driver och samordnar utvecklingsarbete tillsammans med berörda verksamheter och kompetenser. En viktig del av uppdraget är att driva utvecklingen av kommunens digitala service och e-tjänster utifrån invånarens behov och upplevelse.   Ditt nya jobb   Med hjälp av statistik och insikter från kommunens olika kontaktytor med invånare identifierar du återkommande frågor, mönster och hinder som visar var servicen kan förbättras. Tillsammans med berörda verksamheter omsätter du insikterna till konkreta initiativ.  Beroende på uppdrag kan du initiera och driva förändringsarbete, projektsamordna olika initiativ och samla de personer och kompetenser som behöver bidra. Du ser till helheten och hur olika kontaktvägar, tjänster och information hänger ihop och tillsammans påverkar invånarens upplevelse av kommunens service.   Din kompetens   Vi söker dig som har högskoleutbildning inom exempelvis Customer Experience, UX, informatik eller digital verksamhetsutveckling, alternativt annan utbildning som vi bedömer som relevant. Flera års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet kan ersätta utbildningskravet.  Du har erfarenhet av att driva utvecklingsarbete utifrån ett kund- eller användarperspektiv och av att leda eller samordna projekt. Du är van vid att identifiera behov, se samband och omsätta analys och idéer till konkret förändring.  Du har god förståelse för kund- och användarresor och för hur digitala lösningar och information behöver fungera tillsammans för att skapa en bra upplevelse för användaren. Du är analytisk, har lätt för att sätta dig in i nya digitala tjänster och använder statistik och andra underlag som grund för utveckling.  Som person är du initiativtagande och relationsskapande. Du har förmåga att skapa struktur och driva arbetet framåt när flera verksamheter och kompetenser behöver bidra.  Erfarenhet av e-tjänsteplattformar och teknisk förståelse för exempelvis kodning och integrationer är meriterande. Garantiamo un supporto d'eccellenza a 360 gradi: siamo infatti un punto di riferimento nella manutenzione di base e di linea, nonché un Centro di Addestramento certificato Airbus Helicopters e Safran H.E . Grazie alla nostra struttura CAMO, assicuriamo ai clienti i più elevati standard di navigabilità dei loro mezzi e, attraverso la nostra qualificata Design Organization, ci occupiamo della loro completa personalizzazione .  La persona ricercata entrerà a far parte di un team dinamico, focalizzato nel servire i clienti della nostra nostro mercato di riferimento e nel garantirne la totale soddisfazione e fidelizzazione.  Il CSM è il punto di riferimento principale del cliente per quanto riguarda il supporto e i servizi: sarai responsabile della sua soddisfazione e guiderai il miglioramento continuo per garantire le massime prestazioni dei servizi e aumentare la disponibilità della flotta nella sua interezza.   Di cosa ti occuperai:     Ascoltare e confrontarti costantemente con i clienti del tuo portafoglio tramite incontri e visite regolari, per recepirne le priorità (disponibilità, consegna dei ricambi, durata della manutenzione) e raccogliere feedback sulle prestazioni operative.  Coordinare gli esperti e le diverse discipline di supporto interne per fornire soluzioni rapide e adeguate alle esigenze dei clienti, in particolare nella gestione di casi prioritari o eccezionali (con escalation se necessario per assicurare la risoluzione).  Sviluppare una strategia cliente in linea con le aspettative, contribuendo alla definizione della Customer Satisfaction Roadmap e tracciando costantemente le attività, i report e le interazioni nel CRM Salesforce.  Fornire al cliente informazioni cruciali sui servizi, comunicando iniziative di miglioramento, modifiche al catalogo, "hot topics" e guidandolo nella comprensione dei nostri prodotti e della nostra organizzazione.  Impostare e monitorare eventuali piani d'azione operativi per gestire dubbi o reclami, valutando il divario tra le prestazioni osservate e la percezione del cliente al fine di identificare aree di miglioramento dei processi nel rispetto dei vincoli finanziari.  Analizzare i livelli di attività legati alle operazioni del cliente (come ore di volo, consumo ricambi e trend futuri) coordinandoti con gli specialisti per fornire analisi approfondite.     Come convincerci:     Laurea in International Business, Ingegneria o un percorso di studi affine.  Esperienza professionale superiore a 10 anni nel supporto alle operazioni elicotteristiche in qualità di Sales Manager o Support Manager. L'esperienza maturata in contesti internazionali sarà considerata un forte plus. title: Retention & CRM Manager - Expert Klaviyo
description: Nous sommes une PME e-commerce en pleine croissance, portée par une dynamique commerciale solide et une ambition d'expansion européenne. Notre environnement est concret, agile, et nos décisions vont vite. Nous cherchons aujourd'hui la personne qui va faire du CRM un véritable levier de chiffre d'affaires, pas simplement gérer une newsletter, mais penser, construire et piloter toute la relation client, de l'acquisition à la fidélisation.      Vos Missions :    - Concevoir et déployer l'ensemble des flows Klaviyo : welcome, abandon panier, abandon devis, post-achat, cross-sell, win-back, nurturing prospects, etc.  - Transformer les visiteurs anonymes en contacts qualifiés via pop-ups, formulaires, lead magnets, configurateurs et autres dispositifs de capture  - Piloter le funnel complet : Visiteur → Lead → Lead qualifié → Devis → Commande → Réachat  - Construire et animer le calendrier éditorial des campagnes et newsletters, avec une segmentation fine par comportement  - Maîtriser la donnée Shopify remontée dans Klaviyo : segmentation RFM, LTV, cohortes, comportement produit  - Concevoir une architecture CRM scalable, duplicable sur plusieurs marchés européens      Profil Recherché :    - Expérience confirmée en CRM e-commerce, idéalement côté annonceur ou en agence avec envie de changer de camp  - Maîtrise avancée de Klaviyo et bonne connaissance de Shopify  - Capacité à rédiger des emails, construire des campagnes et briefer des créations simples  - Sensibilité data réelle : vous pilotez par les résultats, pas par les taux d'ouverture  - Appétence pour les sujets d'internationalisation et de structuration CRM à grande échelle      Avantages :   - Rémunération attractive et opportunité d'évolution  - Poste à fort impact dans une structure qui grandit vite  - Autonomie réelle sur un périmètre stratégique  - Projet européen ambitieux à construire dès le départ

title: CRM Manager
description: Description de l'entreprise   Nous accompagnons une EdTech, présente à l'international, qui développe une plateforme d'abonnement numérique dédiée aux contenus éducatifs et culturels.     Dans le cadre de l'accélération de sa stratégie de croissance B2C, elle recherche un(e) CRM Manager afin de piloter sa stratégie CRM et Lifecycle.   Vous rejoignez une équipe Growth en pleine structuration, avec un rôle clé dans les enjeux d'engagement, de rétention et de fidélisation des utilisateurs, au sein d'un environnement international et fortement orienté data.      Description du poste   En tant que CRM Manager, vous pilotez la stratégie CRM et Lifecycle afin d'améliorer durablement l'engagement, la fidélisation et la valeur des utilisateurs.  En lien direct avec le Head of Growth, vous intervenez sur l'ensemble de la chaîne CRM : stratégie, segmentation, marketing automation, campagnes multicanales, analyse de la performance et optimisation continue.     1.Définition de la stratégie CRM & Lifecycle   Définir la stratégie CRM et la segmentation des utilisateurs selon leurs comportements, leurs usages et leur cycle de vie.  Construire les parcours CRM adaptés aux différents segments afin d'améliorer l'engagement et la rétention.  Identifier les données nécessaires pour enrichir la connaissance utilisateur et personnaliser les interactions.  Participer activement à la structuration de la stratégie Lifecycle de l'entreprise.      2.Marketing Automation & campagnes multicanales   Concevoir et déployer les scénarios CRM (onboarding, activation, nurturing, réactivation, winback...).  Piloter les campagnes sur l'ensemble des canaux (email, SMS, push notifications, messages in-app...).  Définir les messages et coordonner leur production avec les équipes Marketing et Éditoriales.  Mettre en place une démarche d'amélioration continue via des A/B tests et des expérimentations régulières.      3.Data & optimisation des parcours utilisateurs   Développer les dispositifs de collecte de données afin d'améliorer la connaissance client.  Optimiser les parcours utilisateurs en collaboration avec les équipes Produit.  Garantir la qualité des données CRM ainsi que le respect des réglementations RGPD.  Identifier les points de friction et proposer des recommandations d'amélioration.      4.Pilotage de la performance   Définir et suivre les principaux KPI CRM (engagement, rétention, churn, LTV, taux d'ouverture, taux de clic...).  Construire les reportings et analyser les performances des campagnes.  Identifier les leviers de croissance et recommander les optimisations nécessaires.      5.Collaboration transverse   Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Produit, Data, Marketing, Growth et Éditoriales.  Diffuser une culture orientée utilisateur et data au sein de l'entreprise.  Participer aux réflexions autour de l'évolution des outils, des parcours et des pratiques CRM. description: 회사 소개   쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.  쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.  쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.      직무 소개   Account Management 팀은 판매자의 성장을 지원하고 Marketplace의 지속적인 비즈니스 성과 향상에 기여하는 조직입니다. 담당 셀러의 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴하여 매출 확대를 위한 전략을 제안합니다. 셀러와 긴밀하게 협업하며 프로모션, 가격 경쟁력, 상품 운영 등 다양한 성장 활동을 지원합니다. 데이터 기반의 인사이트와 컨설팅을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 개선 및 장기적인 파트너십 구축을 목표로 합니다.      업무 내용    마켓플레이스 셀러의 포트폴리오를 관리하며, 비즈니스 현황을 분석하고 성장 기회를 발굴  마켓플레이스 셀러의 비즈니스 현황과 주요 성과 (매출, 트래픽, 전환율 등) 지표를 분석하고, 매출 성장을 위한 영업 전략 수립·실행  프로모션, 상품 운영 개선 등을 통해 셀러의 비즈니스 성과 향상 지원  셀러의 니즈와 문제점을 파악하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 제안하여 지속적인 성장을 지원       자격   요건    영업, Account Management, Business Development 또는 관련 분야에서 최소 3년 이상의 경력을 보유하신 분  고객 또는 파트너 비즈니스 관리 경험이 있으신 분  데이터와 지표를 기반으로 문제를 분석하고 해결한 경험이 있으신 분  우수한 커뮤니케이션 및 관계 구축 역량이 있으신 분  목표 달성을 위한 강한 실행력과 오너십을 가지신 분  빠르게 변화하는 환경에서 우선순위를 설정하고 다양한 과제를 효과적으로 관리할 수 있는 분  셀러의 니즈를 깊이 이해하고 데이터 기반의 솔루션을 통해 비즈니스 성과를 개선한 경험이 있으신 분       우대   사항    이커머스 또는 온라인 플랫폼 관련 경험이 있으신 분  B2B 영업 또는 고객 관리 경험이 있으신 분  판매자 관리 또는 고객 성공(Customer Success) 경험이 있으신 분  Excel, SQL 또는 BI Tool 활용 경험이 있으신 분       전형 절차 및 안내 사항    전형절차    서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격  전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.  전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.    참고사항    본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.  지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.  취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.  직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.  채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.  고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.       개인정보 처리방침    쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다. https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy/    서류 반환 정책    본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.  당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.  위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (recruitingops@coupang.com) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.  당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류

description: Vil du være med til at skabe fremtidens sikkerhedsløsninger for mere end en million danske kunder?   Sikkerhed er blevet en afgørende del af danskernes digitale hverdag. Derfor søger vi en kollega, der kan være med til at udvikle og styrke YouSees sikkerhedstilbud på tværs af vores produkter.  Vi leder efter en profil, der kan bygge bro mellem teknologi, kundebehov og kommercielle mål. Du forstår sikkerhedsområdet, kan navigere i teknisk kompleksitet og omsætte den til services og oplevelser, som skaber tryghed og tydelig værdi for kunderne.  Du bliver en del af Product Experience Management-teamet i Commercial & Products og får en central rolle i samarbejdet mellem produktudvikling, teknologi, kommercielle teams og strategiske partnere på tværs af YouSee og TDC Brands.   Din rolle   I en nyoprettet rolle som Product Experience Manager for Security får du det kommercielle ansvar for udviklingen af YouSees sikkerhedsløsninger.  Du ejer den samlede kundeoplevelse på sikkerhed og omsætter kundeindsigter, markedstrends og teknologiske muligheder til en tydelig vision og konkrete initiativer.  Du arbejder for, at vi i stigende grad forebygger og løser problemer, før kunderne oplever dem. Samtidig sikrer du, at vores sikkerhedsløsninger udvikles og positioneres med fokus på kundeværdi, differentiering og profitabel vækst.  Du tager ansvar for den samlede kunderejse og bidrager til udviklingen af alt fra produktpositionering og onboarding til CRM-kommunikation og løbende engagement.  Du designer ikke selv de tekniske løsninger, men er med til at definere, hvilke problemer der skal løses, hvilke services der skal udvikles, og hvordan de bringes til markedet.  Rollen kræver desuden, at du kan tale med tekniske specialister om komplekse sikkerhedsløsninger og samtidig formidle værdien af dem til forretningen og kunderne.   Dine opgaver inkluderer:     Analysere data, kundeindsigter og markedstendenser og omsætte dem til sikkerhedsløsninger med kundeværdi og kommerciel effekt.  Identificere churn- og kontaktdrivere relateret til vores sikkerhedsløsninger og omsætte indsigterne til konkrete forbedringer.  Indgå i tæt samarbejde med Product Leads, Commercial Managers, Customer Journey Managers, Product Owners, eksterne partnere mv.  Bidrage til roadmap, prioritering og kommerciel udvikling af både indbygget sikkerhed i vores kerneprodukter og nye sikkerhedsservices, der skaber tryghed og værdi for kunderne.  Overvåge udviklingen i cybersecurity, digitale trusler og markedstendenser, så vores løsninger forbliver relevante og attraktive.      Din profil   Du kombinerer forretningsforståelse med indsigt i sikkerhedsområdet og trives i spændingsfeltet mellem teknologi, kunder og forretning.  Du er nysgerrig, initiativrig og tager naturligt ejerskab for dit område samt skaber resultater gennem samarbejde og faglig gennemslagskraft frem for formelt ledelsesansvar. Samtidig evner du at skabe retning, samle interessenter om den og drive udviklingen fremad.   V
