Det gjør vi gjennom å utvikle fellesløsninger, slik at domstolene kan konsentrere seg som sine hovedoppgaver i dag og i fremtiden.  IT-avdelingen har et overordnet ansvar for forvaltning av informasjon og bruk av teknologi i Norges domstoler. Avdelingen skal sikre stabile, sikre og fremtidsrettede IT-løsninger som understøtter domstolenes virksomhet og ambisjonen om et digitalt rettsliv. Avdelingen består totalt av om lag 60 medarbeidere, fordelt på Seksjon for applikasjonsutvikling og test, Seksjon for digital arbeidsplass og Seksjon for sikkerhet, arkitektur og tjenesteplattform.  Brukersenteret er nylig etablert som en egen gruppe i Seksjon for digital arbeidsplass. Brukersenteret er intern førstelinje for IT-støtte til Norges domstoler og har en sentral rolle i å sikre stabil drift, gode brukeropplevelser og effektiv innføring av nye IT-løsninger. Det er totalt ca. 2000 brukere.  Vi har nå ledig stilling som gruppeleder. Gruppeleder vil rapportere til seksjonssjef for Digital Arbeidsplass.   Arbeidsoppgaver   Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være å:   lede og videreutvikle Brukersenteret som nasjonal brukerstøttefunksjon  ha personalansvar for gruppens medarbeidere, herunder oppfølging, utviklingssamtaler, kompetanseutvikling og arbeidsmiljø  sørge for effektiv drift, bemanning og prioritering av oppgaver  følge opp mål, kvalitet, kapasitet og leveranser  videreutvikle arbeidsprosesser, rutiner og metoder for brukerstøtte  bidra til god samhandling mellom Brukersenteret, andre fagmiljøer i IT-avdelingen og våre leverandører  være en sentral samarbeidspartner for IT-rådgivere og IT-koordinatorer i domstolene, og lede utviklingen av disse rollene  bidra i planlegging og gjennomføring av større endringer, innføringer og forbedringstiltak på IT-området  sikre at brukernes behov og erfaringer blir fanget opp, systematisert og omsatt til forbedringer       Kvalifikasjoner   Vi ser etter deg som har:   relevant høyere utdanning, minimum bachelor innen IT, gjerne med ledelse i fagkretsen  erfaring med tjenesteleveranser, brukerstøtte eller IT-forvaltning  erfaring med personalledelse er en fordel, men kandidater med erfaring fra faglig ledelse oppfordres også til å søke  kjennskap til ITSM-rammeverk, prosessarbeid eller kontinuerlig forbedring er en fordel      Ansettelse til denne stillingen forutsetter godkjent bakgrunnssjekk.   Personlige egenskaper    Du trives med å kombinere operativ oppfølging med langsiktig utviklingsarbeid.  Du har god relasjons- og mellommenneskelig kompetanse, og bygger tillit på tvers av fagmiljøer.  Du er strukturert, beslutningsdyktig og god til å prioritere.  Du samarbeider godt og kommuniserer klart og tydelig på norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig.  Du motiveres av å utvikle mennesker og fagmiljø.       Vi tilbyr   I tillegg til en jobb som er viktig for både enkeltpersoner og samfunnet får du:   muligheten til å utvi

title: Founding Customer Success Lead
description: Own everything after “yes”: pilot, onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion, plus the proof that comes out of it.     On-site in either Stockholm or Malmö.     Oplane is not a tool people buy and forget. It runs inside the coding loop, it finds real architectural risk in code that is still being written, and it only pays off when a customer’s engineers actually change what they do with it. Right now the people who make that happen are two founders and two customer-facing engineers, and there is no owner for what happens after a contract is signed.     You are that owner, and you are building the function from nothing. There is no onboarding playbook, no health model, no renewal motion. You will write all three while running live accounts yourself.     What you’ll own  Everything after “yes.” Pilot, onboarding, adoption, retention and expansion, plus the proof that comes out of happy customers.     What the job actually is  · Run pilots to a real outcome. Our pilots are short and strict, and success is a customer seeing a genuine finding in their own code and fixing it. You own that path from kickoff to decision.  · Understand the customer’s work better than they expect you to. How they ship, what their review process actually looks like, where security slows them down, who inside the company is under pressure and why. This is the core of the job. If you are not curious about somebody else’s engineering org, you will not enjoy it here.  · Get Oplane properly embedded. Into their repos, their CI, their pull request flow and their coding agents. You will be hands-on with technical setup, working alongside our engineers rather than handing it to them.  · Build the retention system. Health signals, adoption milestones, the difference between a customer who is using it and a customer who is depending on it. Then renewals and expansion, which follow from that rather than from a QBR calendar.  · Turn success into proof. Customer stories, references, joint sessions with our marketing and sales work. Our buyers trust other practitioners far more than they trust us, so the accounts you make successful become the reason the next ones sign.  · Feed the product. You will see every place the product creates friction before anyone else does, and we expect that to reach the engineers directly rather than through a quarterly summary.     Who this is for  · At least 4 years owning customers in a technical B2B product. We are looking for someone who has already done this well, not someone learning it here.  · You can point at retention and expansion numbers you personally influenced, and explain what you did to move them.  · You have genuinely spent time in the field with customers, in their tools and their meetings, making somebody’s job measurably easier. This is not a role for someone whose experience is ticket queues and renewal reminders.  · You are technical enough to talk about repositories, pull requests, CI pipelines and coding agents without a tran

We improve many of your favorite athletes' performances with our wearable tracking technology, video and data analysis systems, and athlete management products. Our technology offers objective solutions to sport-based challenges and can be found throughout the NFL, NHL, NBA, AFL, NRL, Premier League, Bundesliga, La Liga and many more.

The Role:

 

Spire is making a fundamental shift in how it operates its constellation. We are moving from a model where trained operators watch dashboards and escalate to experts, to one where the system is fully autonomous, self-healing, and data intelligent. This Director will lead that transformation. You will set the technical vision, define the architecture, build and inspire the team, and personally raise the standard for what modern space operations look like. 

The old model relies on operators, escalations, manual processes, and institutional knowledge locked in the heads of a few experts. It does not scale and it does not belong in a modern space company. We know what we want to replace it with: SRE principles applied to a constellation, autonomous fault handling, AI-driven anomaly detection, low toil, high data quality, and continuous improvement baked into the system. 


What This Role Is Not: 

This is not a role for someone who wants to graduate out of technical work. If your ideal week is back-to-back 1:1s, sprint ceremonies, and stakeholder syncs, this is not the right fit. We need a director who writes code, reviews architecture, challenges technical decisions, and earns the team's respect through demonstrated craft and not just tenure or title.

title: Fachinformatiker Systemintegration (m/w/d) vor Ort | Es ist kein Job - Wir leben IT!
description:
Wir leben IT.

Eigentlich suchen wir keinen Mitarbeiter. Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust hat, mit uns IT zu machen.

Wir sind ein kleines Team mit einer großen Leidenschaft für Technik. Uns begeistert alles, was blinkt, piept, sich virtualisieren lässt oder einfach nur funktioniert, nachdem wir daran geschraubt haben. Neue Technologien probieren wir lieber selbst aus, als nur darüber zu lesen.

Unsere Kunden verlassen sich darauf, dass ihre IT läuft. Deshalb sind wir da, wenn es darauf ankommt – meistens per Remotezugriff, manchmal aber auch direkt vor Ort. Mal geht es um Server, Virtualisierung oder Netzwerke, mal erklären wir einem Kunden zum dritten Mal, warum der Monitor tatsächlich eingeschaltet sein muss. Wir nennen das liebevoll „betreutes Arbeiten“ – und meistens können wir anschließend gemeinsam darüber lachen.

Bei uns gibt es keine Konzernstrukturen und keine langen Entscheidungswege. Wir arbeiten unkompliziert zusammen, kommunizieren direkt und helfen uns gegenseitig – egal ob im Büro, im Homeoffice oder unterwegs.

Und ja: Wenn wir Lust haben, gehen wir gemeinsam mit Kunden oder anderen ITlern zum Chinesen oder ins Steakhaus. Nicht weil das irgendwo vorgeschrieben ist, sondern weil wir uns gut verstehen.

Wenn Du morgens eher denkst „Mal sehen, was heute kaputt ist“ als „Schon wieder Montag“, dann könnten wir ziemlich gut zusammenpassen.

Kurz gesagt: Wir leben IT. Nicht nur zwischen 8 und 17 Uhr.

Aufgaben

Jeder Tag ist anders – genau deshalb macht der Job bei uns Spaß.

Du bist der erste Ansprechpartner, wenn beim Kunden die IT mal wieder beschlossen hat, ein Eigenleben zu entwickeln.

Die meisten Probleme lassen sich per Remotezugriff lösen, wenn es aber sinnvoller ist, fährst Du direkt zum Kunden und bringst die Technik wieder zum Laufen.

Du installierst und betreust Windows-Clients, Windows-Server, Microsoft 365 sowie alles, was in einer modernen IT-Umgebung dazugehört.

  • Partner with our CEO on go-to-market and pricing — you bring the product and customer evidence; he owns the commercial side. You'll collaborate closely.
  • Become a GRC expert, fast — controls, RACM, audit evidence, the regulatory frameworks. We'll backstop you, but you'll own becoming fluent.

title: Embedded Software-Entwicklung Vollzeit (M/W/D) C, ESP32, BLE, IoT
description:
Irgendwo an einem norwegischen Fjord steht gerade ein Camper im Regen. Drinnen ist es warm, weil eine Firmware zuverlässig ihren Job macht. Vielleicht bald Deine.

Aufgaben

  • Du gestaltest unsere BLE-Schnittstellen zwischen Modulen und App
  • Du bringst Drittgeräte zum Sprechen: Heizungen, Batterien, Wechselrichter und Sensorik namhafter Hersteller, über CAN, RS-485/Modbus und VEDirect

Jemand wählt die 112. Noch bevor die Feuerwehrkräfte eintreffen, liefert unsere Drohne den Einsatzkräften ein Lagebild aus der Luft. Sekunden, die Leben retten.

Das ist Realität. Feuerwehren und Einsatzleitstellen in Deutschland arbeiten bereits mit unserer Technologie – automatisierte Drohnenflüge, Echtzeit-Lagebilder, noch bevor die ersten Kräfte eintreffen. Und das ist erst der Anfang.

Du willst, dass deine Arbeit einen echten Unterschied macht? Dann bist du bei uns richtig – unser Piloten-Team freut sich auf Verstärkung. Unser Ziel ist klar: Gefahrenabwehr effizienter und schneller machen. Als Pilot:in bei uns übernimmst du Verantwortung im 24/7-Einsatz – zuverlässig, sicher und mit dem Anspruch, gemeinsam mit uns zu wachsen.

Unsere Piloten-Team steuert die Einsätze von unserem Pilotenleitstand in Bensheim.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Echte Einsätze, echte Verantwortung: Du arbeitest an einem System, das im Ernstfall Leben schützt, kein Konzept, sondern laufender Betrieb.

title: Founding Designer (Code-First / 100% Remote)
description:
neoBIM is a cutting‑edge startup transforming the construction industry with AI‑powered Building Information Modeling (BIM). Co‑founded by industry pioneers, the company is on a mission to make BIM smarter, faster and more collaborative. With a growing team, neoBIM offers an innovative work environment, a flexible culture and the chance to work on impactful global projects.

We're hiring our founding designer to own the look, feel, and design system of the product from day one — and to do it in a way that's collapsing the old design-to-handoff pipeline.

How we think about design here

The traditional loop is: design in Figma → hand off → engineers translate to code → drift sets in → repeat. We don't want that. Tools like Claude now let designers express intent directly in code, working in the real design system instead of a mirror of it. So the only translation step left is designer-code → production-code — far closer, far less lossy.

We're not dogmatic about never opening a canvas to think. But the designer we want is someone who reaches for code as their primary medium and treats the running product as the source of truth.

Tasks

  • Define and build our design system in code, using shadcn/ui as the foundation — tokens, variants, modes, responsive behaviour, accessibility
  • Prototype directly in code with AI assistance (Claude), so what you "design" is already buildable and lives in the codebase
  • Design the entire product surface — from the 3D canvas and viewport controls to property panels, dashboards, and onboarding flows
  • Own iconography and illustration: either craft our icon set and product illustrations yourself, or art-direct freelancers to deliver a consistent, high-quality visual language
  • Work in a tight loop with engineers, where "handoff" mostly means a code review, not a translation
  • Shape the brand and marke

description: About IMMA       Independent Multicultural Media Australia Ltd (IMMA) is the national peak body representing more than 60 independent multicultural media outlets across Australia. We advocate for equity in government and agency advertising, support training and digital transformation, and give multicultural media a strong collective voice.     Our members are the media. They are the publishers, broadcasters and digital outlets reaching audiences in language and in community every day in Australia, and they are the reason IMMA exists.       The Role       The Member Services Manager is IMMA's single point of contact for member outlets, and the person responsible for building what our members are able to do.     This is a member-facing job. You will maintain relationships across the membership, learn each outlet's business, and be the person members hear from regularly and can depend on. Communication is a key part of it: keeping members informed, briefed and connected to what IMMA is doing on their behalf.     The other half is development. Our members range from substantial digital businesses to family run outlets that have served the same community for decades, and they need different things from us. You will identify where members need support, organise practical training, build the guidance and templates, and work with each outlet on a plan to get them where they need to be. Some members are already there. Many are not, and moving them along that pathway is the central measure of success in your first year.     You will also support the success of our advertising booking platform, Multicultural Media Direct (MMD). This includes overseeing campaign delivery once a booking is confirmed, working through MMD's operations team.     This role reports to the General Manager.       What You Will Do        Member relationships             Be the primary point of contact for IMMA's member outlets  Build a real working knowledge of each member’s media offering: audiences, formats, rates, specifications, production requirements and commercial practice  Understand what members need from IMMA, and bring that back into how IMMA operates  Be the person members call, and the person who calls them before there is a problem       Member communications       Keep members informed about what IMMA is doing, what opportunities are coming and what is expected of them  Write and issue member updates, briefing notes, opportunity notices and practical guidance  Run member briefings and check-ins, one-to-one and in groups  Make sure information moves both ways, so members hear from IMMA early and IMMA hears from members early  Maintain accurate member records and contact details       Training, development and capability building         Identify where members need support  Design ongoing or periodic training around member needs  Build guidance, templates and standards members can use  Work with each member on a development plan: what needs to be in place, who is do

title: Customer Support Lead
description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Customer Support Lead based in Germany.   As Customer Support Lead, you will lead and scale a global customer support function in a fully remote, technology-driven environment. You will oversee both AI-powered and human support operations while ensuring high-quality, timely, and safe resolutions for users. The role combines people leadership, technical troubleshooting, support operations, and AI-enabled service innovation. You will establish service standards, improve workflows and knowledge systems, and use support data to drive measurable operational improvements. Working closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI teams, you will turn customer insights and support issues into actionable improvements. This is an opportunity to shape a modern, scalable support organization at the intersection of customer experience, technology, and emerging digital products.   Accountabilities   You will be responsible for leading the support organization, maintaining operational excellence, and continuously improving the experience delivered through both human and AI-powered channels.    Lead, coach, develop, and grow the customer support team, including performance management, hiring, and training.  Oversee day-to-day support operations across AI and human channels, ensuring timely, accurate, and high-quality issue resolution.  Manage complex and escalated cases, particularly those involving technical product issues.  Build scalable support processes, workflows, escalation policies, and knowledge management systems.  Maintain accurate and consistent support guidance across AI and human channels.  Track key performance indicators including SLA, CSAT, resolution time, backlog, verified resolution, repeat contacts, escalation quality, and cost per resolved issue. Collaborate on AI support acceptance criteria, rollout readiness, and post-launch monitoring.  Help define the long-term strategy for a scalable, technology-enabled global customer support organization.     Requirements   The ideal candidate combines strong customer support leadership with technical troubleshooting capabilities, operational expertise, and hands-on experience with AI-powered support environments. title: Teamlead of Customer Care Hunting & Nature (m/w/x)
description: Im Rahmen der geplanten Ausgliederung des Geschäftsbereichs ZEISS Hunting & Nature wird ein neues, eigenständiges Unternehmen gegründet. Die Stellenbesetzung erfolgt durch ZEISS, der Arbeitsvertrag wird jedoch mit dem neu gegründeten, eigenständigen Unternehmen geschlossen.    Werden Sie Teil von Hunting & Nature – einem spannenden Endverbrauchergeschäft, das weltweit innovative optische Produkte für Jäger, Vogelbeobachter und Outdoor-Begeisterte anbietet. Unsere Begeisterung für Innovation und Präzision treibt uns an, Produkte zu entwickeln, die das Leben unserer Kunden bereichern und ihre Naturbeobachtungen sowie Jagderlebnisse auf ein neues Niveau heben.   Ihre Rolle   Ihre Rolle Als Leitung Der Abteilung Customer Care Hunting & Nature (m/w/x) Für Mitarbeitende An Mehreren Deutschen Standorten Sind Sie Unter Anderem Für Die Personal- Und Budgetplanung Sowie Für Eine Einwandfreie Schnittstellenkommunikation Verantwortlich. Zu Ihren Aufgaben Gehören Außerdem    Koordination der Customer-Care-Einheiten an unseren Standorten Aalen, Köln und Wetzlar sowie Sicherstellung des europäischen Customer-Care-Volumens in verschiedenen Ländern (Schwerpunkt Europa)  Implementierung und Verantwortung nachhaltiger und wirtschaftlicher Service- und Support-Konzepte im 1st und 2nd Level  Identifikation, Neudefinition und Integration von Optimierungspotenzialen innerhalb bestehender Kundensupportprozesse sowie die Gewährleistung fortwährender kontinuierlicher Verbesserung  Verantwortung für die Einhaltung definierter Performance- und Kundenzufriedenheitskennzahlen sowie die Ableitung von Ursachenanalysen bei Abweichungen und Einleitung entsprechender Maßnahmen  Initiierung, Moderation und Leitung teamübergreifender Abstimmungen  Definition und Einhaltung von KPIs (Kernkennzahlen) im Bereich Customer Care    Gestalten Sie eigeninitiativ und eigenverantwortlich schlanke und effektive Prozesse, bringen Sie sich in Verbesserungen ein und sichern Sie gemeinsam mit uns einen aktiven und herausragenden Kundensupport für das aktuelle und zukünftige Produktportfolio. Ihnen bietet sich die Gelegenheit, unseren Bereich Hunting & Nature mit uns gemeinsam aus den Konzernstrukturen in ein mittelständiges Unternehmen zu entwickeln. Dabei bietet sich die Gelegenheit mit großen Gestaltungsspielraum den Servicebereich eigenständig innovativ weiterzuentwickeln.   Ihr Profil      Studienabschluss im Bereich BWL, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder vergleichbar  Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Customer Care, Service- oder Projektmanagement oder Digital Devices/Services  Hohe technische Kompetenz, um mögliche Servicekonzept eigenständig bewerten und optimieren zu können  Hohe IT-Affinität, sowohl in Bezug auf digitale Arbeitswelten (Cloud-Lösungen, CRM-Systeme, Call Center Lösungen), aber auch in Bezug auf den Support digitaler/ vernetzter Geräte und neuen Lösungen für den Customer Care Bereich  Flexibilität und Reisebereitschaft in Bezug auf den Arbeitsstand

title: Client Services Manager
description: Company Description  Enabling Hands Support Services is a support-focused organization based at 19 Hasking Street in Caboolture, Queensland, Australia. The company provides services to individuals and communities needing tailored assistance in their daily lives. Team members work closely with clients to promote independence, wellbeing, and access to appropriate resources. The organization values compassionate, reliable, and professional support, and offers opportunities for staff to build long-term relationships with clients and community stakeholders.   Role Description  The Client Services Manager is a full-time, on-site role located in Caboolture, QLD. This position is responsible for overseeing the delivery of client services, ensuring a high standard of care, and maintaining strong client relationships. Day-to-day tasks include supervising support staff, coordinating client service plans, monitoring service quality and client satisfaction, and resolving issues or concerns promptly. The role also involves liaising with families, caregivers, and external providers, managing documentation and reporting, and contributing to continuous improvement initiatives. The Client Services Manager collaborates with leadership to align services with organizational goals and regulatory requirements.   Qualifications       Candidates should possess strong Client Services and Customer Service skills, with a focus on responsive and respectful support.  Candidates should possess Customer Satisfaction skills, including the ability to monitor feedback and implement improvements.  Candidates should possess effective Communication skills, both verbal and written, for interacting with clients, families, and staff.  Candidates should possess Analytical Skills to review service data, identify trends, and support informed decision-making.  Experience in community services, disability support, aged care, or a related human services sector is beneficial.  Demonstrated leadership or supervisory experience in a client-facing environment is preferred.  Relevant qualifications in social work, community services, health, or a related discipline are advantageous.  Ability to work collaboratively, manage competing priorities, and maintain accurate records in line with organizational and regulatory standards.

Met ons platform AxyLife helpen wij klanten hun pensioenadministratie toekomstbestendig, flexibel en efficiënt in te richten.  De pensioenmarkt staat voor grote veranderingen. Nieuwe wet- en regelgeving, digitalisering en toenemende verwachtingen van deelnemers en klanten vragen om betrouwbare technologie en sterke dienstverlening. Daarom investeren wij voortdurend in innovatie, professionalisering en de ontwikkeling van onze mensen.  Bij Lumera werk je in een omgeving waar technologie, pensioenen en dienstverlening samenkomen. Je krijgt veel ruimte om initiatief te nemen, ideeën uit te werken en daadwerkelijk impact te maken op onze klanten én onze organisatie.   Jouw uitdaging   Als Service Delivery Manager ben je verantwoordelijk voor de dienstverlening aan één of meerdere klanten. Je bent het centrale aanspreekpunt voor de klant en zorgt ervoor dat gemaakte afspraken worden nagekomen, verwachtingen worden gemanaged en verbeteringen worden gerealiseerd.  Je werkt nauw samen met Product Owners, Product Specialisten, Software Engineers en andere stakeholders binnen Lumera. Daarbij stuur je op continuïteit, kwaliteit, klanttevredenheid en verdere groei van de dienstverlening.  Je weet wat er speelt bij de klant, begrijpt de strategische doelstellingen en vertaalt deze naar concrete acties voor jouw team. Tegelijkertijd houd je overzicht over lopende changes, releases, incidenten, projecten en verbeterinitiatieven.   Wat ga je doen? Leiding geven aan multidisciplinaire klantteams en zorgen voor focus, samenwerking en resultaat.  Bewaken van servicelevels, kwaliteit, voortgang en klanttevredenheid.  Coördineren van changes, releases, onderhoudswerkzaamheden en verbetertrajecten.  Signaleren, analyseren en beheersen van risico's, afhankelijkheden en knelpunten.  Opstellen en presenteren van rapportages en service reviews.  Proactief adviseren van klanten over verbeteringen, innovaties en toekomstige ontwikkelingen.  Sturen op een optimale balans tussen klantwensen, capaciteit, prioriteiten en kwaliteit.  Bijdragen aan de verdere professionalisering van Service Delivery binnen Lumera. description: Purpose of role: The Head of Customer Onboarding & Success will lead the onboarding of new customers onto the Ezora financial control and analytics solution and to ensure that existing customers continue to receive the full benefits of the Ezora service. This is a remote working role, based in Ireland, with occasional travel to company events or meetings. The Ezora platform ingests, validates, and reconciles operational and financial data into a single verified source of truth, automating up to 95% of customers' monthly accounting entries. Coupled with that, our analytics layer provides bespoke metrics, visualisations and reports that key decision-makers in these brands use to run their companies on a daily basis.     On top of this verified data, Ezora also enables AI-powered analysis, letting customers connect their own data securely to a leading AI model and interrogate their numbers in plain language, with the model reasoning only over data that has already been validated and reconciled.      Why this role exists   Ezora is growing its customer base of QSR and retail franchise operators, and our ability to deliver new implementations and manage existing client relationships needs to scale with it. As we grow, we need a dedicated owner for client communication and project coordination, someone who can give every project a single, consistent owner from kickoff through to go-live and beyond.     You'll become the day-to-day owner of every customer implementation and project at Ezora - the person who knows what's happening, when, and why, across every live engagement. You'll be the connective tissue between our customers, our CEO, our delivery teams, and any third parties involved, making sure nothing falls through the cracks and every customer feels looked after.     This is a foundational hire for Ezora. title: Director (Head) of Customer Success Management
description: About Portless   Portless is a dynamic and innovative 3PL provider revolutionizing how businesses manage their direct supply chain. We help merchants deliver a fast, reliable post-purchase experience through fulfillment and logistics built for cross-border scale, powered by international warehouses and global orchestration so they can grow with confidence. You lead the Customer Success Management motions, including onboarding & lifecycle teams. You are the owner of Gross and Net Revenue Retention for the merchant base, and set the coverage model, playbooks, and cadences that turn the customer success flywheel (Adopt → Realize Value → Expand → Renew with Confidence) into a repeatable system across the Enterprise, Strategic, and Growth segments. You serve as an accountable partner in the success of our merchants and the Portless team members who support them. title: Head of Client Partnerships
description: Lead leaders to drive growth, build capability, and influence some of Australia's biggest brands at executive level      Commercial leadership role in one of Australia's most ambitious businesses  Act as the 2IC to an inspiring leader who will challenge and support you  Lead a high-value portfolio and shape the next phase of growth       You've built large revenue portfolios. You've led leaders. You've managed complexity without letting it become chaos.       But you're looking for something bigger than simply hitting a number.      We're partnering with a high-growth Australian business that sits at the intersection of commerce, marketing and customer strategy. In just a few years, it has become a major player in its category and is now focused on its next chapter of growth.     They're looking for a  Head of Client Partnerships  to lead a significant commercial portfolio, a team of experienced people leaders, and a customer base that includes some of the country's largest organisations.     This is not a role where you'll inherit a perfectly polished machine. The business has scaled quickly. The opportunity now is to bring greater consistency, capability and strategic thinking to a high-performing team while continuing to drive ambitious growth targets.      There are three big pieces to the role:     You'll own the operational rhythm of a large and complex commercial portfolio.  Hundreds of customer opportunities move through the business at any given time. You'll create visibility, discipline and predictability, ensuring the right priorities get attention, and leaders stay focused on what matters most.   Second, you'll develop a group of people leaders who are talented, capable and still growing as managers.  You'll coach them on performance management, feedback, accountability and leadership fundamentals. Success will be measured not simply by revenue outcomes, but by the quality of leadership capability you build beneath you.   Third, you'll help shift customer conversations to a different level.  Today, many relationships are strong commercially. The next horizon is becoming a genuine strategic partner. That means understanding the customer's broader objectives, engaging more effectively with marketing and brand stakeholders, and helping teams move from selling products to solving business problems.      The person who succeeds in this role will be equally comfortable discussing commercial performance, customer strategy, organisational capability and leadership development.     You'll work for a highly respected executive who is known for setting high standards, backing talented people and developing future leaders.  The culture is ambitious, fast-moving and direct. title: Customer Onboarding & Account Manager
description: Annature is an Australian-based digital signature, identity verification & payments company. Founded to challenge Docusign by putting transparency, fairness, and genuine customer service first, we pioneered Pay as you go pricing in the digital signing space, so our customers only pay for what they use.     We're lean, agile, and customer-focused — we'd rather ship the features that matter than pile on unnecessary complexity. Today we serve 8,000+ businesses and 120,000+ monthly active users across Australia, the UK, and the US, who've collectively signed more than 70 million envelopes together, spanning industries from legal and accounting to real estate, financial services, education, and NDIS.      The role      We're looking for someone to sit at the intersection of onboarding and account management — the human face of Annature for both brand-new signups and our existing customer base.     For new customers, you'll be the first real person they speak to after signing up. We have an outreach team that handles initial contact and demo bookings, and you'll take it from there: running one-on-one product tours, understanding what each customer is trying to achieve, and qualifying them so the right next steps happen. It's not a sales role, but sales-shaped questions will come up regularly — when they do, you'll know enough to answer the basics and bring in someone from sales for anything that needs a customised quote.     For existing customers, you will be their single, dedicated point of contact for anything account-related. We have a support team for when something's genuinely not working the way it should; your job is everything else — helping customers understand how to get the most out of the platform, answering "how do I..." and "what's the best way to..." questions with confidence, and knowing when an issue is actually a support issue.     There's also room to grow this role in a sales direction if you want it - more on that below.      What you'll be doing       Own an assigned portfolio of Annature customers as their dedicated point of contact for account-related enquiries.  Run one-on-one product demos and onboarding tours for new signups booked through our outreach team.  Qualify new signups — understand their use case, their team, and what they're trying to solve — so demos and follow-ups are relevant.  Answer day-to-day product and "how do I" questions confidently, escalating genuine technical or support issues to our support team rather than deflecting everything to them.  Recognise when a customer's needs point toward a customised subscription or commercial arrangement, and hand off warmly to the sales team.       If you want it: take on sales conversations yourself and work toward commission targets (see below — this is optional, not a requirement of the role). title: Customer Sucess Manager 80–100% SaaS Enterprise
description: Willst du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Tech, KI und der Immobilienwelt arbeiten?  Schätzt du den Kontakt zu Menschen und hast ein echtes Interesse an Technologien? Deine Mission?  Deine Arbeit verbindet Beratung, Kundenbindung und Vertriebsdynamik und hat direkten Einfluss auf Umsatz und Wachstum :      Du begleitest unsere Neukunden und betreust unsere Bestandskunden, damit sie unsere Lösung nicht nur nutzen, sondern lieben!  Du führst Schulungen für Kunden durch, entweder per Video oder persönlich vor Ort, und hilfst ihnen, unsere Lösung optimal zu nutzen  Du analysierst und löst funktionale Probleme der Kunden, damit sie die Software effizient und rentabel nutzen können  Du sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden das Beste aus unserer Lösung herausholen, und erkennst Upselling-Potenziale (neue Funktionen, Benutzerpakete, Module)  Du bist aktiv an der Erstellung und Pflege der Dokumentation und der Best Practices für die Nutzung unserer Software beteiligt, um Kunden dabei zu helfen, die Software selbstständig zu nutzen (DOCS, FAQ, ...)  Du sammelst Kundenfeedback und lieferst damit wertvolle Informationen an das interne Team, um zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Software beizutragen (Verbesserungen, Bugs, Priorisierung).       Dein Profil?  Du musst nic

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Job Description    About Us   Longbridge is a leading, next-generation internet brokerage and fintech company established in Singapore in 2019. We provide a one-stop, multi-asset global investment platform offering access to SG, HK, and US markets, with innovative investment and trading solutions designed to make investing smarter, simpler, and more accessible.   About The Role   The Team Manager will lead and manage the 24/7 Malaysia Customer Service team, ensuring the delivery of consistent, high-quality customer service across all shifts.  You will be responsible for team performance, workforce planning, operational efficiency and service quality. You will also work closely with internal stakeholders, including Product, Operations, Compliance and other relevant teams, to identify recurring customer issues and drive improvements to products, services and customer experience based on customer feedback.  The successful candidate will be a strong people leader who can build a high-performing team, manage a 24/7 operation and ensure service levels and customer experience standards are consistently achieved.   Key Responsibilities     Lead and manage the 24/7 Malaysia Customer Service team, including Customer Service Officers and Shift Leads.  Set performance expectations and drive achievement of KPIs, SLAs, CSAT and service-quality targets.  Coach and develop Shift Leads and team members through regular performance reviews and development discussions.  Manage workforce planning and shift scheduling to ensure adequate 24/7 coverage.  Monitor operational performance and use data/MIS to identify trends, performance gaps and improvement opportunities.  Oversee customer escalations, complaints and operational incidents, ensuring timely resolution and appropriate escalation.  Work with Product, Operations, Compliance and other stakeholders to address recurring customer issues and improve processes.  Partner with HR on recruitment, onboarding, performance management and future headcount planning.  Drive a positive, accountable and high-performing team culture.     Requirements     4–5 years of experience in Customer Support / Customer Service management, preferably within a brokerage, securities, fintech, financial-services or other regulated environment.  Experience managing or supporting a 24/7 Customer Support operation is strongly preferred.  Proven track record of meeting or exceeding team KPIs, SLAs and customer-service performance.  Strong people-management, coaching and performance-management skills.  Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using operational data/MIS to drive improvements.  Experience in workforce planning, scheduling and resource management is an advantage.  Strong stakeholder-management and communication skills.  Fluent in English and Mandarin; Bahasa Melayu is an added advantage.  Willing to support the 24/7 operation, including occasional night shifts, weekends or public holidays when required.

title: Avdelingsleder Kundesenter Innlandet
description: Menneskene er selve DNA-et i DNB. Siden 1822 har kloke hoder jobbet sammen for å finne de beste løsningene for kundene våre. I dag er DNB mye mer enn Norges største bank – vi er en teknologidrevet finansinstitusjon som på stadig nye måter knytter mennesker og ideer til kunnskap og kapital.    Mangfoldig er noe vi er, og inkluderende er noe vi hver dag velger å være. Vi gir rom for deg og dine tanker, og vi lover å gjøre vårt aller beste for at du skal føle deg hjemme hos oss. En jobb i Norges største finanskonsern byr på faglige utfordringer i et spennende arbeidsmiljø med mange muligheter. Gjennom ansatte med ulik kompetanse og bakgrunn kan vi sammen skape en attraktiv og fleksibel organisasjon, tilrettelagt for utvikling og endring.    Liker du å få folk til å lykkes – og vil lede et team som skaper fantastiske kundeopplevelser?   Hos oss i Kundesenter Personmarked (PM) er målet enkelt: 100 % gode kundeopplevelser i hvert møte og hver samtale. Nå ser vi etter en avdelingsleder som gleder seg til å lede dyktige rådgivere – og som selv trigges av høyt tempo, endring og resultater.   Hva går jobben ut på?   Som  avdelingsleder  i Kundesenter Innlandet blir du en synlig og tydelig leder. Du har ansvaret for at avdelingen leverer både topp kundeopplevelser og bankens mål – og at folka dine har det gøy på jobb. Det betyr at du:    Leder, utvikler og motiverer rådgiverteamet ditt i hverdagen  Følger opp resultater og skaper retning gjennom god kommunikasjon  Bidrar aktivt i ledergruppen og tenker helhetlig for hele lokasjonen  Driver endringsprosesser og tar initiativ til forbedringer  Har fokus på utvikling av både mennesker og kultur     Du blir en del av et engasjert lederteam som samarbeider tett og heier hverandre frem.   Hvem er du?   Vi tror du lykkes hos oss dersom du:    Har erfaring fra ledelse, coaching og kunderettet arbeid  Trives med ansvar for både resultater og mennesker  Har sterke kommunikasjonsevner og bygger tillit  Har relevant høyere utdanning – men lang, relevant erfaring kan kompensere  Har det lille ekstra engasjementet som smitter over på andre      Hvorfor DNB og Kundesenter PM?   Du blir en del av Norges største bank og et miljø i utvikling – med tydelig satsing på kundeopplevelser, digitalisering og kompetanse. Vi tilbyr solide utviklingsmuligheter, gode betingelser og en kultur der vi løfter frem folk.   Praktisk informasjon     Stillingssted: Gjøvik  Søknadsfrist: 5. oktober  Kontaktperson: Tone Mari Malterud-Lien, tlf. +47 466 31 412, e-post: tone.mari.malterud-lien@dnb.no      Hos oss skal du kunne være deg selv.   Vi er opptatt av å bygge team med ulik erfaring og perspektiver, fordi det gir bedre løsninger. Det viktigste for oss er hva du kan bidra med – ikke hvem du er på papiret.   I søknadsprosessen trenger du kun å laste opp din CV og svare kort på noen stillingsrelaterte spørsmål. Søknadsbrev er ikke et krav, men du kan selvfølgelig laste det opp som et vedlegg om du ønsker.    Vi gjennomfører bakgrunnssjekk

Vill du arbeta i ett bolag med höga ambitioner, stark tillväxt och marknadsledande produkter? Då kan rollen som Customer Success Manager vara rätt för dig. Nu söker vi en Customer Success Manager som vill hjälpa våra kunder att lyckas, utveckla långsiktiga partnerskap och bidra till vår fortsatta tillväxtresa.  Som Customer Success Manager ansvarar du för att hjälpa våra kunder att få maximalt värde av våra tjänster. Du driver onboarding av nya kunder, utvecklar långsiktiga kundrelationer och identifierar affärsmöjligheter inom din kundportfölj. På sikt kommer du även att bygga djup produktkunskap och fungera som ett stöd för kollegor inom exempelvis försäljning, Key Account Management och marknadsföring.   Dina ansvarsområden      Ansvara för onboarding av nya kunder   Bygga starka och långsiktiga kundrelationer   Arbeta proaktivt med kundnöjdhet och retention   Identifiera och driva upsell-möjligheter   Utbilda och vägleda kunder i våra produkter   Bidra med kundinsikter och produktfeedback internt      Vi söker dig som      Har några års erfarenhet inom Customer Success, Key Account Management eller liknande roll   Gärna har arbetat inom SaaS, finans eller abonnemangsbaserade affärsmodeller   Är van att förklara system och produkter för både kunder och kollegor   Har ett affärsdriv och kan visa goda resultat från tidigare roller   Arbetar strukturerat och datadrivet   Talar och skriver flytande svenska och engelska      Varför oss?    Vi erbjuder en roll med stort eget ansvar i ett bolag med höga ambitioner och stark tillväxt. Samtidigt värnar vi om en kultur där vi hjälper varandra, har högt i tak och tror på balans mellan prestation och välmående. Tjänsten är placerad på vårt kontor i centrala Stockholm med en hybrid arbetsmodell där vi arbetar från kontoret tre till fyra dagar i veckan. title: Renewals Manager
description: As a member of our growing Renewals team, you will be instrumental in defining, testing, and scaling a renewals model that balances high-volume scale with top-down positioning across the Japan market. Based in our Tokyo office, you will partner closely with customers and internal stakeholders such as Account Executives, Customer Success Managers, Finance, and Legal to ensure Asana customers are set up for continued success from their Asana investment. Your primary focus will be managing customer renewals to maximize retention, identify expansion opportunities, and drive a high degree of customer satisfaction. You will play a critical role in protecting and growing Asana's customer base by proactively managing renewal risk, demonstrating customer value, and driving timely contract execution.  This role is based in our Tokyo office with an office-centric hybrid schedule. The standard in-office days are Tuesday, Thursday and one additional day of choice, which may be determined by your team. Most Asanas have the option to work from home on the two other weekdays they are not in office. If you're interviewing for this role, your recruiter will share more about the in-office requirements.   What You’ll Achieve     Own, drive, and lead the renewals process for customers in the Japan market, in collaboration with the account team, to preserve and improve customer contracts and relationships.  Actively engage with key decision-makers to understand customer requirements, demonstrate the value of Asana, and uncover roadblocks to ensure on-time renewals.  Negotiate and execute renewal contracts that align with customer goals in partnership with Finance and Legal.  Engage with at-risk customers and develop prescriptive strategies to mitigate potential churn and improve retention.  Communicate renewal risk clearly, take the lead in developing resolution strategies, and escalate wherever appropriate.  Discover and identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities during the renewal process to maximize customer growth.  Maintain and report an accurate 90–120-day rolling forecast of renewals and proactively manage risks and opportunities within the forecast.  Track and contribute to key business outcomes, including Renewal Rate, Net Retention Rate (NRR), renewal attainment, and expansion.  Maintain accurate customer and renewal information in Salesforce and other relevant systems.  Assist with enhancing and improving systems, tools, and processes to increase team efficiency and scalability.     About You     Demonstrates curiosity about AI tools and emerging technologies, with a willingness to learn and leverage them to enhance productivity, collaboration, or decision-making.  Business-level fluency in Japanese and English.   2–5 years of experience in customer-facing SaaS roles, such as software/subscription renewals, account management, sales, customer success, or Deal Desk, with experience managing commercial conversations and customer relationships.

title: Responsable Customer Success & Communauté (H/F)
description: Rattachement :  Julien, l’un des fondateurs. Tu travailles en autonomie complète sur ton périmètre, en lien direct avec l'équipe produit. Pas de middle management, tu es responsable de tes livrables et tu rends compte directement aux fondateurs.   Interfaces principales :  Tu travailles en lien direct avec les équipes Produit, Tech, Marketing et Sales.   Ton rôle :  Tu es la voix de nos utilisateurs. Chez Liberty Rider, le service client n'est pas un centre de coûts : c'est le lien direct entre 2 millions de motards et l'équipe qui construit l'app. Notre réputation de bienveillance et de réactivité s'est bâtie là-dessus, et c'est toi qui la portes.   Tes Missions   Ton poste s'articule autour de deux moitiés qui se nourrissent l'une de l'autre : garantir une expérience sans friction sur l'app, et faire grandir la Tribu.   Service client & qualité produit (~60 %) :     Tu pilotes notre agent IA de première ligne : tu entraînes ses réponses, tu analyses ce qu'il ne résout pas, tu fais monter le taux de résolution automatique et le NPS.  Tu prends en main les cas que l'IA ne peut pas traiter — les situations sensibles, les motards qui viennent de chuter, les demandes complexes — avec la précision et l'humanité qu'ils méritent.  Tu fais vivre le centre d'aide : nouveaux contenus, mise à jour à chaque release, base de connaissance de l'IA.  Tu testes chaque version de l'app avant sa mise en production, tu qualifies les bugs remontés par les utilisateurs et tu participes aux sprints de l'équipe tech.  Tu optimises les process, outils et automatisations pour que le temps passé sur le traitement diminue, et que le temps passé avec les utilisateurs augmente.     Communauté & projets fédérateurs (~40 %) :     Tu conçois et pilotes des projets qui rassemblent la Tribu : programme de bêta-testeurs, ambassadeurs, challenges, contenus co-créés avec les motards.  Tu vas à leur rencontre : salons, rassemblements, sorties moto, événements que tu organises ou auxquels tu représentes Liberty Rider.  Tu fais remonter ce que les motards vivent, demandent et proposent — de façon structurée, chiffrée — vers le produit, la tech et le marketing.  Tu participes aux réunions marketing pour apporter des idées d'animation, de fidélisation et de prise de parole nourries par ta connaissance du terrain.     POURQUOI NOUS REJOINDRE ?   Une mission qui a du sens : Chez Liberty Rider, ton travail a un impact concret : contribuer à sauver des vies et améliorer la sécurité des motards.   Un rôle clé et autonome   Directement rattaché·e à Julien, co-fondateur, tu portes la relation utilisateurs de bout en bout : satisfaction, rétention et animation de la communauté des ambassadeurs.   Une communauté engagée à faire grandir   Tu prends la main sur le programme Ambassadeurs : recruter, animer, faire vivre un réseau de motards qui portent la marque bien au-delà de l'application.   Un environnement agile et responsabilisant   Équipe à taille humaine, circuits courts, capacité

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Overview   Keysight is at the forefront of technology innovation, delivering breakthroughs and trusted insights in electronic design, simulation, prototyping, test, manufacturing, and optimization. Our ~16,800 employees create world-class solutions in communications, 5G, automotive, energy, quantum, aerospace, defense, and semiconductor markets for customers in over 100 countries. Partner with Support, Professional Services, Product Management, and Engineering to coordinate issue resolution, feature requests, and customer escalations. title: Go to market-manager
description: Om rollen   Vi söker en Go to market-manager som vill vara med och utveckla hur vi skapar värde för våra kunder genom vår plattform.     Det här är en bred och hands-on roll i skärningspunkten mellan produkt, kundutveckling och operations. Du kommer att arbeta nära den svenska verksamheten och våra kunder för att identifiera nya tillväxtmöjligheter, förstå verksamhetens behov och säkerställa att vår produkt och våra arbetssätt utvecklas i rätt riktning.     Du kommer också att fungera som en viktig länk mellan den svenska organisationen och våra produkt- och utvecklingsteam. Det innebär att du behöver kunna gå från ett kommersiellt eller operationellt problem till analys, hypotes och tydlig kravställning – och därefter driva arbetet hela vägen till implementering och uppföljning.     Rollen passar dig som trivs i en snabbrörlig miljö där alla svar inte finns från början. Du kombinerar strategisk och analytisk höjd med ett starkt driv och ägandeskap för att få saker att hända.      Ditt ansvar   I rollen kommer du bland annat att:       Utveckla våra kunder genom plattformen.  Arbeta tillsammans med den kommersiella organisationen för att identifiera hur produktfunktionalitet och nya arbetssätt kan öka kundernas användning, effektivitet och värde av plattformen.   Vara länken mellan verksamhet och produkt/tech.  Fånga upp och prioritera behov från kunder och den svenska verksamheten, omsätta dem till business cases och prioriteringar för den svenska marknaden.   Leda lansering och implementation av nya funktioner.  Ansvara för den svenska utrullningen av nya produkter och funktioner – från planering och stakeholder alignment till lansering, implementering och uppföljning.   Driva initiativ från idé till resultat.  Projektleda initiativ tillsammans med Account Management och Sales och säkerställa att de omsätts till faktisk nyttja för verksamheten.   Arbeta datadrivet.  Analysera resultat, utfall och användardata, formulera hypoteser, definiera relevanta KPI:er och använda resultaten för att prioritera och utveckla våra initiativ.   Kommunicera rekommendationer och skapa alignment.  Strukturera komplexa frågeställningar och presentera tydliga rekommendationer, business cases och beslutsunderlag för såväl interna stakeholders som kunder.       Vem vi söker   Vi tror att du har:      4–6+ års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet, exempelvis från management consulting, Strategy & Operations, Business Operations, Commercial Operations inom tech eller en liknande roll.  Erfarenhet av att leda strategiska, kommersiella eller operationella projekt och av att driva initiativ från analys och idé till implementering.  Stark analytisk problemlösningsförmåga och vana att arbeta datadrivet.  Erfarenhet av att arbeta tvärfunktionellt, gärna nära både kommersiella team och produkt-/utvecklingsorganisationer.  Förmåga att ta fram och presentera tydliga beslutsunderlag och rekommendationer.  Erfarenhet från en snabbväxande eller snabbrörlig organisation.  Relevant

title: Manager:in Customer Success // Customer Support (German Speaking)
description: Nur Vollzeit möglich – Standort Wien (AT)     Unterstütze uns als Customer Sucess Manager:in in Wien!    Standort: Wien (AT) | Gehalt: Ab EUR € 3.155,- Brutto/Monat (KV), Überzahlung möglich     Warum du?    Du brennst für innovative Technologie und dafür, sie für andere Menschen zugänglich(er) zu machen? Wir suchen eine kommunikationsstarke und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die den Umgang mit Menschen liebt und die Digitalisierung der Bauindustrie durch unsere Software aktiv mitgestalten möchte.    Wer sind wir?    Die Idee für reebuild entstand direkt auf der Baustelle: Bauleiter:innen verbringen zum Teil mehrere Stunden täglich mit Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Rechnungsprüfung, Bestellabgleich oder dem Erstellen von Aufmaßblättern – und diese Stunden fließen dann nicht mehr in die Bauprojekte, auf die es eigentlich ankommt.   Das wollten wir ändern, und haben daher eine KI entwickelt, die den administrativen Aufwand für Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen um bis zu 75 % reduziert.   Da es jedoch nur mit einem motivierten Team möglich ist, unsere Software ständig weiter zu optimieren, sind wir aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen ambitionierten Kolleg:innen.  Aufgaben   Deine Aufgaben    Als Manager:in in der Kund:innenbetreuung bei reebuild bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere B2B-Kund:innen (Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen) und fungierst gleichzeitig als Schnittstelle für das gesamte Customer-Success-Team. Deine Mission: Sicherzustellen, dass unsere Kund:innen unsere Plattform optimal verstehen und ihr Feedback so dokumentiert wird, dass wir es zur Optimierung unserer Software ideal verwenden können. So spielst du eine Schlüsselrolle bei der Begleitung unserer Kund:innen und bist gleichzeitig stellvertretend für sie dabei, wenn es darum geht, neuen Features den letzten Feinschliff zu verpassen und das perfekte Produkt zu entwickeln.   Dein Aufgabenbereich gliedert sich daher in zwei Bereiche:    1. Software-Support:  Unterstützung unserer Kund:innen bei der Anwendung unserer Software mithilfe von E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall sowie schnelle und kompetente Hilfestellung bei ihren Herausforderungen. Deine Offenheit, Spontanität und Lösungsorientierung sind dabei essenziell.    2. Produktentwicklung:  Strukturierte Dokumentation von Kund:innenanfragen und Weiterleitung von wertvollen Verbesserungsvorschlägen direkt an unser Produkt- und Entwicklungsteam.  Qualifikation   Dein Profil:    Eine oder mehrere dieser Punkte treffen auf dich zu:      Du besitzt 1-2 Jahre Erfahrung in der Kundenbetreuung  – Idealerweise hast du schon einmal im Customer Support oder Customer Success in der Software-Branche gearbeitet    Du bist neugierig  und willst verstehen, wie Dinge funktionieren    Du besitzt Kenntnisse der Bauwirtschaft  – z. B. durch Erfahrung in der kaufmännischen Bauabwicklung, im technischen Innendienst oder im Bereich Architektur    Du hast eine Affinität zu Software und digitalen Lösungen  und findest dich in neuen

title: Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager
description: Join Telavox as a Service Operations Support Manager 🌎   We are looking for a talented and driven Service Operations Center (SOC) Manager to join our team. This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys technical problem-solving, leadership, and providing top-notch customer support in the telecom and UCaaS industry. If you're excited about leading a support team solving complex technical challenges and contributing to a fast-growing, innovative company, we’d love to hear from you!   About The Job   As a Service Operations Center Manager at Telavox, you will be responsible for leading a team that provides second-level technical support to our operator clients. The team is based in Malmö, but our clients are around the world. You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure customers have a seamless experience with our software products and services.   A Typical Day In This Role Involves     Team leadership and coordination: Managing and guiding a team of support engineers, ensuring high-quality service delivery through various channels like tickets, phone, email, and chat.  On-call duty management: Organizing and overseeing the team’s on-call schedule, ensuring proper coverage during after-hours support. Except for leading a team of Tech Support Engineers, the team includes an Incident Manager responsible for incident management and its ways of working.  Technical issue resolution: Diagnosing, troubleshooting, and resolving escalated issues while maintaining a customer-focused mindset.  Stakeholder & Service Provider collaboration: Build strong relationships across support, product, customer operations, and larger Service Providers to resolve issues, improve processes, and turn feedback into action.  Reporting: Maintaining, improving, and automating our customer reporting on SLA and Service Operations status.  SLA management: Monitoring team performance to ensure service-level agreements (SLAs) are met, escalating incidents as needed, and continuously improving the support process.    This role is based in our Malmö office, where you’ll join a collaborative and innovative work environment and have opportunities to lead and influence our growing global support operations.   About You   We’re looking for a leader with a minimum of 3-5 years of leadership experience in technical support or customer service, ideally within the software or telecom industry. You thrive in a leadership role, have a strong grasp of technical troubleshooting, and are dedicated to delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. You thrive at fostering team spirit and building a positive, collaborative culture that motivates your team to perform at their best.   Competencies     Experience in a technical support role, with at least 3-5 years of team leadership experience.  Experience managing on-call rotations and ensuring 24/7 coverage, including leading incident management operations.  Strong problem-solving skills and a customer-focused mindse

Define human escalation policies for high-risk situations, repeated AI failures, and explicit requests for human assistance.  Partner with Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI teams to resolve issues and communicate customer feedback.  Collaborate on AI support acceptance criteria, rollout readiness, and post-launch monitoring.  Help define the long-term strategy for a scalable, technology-enabled global customer support organization. description: Sales Manager, Travel Retail & FMCG       Haluatko ottaa kaupallisen vastuun kansainvälisistä brändeistä ja kehittää Travel Retail -liiketoimintaa suomalaisessa perheyrityksessä? Norex Selected Brands etsii kasvavaan organisaatioonsa kaupallista osaajaa, joka haluaa kasvattaa asiakkuuksia, avata uusia ovia ja rakentaa liiketoimintaa yhdessä kansainvälisten päämiesten kanssa.      Norex Selected Brands Oy on vuonna 1981 perustettu suomalainen perheyritys ja yksi Suomen suurimmista viinien ja väkevien alkoholijuomien maahantuojista. Tuomme Suomeen laadukkaita juomia yli 20 maasta ja kehitämme kansainvälisten päämiestemme brändejä pitkäjänteisesti Suomen markkinoilla.     Toimimme laajasti Alko-, HoReCa-, tukku-, Travel Retail ja päivittäistavarakauppa-kanavissa. Yhdistämme vahvan markkinatuntemuksen, kaupallisen kehittämisen ja käytännönläheisen tekemisen rakentaaksemme asiakkaillemme ja päämiehillemme kannattavaa kasvua. Perheyrittäjyys, ketteryys ja pitkäaikaiset kumppanuudet ovat toimintamme ytimessä. Lue meistä lisää tästä.     Norex kasvaa ja kehittää liiketoimintaansa aktiivisesti myös nykyisten tuotekategorioidensa ulkopuolelle. Etsimme nyt joukkoomme uutta  Sales Manageria , jonka selkeä kaupallinen vastuu heti tehtävän alusta lähtien on Travel Retail / Duty Free -liiketoimintamme. Samalla hän tuo Norexille uutta FMCG- ja juomakategorioiden osaamista, joka auttaa meitä rakentamaan tulevaisuuden kasvua ja avaamaan uusia liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia.      Mitä tehtävässä pääset tekemään?      Sales Managerina vastaat Travel Retail / Duty Free -asiakkuuksiemme kehittämisestä ja kasvatat liiketoimintaa sekä nykyisten että uusien asiakkaiden kanssa. Työskentelet itsenäisesti asiakkaiden, kansainvälisten päämiesten sekä Norexin oman myynti- ja tuotepäällikköorganisaation kanssa.      Tehtävässäsi:    vastaat nykyisistä Travel Retail / Duty Free -asiakkuuksista ja niiden kaupallisesta kehittämisestä  etsit aktiivisesti uusia asiakkaita ja liiketoimintamahdollisuuksia  käyt sopimus-, hinta-, tarjous- ja valikoimaneuvotteluja  suunnittelet, seuraat ja ennustat asiakaskohtaista myyntiä  hoidat ja kehität suhteita kansainvälisiin päämiehiin ja yhteistyökumppaneihin  rakennat yhdessä tuotepäälliköidemme kanssa asiakkaille kilpailukykyisiä valikoima- ja tarjouskokonaisuuksia  osallistut kansainvälisiin Travel Retail -tapahtumiin ja messuille  voit kokemuksesi ja kiinnostuksesi mukaan osallistua myös HoReCa- ja muun B2B-myynnin kehittämiseen.      Roolin tarkkaa sisältöä ja vastuualueiden painotuksia voidaan rakentaa myös kokemuksesi ja vahvuuksiesi ympärille.      Mitä odotamme sinulta?      Etsimme ennen kaikkea kaupallista tekijää, jolla on kokemusta FMCG-liiketoiminnasta ja näyttöä itsenäisestä asiakasvastuusta. Taustasi voi olla esimerkiksi juoma-, panimo-, virvoitusjuoma- tai muulta nopeasti kiertävien kuluttajatuotteiden alalta. title: Customer Success Specialist (Turku)
description: Haluatko kehittyä asiakaskohtaamisten ja myynnin huippuosaajaksi? Sytytkö tavoitteista ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi jatkuvasti eteenpäin? Motivoiko sinua työ, jossa onnistumisesi näkyvät suoraan sekä asiakkaan arjessa että omassa tuloksessasi?    Etsimme nyt useampaa uutta Customer Success Specialistia Turkuun!   Customer Success Specialistina olet keskeisessä roolissa luomassa sujuvaa ja positiivista asiakaskokemusta. Työskentelet osana uutta tiimiä, jolla on tärkeä tehtävä Elisan asiakaskokemuksen kehittämisessä ja jossa jokaisen panoksella on aidosti merkitystä. Tehtävän keskiössä on asiakkaiden tarpeiden tunnistaminen sekä niihin sopivien, räätälöityjen ratkaisujen tarjoaminen Elisan palveluiden ja tuotteiden avulla. Tavoitteenasi on auttaa asiakasta saamaan enemmän kuin hän odotti ja tuottaa lisäarvoa sekä asiakkaalle että Elisalle.  Työ on pääasiassa puhelimitse tapahtuvaa asiakastyötä: vastaat asiakkaiden yhteydenottoihin ja kontaktoit asiakkaita myös aktiivisesti myynnillisten ulossoittojen muodossa. Aktiivinen myyntityö on keskeinen osa tehtävääsi, jossa onnistuminen perustuu asiakkaan tarpeiden ymmärtämiseen ja kykyyn viedä tilanne sujuvasti ratkaisuun. Työ on tavoitteellista ja suoriutumista seurataan selkeiden mittareiden kautta, jotka ohjaavat tekemistä ja tekevät onnistumisen näkyväksi.  Tässä tehtävässä jokainen päivä on erilainen tuoden mukanaan mahdollisuuksia uuden oppimiseen ja ongelmanratkaisutaitojesi kehittämiseen. Viihdyt tehtävässä, jos nautit vaihtelevasta tekemisestä, pidät langat käsissäsi vauhdikkaassakin arjessa ja haluat kehittää osaamistasi asiakaspalvelun ja myynnin parissa!   Entä työajat ja palkka?    Etsimme useampaa uutta työkaveria  toistaiseksi voimassa olevaan kokoaikaiseen (37,5 h/vko) työsuhteeseen. Toivomme, että pystyt aloittamaan työt perehdytyksen merkeissä 2.11.2026.   🕙 Työskentelemme vuoroissa ma-pe klo 08:45-18:15 välillä ja odotamme sinulta valmiutta työskennellä näissä vuoroissa.  📍Työskentelypisteesi sijaitsee  Turun   toimistollamme.  Työsuhteen alussa työskentelemme toimistolla sujuvan perehdytyksen varmistamiseksi. Osaamisen karttuessa sinulla on myös mahdollisuus tehdä töitä etänä yhteisiä pelisääntöjä noudattaen. Elisalla on käytössä hybridityön malli, jonka mukaan työskentelemme toimistolla keskimäärin kolmena päivänä viikossa.   💰Tehtävässä varmistat osaltasi asiakaspalvelumme myynnillistä onnistumista, ja me myös palkitsemme sinua onnistumisista ja itsesi ylittämisestä!  Pohjapalkkasi määräytyy ICT-alan TES:n mukaan (2357   €/kk), minkä lisäksi tarjoamme houkuttelevan kannustemallin, jossa ansaintamahdollisuudet ovat aidosti omissa käsissäsi. Lisäansiot vaihtelevat tyypillisesti muutamista sadoista aina useisiin tuhansiin euroihin kuukaudessa!    Mitä toivomme sinulta?   Me uskomme, että asiakaskohtaamisten ammattilaiseksi kasvetaan oppien ja kokemuksen kautta. Emme siis odota sinun olevan valmis ammattilainen – innostus ja motivaatio vievät pitkälle! Arki on ajoittain nopeatempoist

title: Delivery Specialist / Senior Delivery Specialist
description: About The Role   As a Delivery Specialist at Avarda, you will play a key role in delivering successful payment solutions to our merchants across the Nordics and supporting their growth journey toward new markets. You will own and drive merchant implementations from planning to successful go-live, acting as the bridge between our merchants and internal teams across Product, IT, Development, Operations, and Commercial.  The role combines project management, implementation consulting, technical integration coordination, and service management. You will work primarily with mid-sized online retailers, while also supporting some of our most important strategic merchants after launch — helping them integrate Avarda's solutions, optimize their payment experience, and ensure long-term success. You will manage multiple implementation projects simultaneously alongside these ongoing relationships - ideal for someone who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex challenges, and working in a fast-paced fintech environment where you can make a direct impact.    Key Responsibilities      Lead end-to-end merchant onboarding and implementation projects, typically running over several months  Manage multiple merchant implementations simultaneously while maintaining high quality, transparency, and delivery predictability  Act as the main delivery partner for merchants, ensuring excellent communication and a smooth implementation experience  Coordinate collaboration between merchants and internal teams, including Product, IT, Development, Operations, Commercial, and other stakeholders  Support technical implementation activities, including API integrations, troubleshooting, testing, and release coordination  Translate merchant business requirements into actionable tasks for technical and operational teams  Proactively manage delivery risks, dependencies, and blockers to ensure successful and timely delivery  Ensure a smooth transition from implementation to ongoing service management, then support strategic merchants with continuous improvements that sustain high satisfaction and strong partnerships  Contribute to improving implementation processes, tools, documentation, and ways of working, sharing insights from merchant interactions to support product and operational development     We are hiring at both the Delivery Specialist and Senior Delivery Specialist level.  The core role is the same — we set the level, scope, and mentoring responsibilities based on your experience, so we encourage you to apply whether you are building your delivery career or bringing a track record of leading complex implementations.  At the Senior level, you will also  take the lead on our most strategic and complex merchant implementations, act as a point of escalation for delivery challenges, and help mentor colleagues and shape how the team works.   Qualifications And Experience     Must-haves      2+ years (Delivery Specialist) or 5+ years (Senior Delivery Specialist) of experience

title: Startup Account Manager

title: Generalist:in Customer Success // Customer Support (German Speaking)
description: Teilzeit und Vollzeit möglich – Standort Wien (AT)     Werde als Junior Customer Success Generalist:in Teil unseres revolutionierenden Teams!    Standort: Wien (AT) | Gehalt: Ab EUR 2.236,- Brutto/Monat (KV), Überzahlung möglich     Warum du?    Du bist neugierig, geduldig und hilfsbereit – mit einer echten „Deine Probleme sind auch meine"-Mentalität. Du besitzt Empathie und kannst Probleme nicht nur nachvollziehen, sondern denkst konsequent in Lösungen. Du interessierst dich ehrlich für die Herausforderungen unserer Kund:innen und sprichst ihre Sprache. Und wenn's drauf ankommt, beißt du dich durch – mit Charme. 😉    Wer sind wir?    Die Idee für reebuild entstand direkt auf der Baustelle: Bauleiter:innen verbringen zum Teil mehrere Stunden täglich mit Verwaltungsaufgaben wie Rechnungsprüfung, Bestellabgleich oder dem Erstellen von Aufmaßblättern – und diese Stunden fließen dann nicht mehr in die Bauprojekte, auf die es eigentlich ankommt.   Das wollten wir ändern, und haben daher eine KI entwickelt, die den administrativen Aufwand für Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen um bis zu 75 % reduziert.   Da es jedoch nur mit einem motivierten Team möglich ist, unsere Software ständig weiter zu optimieren, sind wir aktuell auf der Suche nach neuen ambitionierten Kolleg:innen.  Aufgaben   Deine Aufgaben:    Als Junior Customer Success Generalist:in bei reebuild bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für unsere B2B-Kund:innen – Bauunternehmen und Projektentwickler:innen. Deine Mission: Sicherstellen, dass unsere KI-gestützte Software optimal genutzt wird und Fragen schnell, kompetent und nachhaltig gelöst werden. Du begleitest unsere Kund:innen vom Erstkontakt bis zur vollumfänglichen Nutzung unserer Plattform, und erklärst Abläufe geduldig bis zum letzten Klick.      Software-Support (Help-Desk):  Du unterstützt unsere Kund:innen per E-Mail, Telefon und Videocall bei der Anwendung unserer Software und reagierst auf ihre Anforderungen direkt und lösungsorientiert.    Wissensmanagement:  Du vermittelst Kund:innen das nötige Wissen, um souverän mit unserem Tool umzugehen – von der Einführung bis zur eigenständigen Nutzung.    Produktfeedback:  Du hörst genau hin, erkennst Muster in den Rückmeldungen deiner Kund:innen und gibst dieses Feedback direkt an die Produktentwicklung weiter.    Überblick behalten:  Auch wenn es mal stressig wird, weißt du, welche Herausforderungen gerade bei deinen Kund:innen liegen – und priorisierst richtig.    Du bringst eigene Ideen ein:  Du arbeitest gründlich und weißt genau, wenn du bei deinen Kolleg:innen Informationen einholen musst, hältst dich aber auch nicht zurück, wenn es um das Einbringen eigener Ideen geht.    Qualifikation   Dein Profil:    Eine oder mehrere dieser Punkte treffen auf dich zu:      Du besitzt ein Gespür oder bereits erste gute Erfahrungen mit der Kundenbetreuung  – Idealerweise hast du schon einmal im Customer Support oder Customer Success gearbeitet    Du bist neugierig  und willst verstehen
