title: Lead Account Management
description: Riyadh Air (RX), headquartered in the Saudi Capital, is the new national airline that’s shaping the future of flying. It seeks to lead the aviation industry by transforming Saudi Arabia into a global aviation and trade hub – a digitally native airline that will connect the kingdom to more than 100 destinations.   About The Role   Are you ready to grow high-value agency partnerships and make us the first choice across the Central Province travel trade market?  This role is central to developing an assigned portfolio of travel management companies, online travel agencies, and travel agencies across the Central Province. It combines field-based relationship management with responsive day-to-day commercial support that drives loyalty, conversion, and revenue.  A core part of the role is owning your agency portfolio through structured visit plans, production targets, and regular performance reviews. Success depends on building strong relationships that strengthen account performance and uncover new sources of volume.  Working closely with agency partners, the role focuses on supporting daily requests related to bookings, waivers within policy, servicing escalations, and New Distribution Capability (NDC) content issues. You will also manage group demand from quotation and negotiation through to follow-up and materialization.  With responsibility for commercial growth, this position supports the development of labor movement and leisure segments within the portfolio. It also includes delivering product, network, and systems training, while representing us at roadshows and trade events.  You can expect to track production against incentive and campaign targets, build recovery plans for underperforming accounts, and provide weekly reporting on visits, pipeline activity, competitor movements, and issues requiring escalation.  This is your chance to build powerful trade partnerships, unlock commercial growth, and help shape how travelers across the Central Province connect with us.   About You   Degree qualified, you will demonstrate a minimum of 5 years of sales experience with an airline or travel agency, including direct agency account management.  You will bring strong knowledge of fares, ticketing, group handling, and NDC, along with established relationships in the Central Province agency market, commercial numeracy, consultative selling skills, and the ability to manage a field-based account portfolio with pace, resilience, and professionalism.  This is your opportunity to shape the future of air travel. Bring your best and show us why you can own this position within Riyadh Air.  Please submit your application by clicking on the Apply button. Our Talent Acquisition team will be reviewing applications shortly.

title: APAC Account Operations Director - Penang
description: About The Role   As a CBRE Account Management Director, you will assist with the oversight of the department responsible for delivering all client commitments.  This is part of the Operations Management job functions. They are responsible for coordinating staff functions and operations that support the organization’s goals and strategies.   What You’ll Do     Provide formal supervision to employees. Monitor the training and development of staff. Conduct performance evaluations and coaching. Oversee the recruiting and hiring of new employees.  Coordinate and manage the team's daily activities. Establish work schedules, assign tasks, and cross-train staff. Set and track staff and department deadlines. Mentor and coach as needed.  Interact and consult with clients to understand business needs. Coordinate the resources needed to service projects, build strategic operational plans, and balance the expectations of clients with the execution of work.  Manage several clients simultaneously, while serving as a point of contact for systems and processes for new and current projects.  Oversee the management of sales and relationships with key customers. Ensure proper services and enhancements are being carried out. Troubleshoot and solve conflicts.  Direct the project process. This includes developing project plans, creating a project team, and managing timeframes and performance.  Verify the timely and successful delivery of solutions according to client needs and objectives as well as contract specifics.  Consult with internal and client teams to define project requirements, investigating various approaches to attain end results.  Apply a robust knowledge of multiple disciplines, the business, and key drivers which impact departmental and cross-functional performance.  Lead by example and model behaviors that are consistent with CBRE RISE values. Persuade managers and other colleagues to take action while being guided by the organization's functional business plans. Negotiate with external partners, vendors, and customers of divergent interests to reach a common goal.  Identify and solve multi-dimensional, complex, operational, and organizational problems leveraging the appropriate resources within or outside the department.  Significantly improves and changes existing methods, processes, and standards within job discipline.     What You’ll Need     Bachelor's Degree preferred with 8-12 years of relevant experience. In lieu of a degree, a combination of experience and education will be considered.  Experience in the areas of staffing, selection, training, development, coaching, mentoring, measuring, appraising, and rewarding performance and retention is preferred.  Ability to lead the exchange of sensitive, complicated, and difficult information, convey performance expectations, and handle problems.

title: Directeur de la relation clients - Éditeur de logiciels (Femme/Homme)
description: Description De L'entreprise   Candidate First recrute pour une entreprise technologique en croissance, basée à Lyon, qui conçoit et déploie des solutions et services à forte dimension métier.  Dans un contexte de transformation de son organisation et d’évolution de ses pratiques, l’entreprise souhaite renforcer son pilotage de la relation client et recrute son futur  Directeur de la relation client (Femme/Homme).    Description Du Poste   Rattaché directement à la Direction Générale, vous prenez la responsabilité d'un périmètre stratégique regroupant plusieurs dizaines de collaborateurs et managers.  Vous pilotez l'ensemble du parcours client à partir de la phase de déploiement et supervisez les différentes composantes du delivery : gestion de projets clients, onboarding, formation des utilisateurs et support métier ou technique.  Votre principal enjeu consiste à  faire évoluer en profondeur l'organisation de la relation client et les pratiques de delivery , dans un contexte marqué par le développement de nouvelles offres et la transformation des attentes clients.   À Ce Titre, Vous     repensez l'organisation de la relation client et les différents parcours clients ;  faites évoluer les processus et les modes de fonctionnement afin d'améliorer la qualité et l'efficacité du delivery ;  pilotez la transformation des activités de support, notamment à travers l'évolution des outils et l'intégration de nouveaux usages liés à l'intelligence artificielle ;  accompagnez les managers et les équipes dans la transformation de leurs pratiques ;  structurez le pilotage de la performance et de la qualité de service ;  entretenez une relation directe avec les clients et intervenez régulièrement dans les rendez-vous à enjeux ;  travaillez étroitement avec la Direction Générale et les différentes fonctions de l'entreprise afin d'assurer la cohérence du parcours client. Vous avez déjà conduit une transformation opérationnelle significative : évolution d'organisation, refonte de processus, transformation d'un service client ou évolution d'un modèle de delivery.  Vous savez conjuguer vision stratégique, management et capacité à intervenir concrètement auprès des équipes et des clients. Nous recherchons un profil disposant d'une expérience opérationnelle forte et directement confronté aux enjeux de delivery et de relation client. title: Head of Customer Success
description: Head of Customer Success — Coaching en ligne (perte de poids)    Remote · Temps plein · Francophone · Freelance       Le business en deux minutes   Nous opérons un programme de coaching en ligne dédié à la perte de poids pour femme, porté par une figure connue de son audience sur les réseaux (+2M Followers).  Un accompagnement de 3 mois construit sur trois piliers : sport, nutrition et mindset   Le nom de la marque est communiqué lors du premier échange.      Quelques repères :   Plus de 2 000 femmes accompagnées depuis le lancement  Environ 240 clientes actives en permanence  Environ 70 nouvelles clientes par mois  Une équipe structurée : coachs, setting, closing, COO, CTO  Une croissance continue      Ce n'est pas un projet lancé il y a six mois. C'est une structure qui tourne, qui délivre depuis +2 ans, et qui a maintenant besoin de quelqu'un pour faire progresser la partie post-vente.      Pourquoi ce poste existe   Aujourd'hui, toute notre équipe travaille sur ce qui se passe  avant  la vente : générer des leads, remplir les agendas, closer. Ça fonctionne.  Ce qui se passe  après  la vente n'appartient à personne. Nos clientes sont bien accompagnées, mais personne ne pilote la satisfaction, personne n'optimise le renouvellement, personne n'exploite notre base de +2 000 anciennes clientes, personne ne construit de programme de parrainage.  Ce sont des axes totalement inexploités.      Ce que tu piloteras    Le renouvellement.  Environ 17 % de nos clientes prolongent leur accompagnement à la fin des 3 mois. Tu es responsable de faire progresser ce chiffre : proposition, timing, argumentaire, price point, homogénéité entre les coachs.   La croissance par la base clientes.  Parrainage, affiliation, réactivation des anciennes clientes. Tout ce chiffre est aujourd'hui à zéro parce que rien n'existe. Tu construis, tu testes, tu pilotes.   Les remboursements.  Tu traites chaque demande, tu décides, et surtout tu fais baisser le nombre de clientes qui en arrivent là. Ça passe par comprendre les causes racines et corriger en amont.   La preuve client.  Avant/après exploitables, témoignages, satisfaction mesurée, avis publics. Notre matériel de preuve est aujourd'hui produit de façon artisanale et largement inexploitable en marketing. En 8 años ya somos unos 50 empleados y facturamos €8M anuales en ventas de software a empresas del automóvil tanto en Europa como Latinoamérica y quién sabe donde más...     Pero eso no es lo importante.     Lo importante es cómo trabajamos.     En Walcu:   Somos un equipo joven (sí, la media está por debajo de los 30), con mucha energía y pocas ganas de hacer las cosas a medias.  Nos tomamos el trabajo en serio, pero no a nosotros mismos  Decimos las cosas como son (aunque incomode)  Valoramos el criterio por encima de seguir procesos  Y creemos que el impacto real está en hacer que otros mejoren, no en hacer el trabajo por ellos   No somos para todo el mundo. Y eso está bien.      Sobre ti:       Eres francés/a (o tienes el francés como idioma nativo) y puedes trabajar en español. Estás en Madrid o te vienes.  Entiendes rápido cómo funcionan los negocios y las personas  Sabes comunicar con claridad, precisión y criterio  No evitas las conversaciones difíciles  Detectas problemas antes de que sean un problema  Y tienes el impulso natural de mejorar lo que tocas      Vamos, eres la repanocha.      ¿Cómo será tu día a día como Customer Coach?   Sí, hemos retirado el término Customer Success y lo hemos rebrandeado como Customer Coach porque el verdadero éxito no consiste en ayudar a los clientes a hacer el trabajo. Se trata de ayudarles a aprender a hacer el trabajo. No hacemos el trabajo para los clientes.  Enseñamos a los clientes a hacer el trabajo por sí mismos.      Qué harás (de verdad):      Serás responsable de que tus clientes del mercado francés usen Walcu bien y obtengan resultados reales.      Construirás relaciones de confianza (de las que permiten decir cosas incómodas)  Liderararás cuentas y ser el punto de referencia del cliente  Entrenarás, retarás y acompañarás al cliente para que saque el máximo partido a Walcu y lo integre en su operativa real.  Entenderás su negocio, sus objetivos y sus retos para convertir la herramienta en impacto tangible.  Identificarás oportunidades de evolución en la cuenta, proponiendo ampliaciones que generen impacto real. Para nosotros el éxito no es vender más licencias, sino que el cliente sienta Walcu como su propio CRM.  Monitorizarás la salud de la relación (uso, engagement, riesgo de churn) y actuarás antes de que haya problemas.  Trasladarás al equipo de Producto feedback accionable y defenderás la voz del cliente dentro de Walcu.       Condiciones laborales:    Contrato a jornada completa e indefinido –queremos a alguien para siempre ❤–.  Presencial 100% los cuatro primeros meses (para que entiendas de verdad cómo funcionamos)  2 días de remoto después  Podrás elegir tu horario de entrada y salida –aunque siempre hay que cubrir

title: Renewals Manager
description: Role Overview  This role engages early and often with customers and partners, together with Renewals Specialists, often initiating and leading conversations to understand business needs, technology objectives, and long-term plans across multiple accounts and segments. It builds relationships with customers and channel partner teams to understand business priorities and objectives, ensuring alignment with the CX recurring revenue strategy. Throughout the renewal process, the position collaborates with the Renewals Specialist from opportunity identification to close, initiating engagement through a warm handoff from Sales and Customer Success, and confirming roles and responsibilities early to ensure a smooth transition, aligned activation strategy, and unified customer engagement. The role collaborates cross-functionally with field sales, inside sales, channel teams, delivery, operations, and customer success to provide a unified customer-facing solution, ensure on-time renewals, and identify expansion opportunities. It partners with sales on deal strategy and with customer success on adoption and sentiment to address competitive, adoption, and technology risks across the renewal portfolio, ensuring the appropriate expertise is involved to resolve complex scenarios. The role conducts proactive risk assessments to identify potential risks early in the renewal process, collaborating with relevant teams to develop and implement resolution strategies that ensure successful renewals and customer satisfaction. title: Lab Operations Manager
description:
About Substrate

Substrate is the critical infrastructure layer between AI and biology. AI for biology has a data problem, not a compute problem: biological foundation models can predict but cannot experiment, and the large-scale, high-quality data they need does not exist. We are building the lab that generates it, with quality and provenance built in. We are not a CRO and we are not a cloud lab.

The company was founded by Mostafa ElSayed, co-founder and CEO; Oli Hoy, who leads the lab buildout and operations; Alexey Morgunov, who leads science and intelligence software; and Anna Huyghues-Despointes, who leads partnerships and go-to-market.

The role

You will run the day-to-day operations of our lab in London, and be the person the scientists come to when something is missing, broken, late or lost. The day-one work is what you would expect: consumables and stock, goods in and cold chain, equipment servicing and calibration, suppliers and purchasing, waste streams and safety records.

Three parts go beyond a standard lab operations job. The first is provenance. Every experiment we sell carries a record of what went into it, down to the lot of the consumable used and the conditions material was held in. If a lot number is not captured, the data point is worth less, and that record runs through you.

The second is that the systems are not written yet. Inventory, goods in, asset registers and ordering exist in no form that will survive the next year. You define what the lab has to capture and work with the science and software teams to make sure it does.

title: Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Ads Bidding
description:
Staff Machine Learning Engineer – Ads Bidding

The Team

The Ads ML team builds and maintains the machine learning models powering Deliveroo's advertising product — connecting consumers with relevant ads and helping merchants, grocers, and FMCG brands grow through the platform. The UK team is ~11 MLEs across ads and promotions, and collaborates closely with the US team (meetings capped at 4pm UK to protect reasonable hours).

The Problem

Deliveroo is migrating ads from cost-per-click (CPC) to cost-per-order (CPO) — merchants pay when an ad drives an order, not when it's clicked. This is a genuinely open, cutting-edge problem: very few companies have solved it, and there's no established playbook to follow. The exact approach is under active discussion and you'd be central to driving it.

You will:

  • Own the design and execution of the CPC-to-CPO migration, including the core open question of whether the system stays CPO-facing externally while optimising CPC behind the scenes, or some hybrid of the two

  • Build and improve the bidding surface: goal-based automated bidding, Target CPO, optimised CPC, and Target ROAS

  • Own yield management tied to ROS targeting

  • Partner daily with the DoorDash US team to align on approach across markets

  • Set technical direction for the domain

Requirements

  • Expertise in ad economics, marketplace bidding, or auction theory

The explosive growth of AI is pushing the industry to rethink how processors are built. Arago is meeting that challenge with a proprietary technology that fuses optical and CMOS technologies to deliver an order-of-magnitude increase in performance.

Arago is the fastest, and currently the only, company to have built such a processor. It's backed by leading deep-tech investors and some of the most respected figures in semiconductors and computing, including the CEO of Arm, the founder of macOS who worked directly with Steve Jobs at Apple, an Nvidia Fellow, the Head of Optics at Google, and many other industry leaders.

Our work is guided by three clear values: do great things, move with high velocity, and operate as one unit. We work in a demanding environment where constant learning, ownership, and execution are expected, and where exceptional people have the opportunity to do their life’s work.

 

What you’ll do

As Architecture Modeling Engineer you will own performance modeling and workload analysis for Arago's optical AI accelerator, working across hardware and software teams to evaluate design choices, shape the programming model, and optimize key compute kernels. This role turns workload requirements into architecture decisions and, ultimately, high-performance software on silicon.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Strong mathematical background, particularly in linear algebra, probability, numerical methods, and quantitative performance analysis.

title: Senior Legal Counsel – Contracts (German speaker)
description:
Could your legal expertise help build the contractual foundations of Europe’s next financial management platform?

 

At Pennylane, we believe legal should be more than a safeguard. It should be a business enabler.

Our ambition is to equip millions of small and medium-sized businesses across Europe with a complete, high-performing financial management platform. As Pennylane continues to grow rapidly in France and expand internationally, we are looking for a Senior Legal Counsel, Contracts to join our Legal, Compliance & Risk team.

Within a Legal department of 10 professionals, the Contracts team secures Pennylane’s commercial and operational relationships with customers, suppliers, partner firms, resellers, integrators and strategic partners.

Reporting to the Lead Legal Counsel, Contracts, you will work closely with our Sales, Partnerships, Security, Finance and Product teams. This is a hands-on role where legal rigor, creativity and business pragmatism are equally valued.

 

🌍 What is Pennylane?

 

Pennylane is one of France’s most dynamic fintech companies, currently expanding rapidly across Europe.

In just six years, we have managed to:

💻 Establish ourselves in the market as an innovative provider of accounting and financial management software

💰 Raise a total of €400 million from renowned investors, including Sequoia, Silicon Valley’s leading ventur

title: Responsable Onboarding Comptable
description:
Et si ton expertise comptable servait à transformer la façon dont travaille toute une profession ?

Founded in 2017, Dutchie is a comprehensive technology platform powering dispensary operations, while providing consumers with safe and easy access to cannabis. title: Product Integration Engineer, Defence
description:
We're looking for a Product Integration Engineer to develop and prove out our products with military customers, starting with the Field Operator HUD (FOH): a head-mounted, always-on visual intelligence system built from Distance hardware, a HUD operating system and AI-assisted data processing that pulls sensor, feeds and command-and-control into the operator's field of view. Your job is to make it work on a specific customer's platform, in the field, not just on a bench, as part of our core R&D team. If you're a hands-on generalist who knows VR or XR and would rather be where the tech meets the user than stuck at a desk, this one's for you.

WHY DISTANCE?

At Distance Technologies, the problem we're solving is simple to state and hard to solve: the amount of data in the world is endless, but human capacity is not. We are building a fundamentally new perception layer between humans and machines, transforming transparent surfaces into interfaces unlike the world has ever seen. Think of the windscreen of a car, the visor of a helmet, or a sight device, each becoming a new front-end for AI. The way we turn bits and atoms into expanded human perception is protected by over 50 granted international patent families. We build it for two demanding worlds: defence and automotive. And we build it from a single foundation fusing software, hardware and computational optics.

title: Medical Device Auditor
description:
We pull medical technology from the future to solve human health.

 

Scarlet is authorised to assess and certify medical devices. We combine clinical, technical and regulatory expertise with AI agents and software so rigorous certification can keep pace with product development at the world’s most ambitious technology companies, without lowering the safety bar.

Our customers have cut a year or more from their certification timelines for new AI-enabled medical devices and shortened product-update cycles from months to weeks. You’ll join a team building the infrastructure that makes these outcomes repeatable at scale.

About the role

As a Medical Device Auditor at Scarlet, you will audit medical device manufacturers’ quality management systems and produce clear conclusions that support certification decisions. You’ll receive training in Scarlet’s audit methods and tools. Your work will combine reviewing evidence with conversations about how manufacturers’ processes work in practice. Travel will be limited, though occasional trips may be required. You will help safe devices reach patients sooner.

  • Plan and conduct QMS audits against ISO 13485, EU MDR and UK MDR requirements.

  • Review records and interview teams to assess whether their processes meet the requirements.

  • Document evidence, findings and conclusions in clear, timely audit reports.

  • Explain findings constructively and keep customers informed throughout the audit.

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python) - Remote
description:
Breathment is a Munich-based digital health startup. We digitize pulmonary rehabilitation for people living with chronic respiratory diseases such as COPD: our app guides patients through therapy exercises at home, watches their movement through the phone camera and gives feedback in real time, while physiotherapists and physicians follow their progress remotely through our telemonitoring platform. We work with German clinics, physiotherapists and health insurers, and every release reaches real patients.

We are looking for a senior engineer who is at home in both worlds: computer vision and production backend. You will own the path from neural-network output to what the patient sees on screen and what the therapist reads in the report.

Tasks

  • Own the computer-vision pipeline that turns pose-estimation output from our neural networks into repetition counts, posture feedback and set-by-set exercise analysis.
  • Design the reporting layer that converts raw movement data into clinical reports physiotherapists act on.
  • Build and extend our Python backend (FastAPI, MongoDB, Redis): the API behind the patient app and the clinician platform.
  • Ship to production on Kubernetes with GPU inference services, and stand behind what you ship: tests, monitoring and clean handovers.
  • Analyse requirements together with product, physiotherapists and the mobile team, and propose solutions instead of waiting for tickets.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of professional software development in Python, including production REST APIs (FastAPI or comparable).
  • Hands-on experience with deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). You have built real product features on top of model output, not only trained models in notebooks.
  • Solid experience with NoSQL databases, ideally MongoDB, and with data models that survive growth.
  • A fluent Git and GitHub workflow: branches, reviews, CI.

title: Photonics Characterisation Engineer
description:
The role

We are looking for a Photonic Characterisation Engineer to join our Photonics team and play a key role in the experimental characterisation of advanced integrated photonic devices.

This is a highly hands-on position where you will design and run experiments, operate optical test equipment, analyse measurement data and help turn experimental results into clear engineering insight. Your work will support teams across photonic design, manufacturing and system testing, helping ensure technical decisions are grounded in high-quality, repeatable data.

You will work across both die-level and wafer-level characterisation, combining practical laboratory work with Python-based data analysis and experimental automation. Over time, you will take increasing ownership of characterisation activities, from defining test approaches through to delivering results and communicating conclusions to stakeholders.

This role is particularly well suited to someone who enjoys being in the lab, working through difficult experimental problems and moving comfortably between optics, software and data.

What you'll be doing

  • Design and execute experiments to characterise integrated photonic devices and structures

  • Operate optical and photonic laboratory equipment across a range of measurement setups

  • Carry out die-level and wafer-level testing

  • Analyse experimental data using Python and relevant scientific computing tools

  • Develop scripts and workflows to automate data collection and analysis

Luminovo builds the B2B SaaS platform that powers the electronics supply chain. DACH is our home market and one of our strongest, and we’re adding an Account Executive to the German-speaking team.

About Peec AI

Peec AI is the analytics platform for AI search. People increasingly discover products and make buying decisions through ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, and Google's AI Overviews instead of traditional search, and most brands have no idea where they show up in those answers. Peec gives marketing, SEO, and growth teams the data to see exactly that: how visible their brand is across AI platforms, how they compare to competitors, and where to win.

 

We are defining this category, and the market is moving with us. Peec is a Series A company backed by 20VC and Singular, past $10M ARR, with a 80+ person team across our Berlin HQ and our new New York office.

About the role

We're looking for a Visiting Founders Associate to join our engineering team in Berlin. You'll be the operational backbone of the team, running the processes, projects, and internal work that keep everything moving, so our engineers can stay focused on building.

The main piece of the role is our compliance work, which you'll coordinate and execute end to end. title: Technical Lead, Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

As Technical Lead, Laser Amplification, you will own the end-to-end technical delivery of the laser amplification subsystem. The amplification chain is the primary energy-scaling element of the laser system, so this role is central to translating ICF system requirements into an integrated, high-performing function.

You will define the subsystem architecture, establish the technical roadmap, lead design and test activities, manage interfaces and risks, and develop the team and capabilities needed to take the amplification chain from concept through hardware delivery and integration.


What you’ll do

  • Define and own the technical architecture for Main Amplifier systems from concept through design freeze, including topology, gain media, pump geometry, thermal management, ASE control, and interface specifications.

  • Ensure that the amplification architecture and development activities remain traceable to ICF system-level laser requirements.

  • Build and maintain the technical roadmap for Light Amplification, aligning development sequence, capability gaps, technology maturity, and program milestones.

  • Lead the design, build, characterization, and integration of the amplification chain.

description:

title: Platform Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

ecoplanet builds the operating system for the energy transition. Our software helps European businesses cut energy costs, run more efficiently, and take the pain out of managing energy day to day. We are around 40 people and backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and others.


Why This Role Matters

You build and run the platform the whole product sits on: the event streams, the backend services and the cloud infrastructure everything else is built on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to make sure that traffic lands reliably, moves through the system in a shape other teams can build on, and keeps doing so as the number of sites grows.
You join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.

What you will work on

  • Event streaming. Kafka is the spine of the system. You own topic and schema design, partitioning, retention and delivery semantics  and the everyday reality behind them: consumers falling behind, replays, backfills, late and duplicated readings.
  • Backend services in TypeScript. The ingestion services, integrations and APIs around that stream. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is turning that variety into one consistent interface the product squads can rely on.
  • Cloud infrastructure on GCP. Compute, networking, IAM, infrastructure as code, CI/CD and observability. The goal is a paved road: other engineers ship and debug their own services without going through you.
  • Technical direction. You are senior enough to set it. Where we invest in the platform, what we standardise, what we deliberately leave rough for now  and bringing the rest of the team along with it.

title: Data Engineer (m/f/d)
description:
What we are building

At ecoplanet, we're redefining energy for tomorrow. Our mission: turn energy management into the competitive edge every European business relies on to win its market. We're building the operating system for the energy transition — cutting energy costs, improving efficiency, and streamlining operations. Backed by EQT Ventures, HV Capital and more, and built by a team full of top-tier talent.


Why This Role Matters

You will build and run the data backbone the whole product sits on. Meter readings arrive from industrial sites across Europe, through messages or us accessing APIs. Your job is to get that data in clean, on time, and in a shape that dashboards, insights and forecasts can rely on.

You will join a team of 12 engineers in two squads. Small team, real ownership, and what you build reaches customers in weeks rather than quarters.


What You’ll Achieve

  • Meter data integration. Connect industrial hardware and utility data streams into real-time dashboards. Every site is a little different, so a good part of the job is bringing data into a consistent structure across all sites
  • Anomalies and insights. This is where data science comes in. Find the things in the data a customer would want to know about — a meter drifting, a machine left running overnight, consumption that does not fit the pattern — and turn them into something they can act on
  • Tech stack and growth. Support the engineering team building scalable data pipeline


What Sets You Up for Success

Must have:

  • At least 3–5 years in a data engineering role or something close to it, building pipelines other people depend on

description:

Als Software Engineer Linux OS bist Du verantwortlich für das Betriebssystem unseres Gateways. Du gestaltest die Grundlage für ein sicheres, stabiles und skalierbares Ökosystem, das den Betrieb, die Überwachung und Aktualisierung unserer Geräteflotte ermöglicht. Damit legst du den Grundstein für unsere Anwendungen und trägst aktiv zur Digitalisierung der Energienetze bei!


Deine Aufgaben

  • Du entwickelst und wartest ein sicheres und modulares Linux-Betriebssystem für unsere Gateways.
  • Du konzipierst und implementierst Frameworks und Schnittstellen zur Überwachung und Aktualisierung der Geräteflotte.
  • Du integrierst Lösungen zur Geräteidentifikation, -authentifizierung und -autorisierung, um höchste Sicherheit zu gewährleisten.
  • Das Thema Linux OS treibst Du aktiv voran und bringst technische Weiterentwicklungen eigenständig von der Idee bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung.


Dein Profil

  • Du bringst fundierte Kenntnisse moderner Softwareentwicklungsworkflows mit, z. B. Versionskontrolle mit Git, CI/CD-Pipelines, automatisiertes Testing und Code Reviews.
  • Fundierte Erfahrung in der Entwicklung von Linux-Betriebssystemen und Softwarearchitekturen bringst Du mit.
  • Der Umgang mit Tools wie Yocto zur Erstellung und Anpassung von Linux-Distributionen ist dir vertraut.

  • Mit der Konzeption sicherer Systeme, z. B. durch Threat Modelling

description:

Do you want to do more than just write security concepts - and put your decisions into practice directly? Do you see cloud security not as a compliance checklist, but as the combination of threat modeling, Infrastructure as Code, and genuine hands-on engineering? Then we are looking for you to join our CISO team as a Senior Security Engineer (m/f/d) in a hybrid working model in Munich, Berlin or Halle (Saale).
You will join a three-person team where responsibility is genuinely shared: no ticket queues and no “that’s not my area.” We plan together, cover for one another, and usually implement and operate the security controls we design ourselves. title: Internship - Workplace and People Operations
description:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

Le poste est basé à Brest, au sein de l'équipe BRAIN (BRoader Artificial INtelligence) du Lab-STICC (UMR CNRS 6285). L'équipe travaille sur les fondements de l'apprentissage automatique (représentations, apprentissage frugal, modèles de fondation, traitement du signal) et sur leurs applications, en particulier en santé. Le projet ENDIVE étudie ce que la diversité peut apporter à l'apprentissage automatique lorsque le budget porte sur le nombre d'exemples annotés plutôt que sur la puissance de calcul. Dans ce régime, ce qu'apporte un nouvel exemple ne dépend plus seulement de sa qualité propre, mais de ce qui le distingue de ceux déjà vus. Le point d'entrée technique du projet est l'échantillonnage à garanties de diversité, et en particulier les processus ponctuels déterminantaux (DPP), dont la matrice de noyau encode à la fois la pertinence des points et leur similarité.

En viktig del av lederoppdraget er å utvikle RRO sammen med medarbeiderne og samarbeidskommunene. Du vil derfor arbeide både operativt og strategisk og ha kontakt med ledere, fagmiljøer, teknologileverandører og andre samarbeidspartnere.  Du blir en del av ledergruppen i enhet Legetjenester og rapporterer til enhetsleder. title: Associate Product Owner
description:
TL;DR

Full-time. Berlin-based. No remote option available for this role. You sit with the PM.

Join GlassDollar as an Associate Product Owner and own the space between a good idea and a shipped feature.
Someone has to decide what "done" means, write it down clearly enough that an engineer can start on Monday, and stay close enough to the build that the scope does not quietly grow on the way. That is the job. You own it end to end: specs, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and a backlog that keeps everyone honest about what is actually shipping. Nobody hands you a ticket queue you did not write yourself.

The problem you'll be solvingA corporation with 100,000 employees has thousands of expensive operational problems, and somewhere out there a startup has already solved most of them. Getting those two facts to meet is slow, political, and mostly attempted in spreadsheets that die in someone's downloads folder.
GlassDollar OS is the venture clienting platform that makes it repeatable: sourcing the startups, matching them to real problems, running the pilots, and rolling out what works across the whole organisation. Enterprise customers run real innovation budgets through it. What you scope this month decides what they can do next quarter.


What we´re looking for

You have personally written the tickets.
3+ years in a product company, where scoping and ticket-writing were actually your job rather than something you handed off.
You are technical enough to argue with engineers.
AI models, API contracts, estimates, sequencing. You push back with reasons, and you change your mind when the reasons coming back are better.
You can write.
A spec is a piece of writing. We will ask for a sample where the reasoning is visible, polish second.

title: Backend Engineer - Senior
description:
Our mission

Bounti is building the AI-native infrastructure layer for frontline teams, spanning training, audits, and autonomous operations. We partner with multi-location operators in frontline industries such as hospitality.
Behind the product sits a backend that has grown quickly: a Node and Postgres API, background workers, queues, and the AI pipelines powering our product. We're hiring a Senior Backend Engineer to own that layer as we scale it.


What you'll do

  • Own the backend behind the product: API design, data modelling, query performance, and the decisions that get harder to reverse the longer we leave them.
  • Run everything asynchronous: queues, background jobs, scheduled work, and the retry and failure behaviour that keeps a short outage from becoming a long one.
  • Own the AI pipelines: the ones running today and the next set of features we build on top of them, including versioned prompts, evaluation, cost and latency budgets, and graceful behaviour when a model provider has a bad day.
  • Move data where it needs to go: reporting and analytics pipelines that give operators a trustworthy picture across dozens of locations.
  • Connect Bounti to the systems customers already run: POS, scheduling, payroll, and whatever comes next. Build a shared layer rather than one-off connectors, so each new partner costs less than the last.
  • Make failure visible and recoverable: idempotency, reconciliation, per-customer alerting, and drift detection when a partner API misreports state.
  • Own the partner relationship on the technical side: sandbox access, certification programmes, API reviews.
  • Build internal tooling that empowers the CS team to diagnose failed syncs and enable integrations.

What's it all about?

The balance of power in the energy industry needs to change. The intermittency of renewable supply and the constant demands of the grid mean that we still rely on less efficient, more expensive and unsustainable fossil fuels to keep the lights on. At Gridfuse, our mission is to shift this balance through technology. To shift the balance of inputs, so that renewables become the world's main source of electricity.  

At Gridfuse, we develop the software that controls real renewable energy assets and turns them into a coordinated Virtual Power Plant (VPP) that can respond intelligently to energy markets and grid conditions.


Your impact

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will build the systems that connects our platform to these assets and turn energy-market and grid requirements into real-world actions. Your code will influence when batteries charge or discharge, how renewable assets respond, and how reliably these assets can participate in the electricity system. 

You will own and evolve core parts of the Control services, working closely with other software engineers and our renewable-energy experts.

  • Design and build distributed control systems that coordinate fleets of batteries, wind turbines and solar plants

  • Build the services responsible for communicating with physical assets and processing their telemetry, status and capabilities 
  • Design systems that continue to behave predictably when devices fail, networks are unreliable, messages arrive late or assets become temporarily unavailable
  • Build highly observable and resilient services that operate continuously in production

title: Working Student (all genders) – Robust Feed-Forward 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scene
description:
Abstract

Feed-forward 3D reconstruction models can recover scene geometry directly from images or videos without costly scene-specific optimization. By combining large-scale pre-training, multi-view reasoning, and strong geometric priors, these models provide an efficient alternative to traditional reconstruction pipelines such as Structure-from-Motion, NeRF, and optimization-based 3D Gaussian Splatting.

Despite recent progress, current models remain sensitive to challenging real-world conditions. Occlusions, moving objects, illumination changes, nighttime scenes, reflections, rain, fog, and snow can result in incomplete geometry, unreliable correspondences, and temporally inconsistent predictions. Improving robustness under such conditions is essential for autonomous driving and robotic perception.

As a working student, you will support the development of robust feed-forward reconstruction models for dynamic scenes. You will investigate methods for handling occlusion, changing illumination, and adverse weather, and explore how large reconstruction models can serve as general-purpose geometric backbones for downstream 3D scene understanding, particularly semantic occupancy prediction and 4D occupancy forecasting.


These tasks interest you

  • Develop and evaluate feed-forward 3D reconstruction models for dynamic scenes using monocular or multi-view image sequences.

title: GTM Engineer
description:
Who is Boulevard?

Boulevard provides the first and only client experience platform for appointment-based, self-care businesses. We empower our customers to give their clients more of the magical moments that matter most.

Before launching in 2016, our founders spent months interviewing salon managers and working behind front desks to understand their pain points so we could design a modern, user-friendly platform that meets the unique needs of their business. Our roots may be in hair salons, but we are built for the broader self-care industry, including many types of salons, spas, medspa, barbershops, and more. Our technology not only helps our customers survive but thrive. Take a look at how we (and YOU) can make that happen.

We have an insatiable curiosity and embrace experimentation. We believe that simple solutions require the most sophistication, and we design each and every detail to maximize potential, power, and impact. Do our values match? Read through our story and what we value the most.

Our team values and celebrates our diverse backgrounds. Being open about who we are and what we do allows us to do the best work of our lives. We believe in equal opportunity for all, and you should too.

Come to the best work of your life at Boulevard.

Own the automation engine that powers Boulevard’s next phase of growth.

Boulevard is building a high-efficiency, AI-leveraged go-to-market engine as we scale from $50M toward $250M in revenue. As our SDR and AE teams grow, we are committed to scaling productivity through automation, not headcount alone.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on systems builder with deep CRM expertise and a pragmatic approach to AI and automation that drives measurable business outcomes.

You will report to the Director of Revenue Operations and partner closely with Sales Ops, Marketing Ops, Revenue Enablement, and Analytics to design and operationalize scalable workflows that dramatically reduce manual lift, increase demos per rep, and improve pipeline performance.

What you'll do here:

  • Own the architecture and evolution of automation workflows across Salesforce, Clay, LeanData, Gong, and Outreach to support outbound prospecting, enrichment, lead routing, and lifecycle management.
  • Design and operationalize AI-driven enrichment workflows in Clay, including custom prompt logic to extract relevant data from SMB web

title: Staff DevOps Engineer (Platform)
description:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

This role is fully remote; however, we’re only open to candidates based in the US, EU and UK.

Responsibilities

  • SDLC Infrastructure Ownership: Own and evolve CI/CD infrastructure using GitHub Actions and Kubernetes, with a focus on reliability, scalability, and developer velocity.

  • Mobile Release Automation: Automate release workflows including building, signing, and distributing binaries and managing app store submissions across iOS, Android, and Chrome.

  • e2e Test Automation: Oversee and improve automated end-to-end testing with Maestro and Playwright across mobile and web.

  • CI/CD Optimization: Improve pipeline performance, reliability, and observability to support rapid, high-confidence releases.

  • Developer Experience: Partner with engineering teams on SDLC and DevEx improvements, including preview environments and tooling such as Appetize.

  • Security & Compliance: Help ensure build, release, and deployment systems meet the security and compliance expectations of a financial product.

  • Technical Leadership: Set standards and drive improvements across build, test, release, and deployment workflows, partnering closely with product and engineering teams.

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in DevOps, Platform Engineering, SRE, Systems Engineering, or a related role, with experience operating at a senior or staff level.

  • Strong experience with AWS and CI/CD systems such as GitHub Actions or GitLab CI.

  • Strong experience with Docker, Kuber

title: Director of Customer Success Operations
description:
About Securly

Securly is the K-12 market leader in AI-powered student safety and wellness solutions, protecting more than 20 million students across 20,000+ schools. Our mission is to create safer, more supportive learning environments by detecting potential harm, supporting student mental health, and empowering educators with actionable insights that help students thrive.

By turning data into meaningful, actionable intelligence, Securly enables schools to identify risk earlier, reduce harmful incidents, and strengthen student support — driving measurable improvements in safety and wellbeing. We're proud to be recognized as a Top Place to Work, named to TIME's America's Top EdTech Companies 2026 list, a Top 40 Most Used EdTech, and one of the 150 most transformational growth companies.

The Role

Securly is looking for a Director, Customer Success Operations to lead the systems, processes, and people behind our entire post-sale customer journey. You'll lead our CS Ops and Renewals function - a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and a team of Renewals Specialists - and own Vitally, our Customer Success platform, as the operational backbone of the business.

This is a builder's role. Vitally has been live for about a year, and the next chapter is yours to write: deepening adoption, sharpening health scoring, automating renewals workflows, and turning good instincts into a repeatable, data-driven system that scales. You'll be the operational thought partner to CS executives - using data and process design to make sure customer growth and success directly fuel Securly's growth.
Location: Remote (U.S.) Type: Full-Time, Exempt Reports to: SVP, Customer Success

What Success Looks Like

In your first 90 days, you'll get under the hood - auditing our Vitally configuration, current CS Ops and renewals workflows, and team structure. You'll build real relationships with your team and ship your first wave of improvements: sharper health scoring, better dashboards, and a more programmatic renewals process.

By 6 months, you're driving measurable gains - better renewals efficiency, stronger forecast accuracy, and dashboards that CS and company leadership actually rely on to run the business.

By your first year, you own a mature CS Ops and Renewals function that consistently meets or exceeds retention targets, backed by a trained, accountable team and a Vitally instance that scales with Securly's growth.

What You'll Do

Lead the team

  • Hire, coach, and manage a team of a CS Ops Manager, a CS Ops Specialist, and Renewals Specialists - setting clear goals and holding the team accountable to them
  • Structure team capacity

title: Lead Customer Experience & Support (m/w/d) 100% Remote
description: Die Alparis GmbH mit Sitz in Bottighofen am Bodensee betreibt Revitera, eine junge Marke für Nahrungsergänzung im Direktvertrieb an Endkundinnen und Endkunden. Unser Shop läuft auf Shopify. Der Schwerpunkt unserer Kundschaft liegt heute im deutschsprachigen Raum, längst aber nicht mehr ausschliesslich: Wir skalieren gerade in weitere europäische Märkte und bereiten den Schritt nach Amerika vor.   Wir sind ein kleines Team mit kurzen Wegen und ohne Konzernstrukturen. Was hier entschieden wird, ist am selben Tag live. Gerade bauen wir unseren Kundenservice technisch neu auf: eine eigene Software, die einen wachsenden Teil der Kommunikation automatisiert und die wir zusammen mit unserer IT laufend weiterentwickeln.   Für diesen Bereich suchen wir die Person, die bei uns die Kundenzufriedenheit verantwortet. Diese Rolle ist die Schnittstelle zwischen allen Teams und unseren Kundinnen und Kunden. Wer sie ausfüllt, kennt unsere Kundschaft besser als alle anderen im Haus, kennt die Produkte, die Strategie und die Ziele dahinter, und trägt dieses Wissen in jedes andere Team zurück. Entsprechend gross ist der Einfluss auf das, was wir bauen.  Aufgaben  • Du übernimmst die vollständige Verantwortung für die Kundenzufriedenheit bei Revitera und für alles, was daran hängt.   • Du bist die Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kundinnen und Kunden und allen internen Teams. Was du aus dem Kontakt lernst, spielst du strukturiert an Produkt, Shop, IT und Marketing zurück.   • Du lernst unsere Kundschaft wirklich kennen, sammelst Feedback systematisch ein und machst daraus verwertbare Erkenntnisse statt Bauchgefühl.   • Du baust den Kundensupport von Grund auf: Prozesse, Antwortstandards, Tonalität, Eskalationswege und die Struktur dahinter.   • Du entwickelst effiziente Systeme, mit denen die Kommunikation mit unserer Kundschaft besser, schneller und persönlicher wird.   • Du treibst die Automatisierung dieses Bereichs voran: Du arbeitest eng mit unserer IT an unserer eigenen Support-Software, testest sie, bringst deine Praxiserfahrung in die Weiterentwicklung des Algorithmus ein und entscheidest mit, was automatisiert wird und was in menschliche Hand gehört.   • Du verantwortest das Bewertungsmanagement, also Shop-Bewertungen, Bewertungsportale und öffentliche Rückmeldungen.   • Du führst die Kundensupport-Mitarbeitenden: Einarbeitung, Qualitätssicherung, Weiterentwicklung.   • Mittelfristig übernimmst du zusätzlich das E-Mail-Marketing und die gesamte Kundenkommunikation ausserhalb der bezahlten Werbung. Die Stelle ist bewusst als wachsende Bereichsleitung angelegt.   Woran wir den Erfolg dieser Rolle messen:   • Customer Retention, also wie viele Kundinnen und Kunden bei uns bleiben. Das ist die wichtigste Zahl.   • Kundenzufriedenheit über alle Kontaktpunkte hinweg.   • Möglichst viele positive und möglichst wenige negative Bewertungen, sowie ein aktives Bewertungsmanagement.   • Der Automatisierungsgrad im Kundenservice, also wie viel wir ohne Qualitätsverlust

ARQ is one of the fastest-growing fintechs in the world. Our mission is to redefine how people interact with money across borders, building the infrastructure to move value seamlessly.   • Demonstrable experience in Backend development, with fluency in Java

About Wayflyer

Today's small businesses need a capital provider that keeps pace with their growth ambitions. Traditional financing options are slow, cumbersome and often out of reach. That's why we built Wayflyer.

Our technology allows us to assess businesses in minutes, generate financing offers that reflect their growth potential and send funds in as little as 24 hours. To date, we've deployed over $6bn to thousands of businesses worldwide, backed by Tier 1 banks like J.P. Morgan.

The challenge

The Broker Channel is Wayflyer's fastest-growing route to market, and growth like that doesn't manage itself. We need someone who can scale a panel of brokers into a genuine growth engine, turning relationships and referral volume into closed deals. This isn't a maintenance role. It's a build role.

description:
At praxipal, we are building an AI-powered healthcare admin workforce to address the global shortage of medical staff.

Medical assistants are too valuable to spend their days chasing callbacks, cleaning up schedules, sending repetitive messages, or wrestling with invoicing and documentation workflows. Staff should spend time on patients. That’s why we build Luna.

title: CENTRALE LYON - Post-Doctoral Position Ferroelectric-Based Ternary Computing: From Circuit Design to System-Level Integration Scientific Context
description:
Energy efficiency remains one of the foremost challenges in modern computing, spanning from edge IoT devices to high-performance data centers. Conventional CMOS-based architectures are approaching fundamental physical limits, while the "memory wall" — data transfers between processor and memory accounting for 70 to 90% of total system energy — continues to worsen with the ever-growing demands of data-intensive workloads such as deep neural networks and signal processing pipelines.

In-Memory Computing (IMC) has emerged as a disruptive paradigm to overcome these bottlenecks by embedding arithmetic operations directly within memory arrays, drastically reducing data movement. In this landscape, ferroelectric field-effect transistors (FeFETs) stand out as particularly compelling devices: fully compatible with standard CMOS fabrication processes, non-volatile, reconfigurable, and capable of storing intermediate polarization states — a property that naturally enables ternary logic within a single device.

The Post-Doctoral position will cover at least one of the following tasks:

  • Design Standard Cell Technology Library based on FeFET devices developed at INL in order to be used with synthesis flow.

  • Design and optimize ternary arithmetic units (multiply-accumulate units, adders, comparators) based on the FeFET ternary gate library developed within the project, targeting area, power, and timing closure under realistic process constraints.

  • Develop and refine system-level models of FeFET-based ternary IMC units, abstracting circuit-level characterization results into archi

title: Senior Product Manager, Data Infrastructure

For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Team

Data Infrastructure builds the platform that every other data team stands on: access to shared data, orchestration, data ingestion, and the retirement of systems the company has outgrown. description:

The European trades are one of the least digitised industries left. Software
penetration sits under 15%, against roughly 70% in the US. The labour

on paperwork instead of the craft they trained for — in the industry that has to
deliver the energy transition.

smalt replaces the back office entirely rather than selling Meister another tool

and watch how the work actually happens. Then you'll come back and build the

- Decide what to build.

Du möchtest Daten nicht nur analysieren, sondern daraus konkrete Verbesserungen entwickeln und aktiv mitgestalten? Du interessierst dich für Product Data, BI und Customer Analytics, hast Spaß daran, komplexe Datenstrukturen weiterzuentwickeln und möchtest mit modernen Technologien wie KI neue Potenziale erschließen? Du arbeitest analytisch, denkst gerne in Zusammenhängen und packst Themen selbstständig an? Dann bist du bei uns goldrichtig!

Kreuzfahrtberater ist eines der führenden Online-Portale für die Vermittlung von Kreuzfahrten aller namhaften Reedereien im DACH-Raum.

Für unser Team suchen wir an unserem Standort in Hamburg zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen engagierten Manager Product Data & BI (m/w/d) in Vollzeit (40 Std.). In dieser Position entwickelst du unsere Product-Data-Strukturen, BI-Landschaft und Customer Analytics weiter, verknüpfst Datenquellen zu ganzheitlichen Datenmodellen und schaffst daraus wertvolle Erkenntnisse für unser Business.

Aufgaben

Das erklärte Ziel: Du bringst Struktur in komplexe Daten, machst sie gezielt nutzbar und schaffst daraus echten Mehrwert für unser Unternehmen und unsere Kunden. Damit bringst du datengetriebene Themen sicher auf Kurs.

Dabei sind deine Kernaufgaben:

  • Messung und aufbereitende Analyse von Kundendaten, Customer Lifetime Value und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Analyse von Conversion, Reactivation und Retention Rates entlang der gesamten Customer Journey
  • Analyse aller Customer Touch Points im Customer Lifecycle inkl. Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen
  • Aktive Identifikation und Einbezug von KI-Potenzialen in alle relevanten Prozesse (z.B. für personalisierte Produktempfehlungen, automatisierte Textgenerierung oder Churn Prediction)
  • Projektleitung für datengetriebene Initiativen von der Konzeption bis zum Rollout

title: Head of Finance & Data (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

In dieser vielseitigen Doppelrolle verbindest du messerscharfe Zahlenkompetenz mit einem echten Gespür für Datenarchitektur und Reporting-Infrastruktur. Du baust nicht nur ein stabiles Controlling auf, sondern gestaltest parallel die technische Grundlage, auf der unser gesamtes Unternehmen datenbasierte Entscheidungen trifft. title: Customer Success Manager

As a  Customer Success Manager  at Qualdatrix Oy, you will be the face of the company to major global enterprises guiding them through smooth, high-impact training and enablement experiences. This role offers strong growth potential, allowing you to expand your responsibilities over time and shape your career path based on your personal interests, skills, and strengths as the company scales. title: Customer Success Manager (SaaS)
location: Pozuelo de Alarcón, Community of Madrid, Spain
description: Customer Success [Coach Terminator]       Sobre nosotros y nuestra cultura [The Walcu Way]:   Somos una start-up tecnológica que ofrece un CRM (herramienta de gestión comercial) en la nube (SaaS) a concesionarios. En 8 años ya somos unos 50 empleados y facturamos €8M anuales en ventas de software a empresas del automóvil. Nos hemos convertido en líderes del mercado español y ya tenemos presencia en otros países de Europa y Latinoamérica.      Sobre ti:   No seremos nosotros quienes digamos cómo eres tú, salvo en este caso, que sí lo haremos. 🙂   Tú tienes experiencia o quieres desarrollarte en la gestión de clientes y entorno SaaS.  Tienes una escritura excelente y unas habilidades comunicativas poderosas –¿lleva coma el vocativo?–, y te sientes muy cómodo/a trabajando en un ambiente eléctrico y de alto rendimiento..  Eres una persona con una alta inteligencia emocional y con la capacidad de entender y empatizar con las necesidades de otros.  Eres una persona curiosa con criterio para detectar mejoras en la experiencia del usuario, te manejas bien con la tecnología, tienes iniciativa y proactividad. Esto es importante para encajar bien con nuestra cultura, ya que somos doers.  Te llena de energía hacer que tus clientes consigan hacer realidad sus proyectos.  Quieres ser la persona que ayuda a nuestros clientes a sacar el máximo partido de nuestro software.       ¿Cómo será tu día a día como Customer Coach?   Sí, hemos retirado el término Customer Success y lo hemos rebrandeado como Customer Coach porque el verdadero éxito no consiste en ayudar a los clientes a hacer el trabajo. Se trata de ayudarles a aprender a hacer el trabajo. No hacemos el trabajo para los clientes.  Enseñamos a los clientes a hacer el trabajo por sí mismos.      Responsabilidades principales:    Llevarás cuentas del mercado Español.  Liderarás la cuenta una vez finalizado el onboarding, siendo la persona de referencia del cliente en su día a día.  Entrenarás y acompañarás al cliente para que saque el máximo partido a Walcu y lo integre en su operativa real.  Entenderás su negocio, sus objetivos y sus retos para convertir la herramienta en impacto tangible.  Identificarás oportunidades de evolución en la cuenta, proponiendo ampliaciones que generen impacto real. Para nosotros el éxito no es vender más licencias, sino que el cliente sienta Walcu como su propio CRM.  Monitorizarás la salud de la relación (uso, engagement, riesgo de churn) y actuarás antes de que haya problemas.  Trasladarás al equipo de Producto feedback accionable y defenderás la voz del cliente dentro de Walcu.       Condiciones laborales:    Contrato a jornada completa –40 horas semanales–.  Contrato indefinido –queremos a alguien para siempre ❤–.  Palomitas de mantequilla y happydent de menta ilimitados.  Y alucina vecina:ni UNO ni DOS sino TRES microondas.  Opción de trabajar 2 días a la semana en remoto a partir del cuarto mes –presencial 100% durante los primeros 4 meses para empaparse de la cultura

description: About Agoda   At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.  Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us. That is why we provide in-person, real-time help around the clock and in 38 languages. No matter the issue, we present the best of Agoda’s values to each and every customer with multiple support channels and a strong desire to serve. Certainly doing more than answering phone calls or replying to emails, our specialists actively look for ways to improve our customer’s experience. We quickly adapt to challenges by collaborating with other teams and experimenting on everything we can. This has allowed us to develop new and effective products that produce meaningful results and continue to drive Agoda’s business performance. Our Customer Support Team serves a daily role in contributing to a core strength and service of Agoda with a clear vision and a focus on efficient and satisfying customer support. As a Contact Center Team Manager based in Kuala Lumpur ,  you will support both determined business objectives (KPIs) as well as acting as a motivator and decision maker to ensure that the group is working efficiently and in unity.  In this position, you will work closely with the operations management team and other departments within Agoda Customer Experience Group (CEG) to support our contact center. The team manager of operations will provide directions, instructions and guidance to the customer care specialists to achieve a certain goal. title: Asiakkuuspäällikkö, arjen talous, OP Etelä-Pirkanmaa
description: Tule meille kollegaksi    Oletko finanssialan ammattilainen ja haluat päästä hyödyntämään asiantuntijuuttasi pankkimme keskeisessä roolissa? Sytytkö innostavasta johtamisesta ja haluatko päästä kehittämään asiakaskokemusta tiimiäsi valmentaen? Haluatko työskennellä pankissa, jonka toiminnan keskiössä on asiakaslähtöisyys?   Haemme nyt arjen talouden tiimiimme asiakkuuspäällikköä vahvistamaan joukkoamme  OP Etelä-Pirkanmaalle . Olet tärkeässä roolissa johtamassa henkilöstön työhyvinvointia sekä erinomaista työntekijäkokemusta. Johdat pankin päivittäis- ja verkkopalveluita ja kehität vastuualuettasi proaktiivisesti, valmennat tiimiäsi asiakaskohtaamisissa ja luot edellytyksiä tiimiläistesi ammatilliselle kasvulle. Varmistat samalla, että tiimin osaaminen on sääntelyn mukaista ja työ tuloksellista. Oleellinen osa työtäsi on myynnin valmentaminen ja arjen työjärjestelyt. Kehität vastuualueesi toimintaa rohkeasti. Mahdollistat tiimillesi itseohjautuvan työskentelytavan ja olet varmistamassa, että asiakaspalvelu- ja toimintaprosessit luovat edellytykset erinomaiselle asiakaskokemukselle. Tehtävä edellyttää kuitenkin liikkumista kaikilla konttoreillamme. Teemme työtä hybridimallilla, lähi- ja etätyötä yhdistellen. Tiimisi työskentelee eri konttoreissamme.   Millaista osaamista etsimme?   Edellytämme vankkaa kokemusta finanssialalta pankkiliiketoiminnasta ja erityisesti tuntemusta päivittäispankkipalveluista ja verkko- ja puhelinpalvelusta. Katsomme eduksesi aiemman esihenkilökokemuksen tai muun valmennusosaamisen. Koulutustaustasi voi olla esimerkiksi kaupallinen tai muuten tehtävään soveltuva.  Suhtaudut muutokseen ja kehittymiseen myönteisesti ja uudistuksien jalkauttaminen sekä eteenpäin vieminen on sinulle luontevaa. Koet olevasi myyntihenkinen. Otat vastuun omasta kentästäsi ja päätöksenteko sujuu sinulta luontevasti. Menestyäksesi tässä tehtävässä tarvitset hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja viestintätyylisi on vakuuttava ja vaikuttava.   Me tarjoamme   OP Etelä-Pirkanmaa sijaitsee elinvoimaisella toimialueella Suomen kasvukäytävällä. Konttorimme sijaitsevat Akaassa, Valkeakoskella, Punkalaitumella ja Urjalassa. Konserniimme kuuluu lisäksi OP Koti Etelä-Pirkanmaa Oy LKV.  Tarjoamme sinulle monipuolisen työn kehitysmyönteisessä organisaatiossa sekä mahdollisuuden vahvistaa omaa asiantuntijuuttasi finanssialalla. Meillä vallitsee avoin, rento ja keskusteleva ilmapiiri, jossa jokainen saa olla oma itsensä ja kehittyä. Sinua odottaa porukka, johon on helppo solahtaa

title: Apulaismyymäläpäällikkö Helsingin Iso Roobertinkadun myymäläämme
description: Etsimme Normal-myymäläämme iloisen ja energisen asenteen omaavaa apulaismyymäläpäällikköä!   Apulaismyymäläpäällikkönä olet avainasemassa luomassa asiakkaille uniikkia osto- ja asiakaskokemusta. Toimit myymäläpäällikön kanssa tiiminä, motivoiden ja kehittäen työntekijöitä avoimessa ja iloisessa ympäristössä. Yhdessä varmistatte, että myymälä toimii tehokkaasti ja saavuttaa myyntitavoitteet. Myymälän visuaalinen ilme ja tiimin johtaminen ovat intohimosi. Pääset perehtymään tehtävääsi huippuosaajien kanssa, jonka tavoitteena on antaa sinulle alkustartti ammatilliseen ja henkilökohtaiseen kasvuun ja kehittymiseen. Kenties mielenkiintosi on toimia jonakin päivänä NORMAL-ketjun myymäläpäällikkönä!  NORMAL on nuori dynaaminen yritys, joka on muutaman vuoden aikana avannut satoja myymälöitä ympäri Euroopan. Myös Suomessa kasvumme jatkuu edelleen.  Tarjoamme asiakkaillemme pysyvästi matalat hinnat ja useita tuhansia ”normaaleja” tuotteita mm. kemikalio-, kosmetiikka- ja kotitaloustuotteiden saralla, unohtamatta jännittäviä uutuuksia joka viikko useissa eri tuotekategorioissa. NORMAL on yritys, jossa olemme kaikki samanarvoisia ja meillä on yhteiset menestymis- ja tulostavoitteet - ja samalla pidämme hauskaa yhdessä.   Mitä Toivomme Sinulta     olet kunnianhimoinen ja kerännyt kokemusta esihenkilönä toimimisesta - tuemme sinua roolissasi  asiakaspalvelu on intohimosi – asiakas on aina tärkein  olet motivoitunut, määrätietoinen ja väsymätön tiiminjohtaja – innostat ja motivoit omalla esimerkilläsi  paineensietokykyä – nopeatempoinen työ vie sinut mennessään ja uppoudut siihen mielelläsi  myymälän johtaminen ja kauppiashenkinen toiminen saa sinun syttymään – lukujen seuraaminen tukee myyntiä  omaat itsenäiset työskentelytaidot, mutta ymmärrät tiimin voiman – yhdessä on hauskempaa  sinulla on visuaalista silmää – esillepanojen teko best!  työt sijoittuvat niin aamu-, ilta- kuin välivuoroihinkin – monipuoliset työajat  kommunikoit vaivattomasti suomeksi ja asiakkaiden palvelu englanniksi onnistuu myös - but of course!  myymäläpäällikön ollessa poissa hyppäät puikkoihin empimättä ja varmistat myymäläntoiminnan     Mikäli etsit inspiroivaa, hauskaa ja menevää työpaikkaa, hae ihmeessä meille ja tule osaksi mahtavaa porukkaamme!  Maksamme palkkaa TES:in mukaisesti.   Oletko se sinä?   Odotamme innolla hakemustasi ja arvostamme myös videon muodossa tulevaa esittelyä! Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo ennen hakuajan umpeutumista, ja paikka täytetään sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

title: Senior Team Manager – Luxury Automotive Customer Experience | Madrid

title: Customer Success Manager, Hospital IT Software
description: Join us on our exciting journey!   IQVIA™ is The Human Data Science Company™, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. Formed through the merger of IMS Health and Quintiles, IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics, and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.   Customer Success Manager, Hospital IT Software   We help Payers, Providers & Government optimize population health management through the work we do to improve patient outcomes.  IQVIA is seeking a Customer Success Manager to support the adoption, implementation, and growth of our Hospital IT and healthcare software solutions across Switzerland. Acting as the primary customer success lead, you will work closely with healthcare providers, IT stakeholders, delivery teams, and partners to ensure successful deployments, high customer satisfaction, and long-term business growth.  This role combines customer success (50%) and revenue growth/account development (50%), helping customers maximize the value of IQVIA's healthcare technology solutions while identifying opportunities for expansion and renewal.   Responsibilities     Serve as the primary customer contact following contract signature, ensuring customer satisfaction and successful solution adoption.   Build strong relationships with clinical, operational, IT, and executive stakeholders.   Lead customer onboarding, implementation coordination, training, and go-live activities.   Proactively manage risks, escalations, and customer support requirements.   Support renewals and identify opportunities to expand existing customer relationships.   Collaborate with sales teams on presales activities, solution demonstrations, and technical feasibility assessments.   Coordinate with IQVIA global teams, partners, and delivery organizations to ensure successful customer outcomes.   Gather and document customer requirements, ensuring alignment with product and roadmap priorities.   Support healthcare data integration and interoperability initiatives, including HL7, FHIR, APIs, and Hospital Information Systems (HIS).   Monitor customer health, platform usage, adoption metrics, and overall value realization.     Requirements     The role requires a strong understanding of hospital business processes, clinical and operational workflows, and the business logic embedded within Hospital Information Systems (HIS) and related healthcare platforms.  The individual must be able to engage with clinical, operational and IT stakeholders to elicit, document and validate business requirements, and translate them into clear functional and technical specifications for implementation, integration and product teams. The ability to act as a bridge between business users and technical experts is critical.  Experience in customer success, implementation, or consulting within healthcare technology or Health IT.
