title: CRM & Loyalty Manager
description: 🏢  SOBRE ALSEA EN EUROPA    Alsea  es la empresa líder en restauración organizada. En España, contamos con un portfolio multimarca integrado por Starbucks, Domino's Pizza, Foster's Hollywood, VIPS, y Ginos. Además, disponemos de  4 fábricas propias  que garantizan una calidad óptima y sabor excepcional, para seguir ofreciendo  experiencias llenas de sabor.   En España, sumamos el talento de  más de 23.000 de personas  que trabajamos para entregar felicidad a más de  450 millones de clientes al año en el mundo.   En Alsea estamos inmersos en que nuestra empresa tenga cada vez más un carácter global, que los procesos de rigen y gobiernan nuestra compañía sean iguales en cualquiera de los países en los que operamos, por ello es imprescindible que nuestros ERP estén alineados y consigamos que los flujos de trabajo sean cada vez más globales y unificados. Por este motivo, nuestro departamento de Tecnologías de la Información busca tres nuevas figuras que nos permitan homogeneizar en SAP los flujos de trabajo de distintas áreas estratégicas, gestionando diversos proyectos.   🎯   SOBRE EL ROL DE  CRM & Loyalty Manager  Actualmente buscamos una persona apasionada por el cliente, los datos y la fidelización para liderar la estrategia CRM y Loyalty de nuestras marcas en España y México. Tendrás la oportunidad de diseñar experiencias personalizadas, desarrollar campañas innovadoras y convertir el conocimiento del consumidor en iniciativas que impulsen el crecimiento, la recurrencia y el vínculo emocional con nuestras marcas.   Entre Sus Funciones Principales Destacan     Diseñar y liderar la estrategia de CRM y fidelización para nuestras marcas en España y México, impulsando la recurrencia, el engagement y el valor de nuestros clientes.  Crear, planificar y ejecutar campañas de comunicación personalizadas a través de email marketing, app, push notifications y otros canales, optimizando la experiencia del cliente en cada punto de contacto.  Desarrollar estrategias avanzadas de segmentación y personalización, adaptando ofertas, promociones y contenidos a los intereses y hábitos de consumo de cada cliente.  Liderar y desarrollar al equipo, impulsando las mejores prácticas en customer journeys, automatización y marketing relacional para maximizar la conversión y el impacto comercial.  Analizar el comportamiento de los clientes y los principales KPIs de fidelización para identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, mejora de la experiencia y aumento de la vinculación con las marcas.  Transformar los datos en insights accionables, elaborando presentaciones y recomendaciones estratégicas para la Dirección que ayuden a impulsar la toma de decisiones.  Identificar y liderar mejoras en las herramientas de CRM, automatización y gestión de campañas, coordinando proveedores y garantizando su evolución y correcto funcionamiento.  Desarrollar nuevas alianzas y acuerdos con partners estratégicos que aporten valor diferencial y experiencias relevantes para nuestros clie

title: Team Leader Marketing Customer Base
description: Sobre la posición:   Responsable del proceso íntegro de definición, ejecución y desarrollo de la estrategia para toda la cartera de clientes Segmento Low Cost.  Responsable de definir los ciclos de vida de cliente, participar de los procesos necesarios para implementarlos, definición de momentos de la verdad, comunicaciones con cliente y desarrollo de campañas para fidelizar a los clientes y maximizar el ARPU. Definición de políticas de fidelización y retención. Responsable de las plataformas de bajas y retención.  Responsable de definir, ejecutar y asegurar la entrega de la estrategia completa de comunicaciones para los clientes del segmento en cada producto. Asimismo, gestionarás las comunicaciones del ciclo de vida transaccional.   FUNCIONES   El rol de  Team Leader de Cartela de Clientes  tiene asociada las siguientes responsabilidades:    Definición de ciclos de vida para cada una de las etapas de cliente. Especificación de requisitos y participación en el diseño e implementación de los procesos necesarios para garantizar la experiencia de cliente   Análisis de posicionamiento de clientes, por tipología, tipo de producto, área geográfica…  Análisis y gestión de KPIs de cartera: Convergencia, permanencias, antigüedad de cliente, ARPUs…  Definición y ejecución de la estrategia de Churn: que abarca desde el seguimiento diario de la evolución de éste, el diseño de las políticas de retención y puesta en marcha de acciones en los diferentes canales para la prevención y blindaje de la cartera   Definir y elaborar campañas sobre la cartera de clientes para incrementar la fidelización, cross sell y up sell, gestión del ARPU…  Diseño de políticas de fidelización y retención   Gestión de Plataformas de Bajas   Diseñar y gestionar el programa de fidelización. Coordinar la implementación operativa de iniciativas y comunicación con terceros y proveedores   Monitorizar resultados y proponer mejoras continuas en la estrategia y ejecución de las iniciativas       ¿Qué necesitamos??     Titulación universitaria en ADE, Marketing, Ingeniería, Telecomunicaciones o similar   Experiencia previa en gestión de productos o desarrollo de propuestas comerciales   Capacidad analítica, orientación a resultados y visión de negocio, e implementación de acciones de mejora  Experiencia en trabajo transversal y coordinación con múltiples áreas   Se valorará conocimiento del mercado y la competencia  Experiencia en elaboración de Business cases y lanzamiento de productos   Experiencia en seguimiento de actividad comercial, gestión de canal o ejecución de acciones comerciales   Orientación a resultados y capacidad para impulsar iniciativas de negocio   Capacidad de organización y seguimiento de múltiples acciones simultáneamente   Habilidad para trabajar con equipos comerciales y coordinar acciones con distintos interlocutores       ¿Qué te ofrecemos?    🌍 Trabajo flexible: 60% desde casa y 40% desde la oficina, ¡con horario flexible!  🏡 20 días adicionales de teletrabajo:

title: CRM戦略推進マネージャー｜マーケティング部新設・執行役員直下のやりがい◆業界トップシェア｜在宅可
description: 【企業名】 株式会社あさひ  【職種名】 CRM戦略推進マネージャー｜マーケティング部新設・執行役員直下のやりがい◆業界トップシェア｜在宅可  【仕事内容(概要)】 CRM戦略推進マネージャー｜マーケティング部新設・執行役員直下のやりがい◆業界トップシェア｜在宅可  【具体的な仕事内容】 ＜圧倒的なシェアを誇るリーディングカンパニー／CRM強化を経営テーマに、マーケティング部新設を推進する中核ポジション＞  ■募集背景 同社は、全国に500店舗超を展開する自転車専門店として、多くのお客様との接点を持っています。 一方で、アプリ・EC・SNS・ホームページなど複数の顧客接点や会員データを保有しているものの、それぞれが十分に連携できておらず、顧客理解やCRM活用には大きな伸びしろがあります。  そこで今回、マーケティング機能を再編し、新たなマーケティング部を立ち上げます。 その中でも重要な「デジタルマーケティングセクション」のマネジャーポジションについて、即戦力を募集します。 顧客データを活用したCRM戦略の推進を中心に、アプリ・SNS・EC・Webサイトを横断した顧客体験の構築を担っていただきます。  ■仕事内容 ・CRM戦略の企画立案および実行 ・会員データを活用した顧客コミュニケーション設計 ・アプリ、EC、SNS、ホームページ等の顧客接点管理 ・デジタルマーケティング施策の効果測定および改善 ・顧客データ分析、KPI設計 ・CRM基盤構築プロジェクト推進 ・ベンダー選定、ディレクション ・チームマネジメント ・ブランドマーケティング、販売企画、店舗部門との連携 ※現在は顧客データ整理が進んでおり、今後本格的な実装フェーズへ移行予定です。 入社後はCRM領域の中核メンバーとして、プロジェクトを牽引いただくことを期待します。  ■ポジションの魅力 （1）同社の規模感で、既存運用の改善ではなく、CRM戦略やデータ活用の仕組みそのものを設計できる （2）組織立ち上げメンバーとして、チームづくりや育成にも携わる （3）経営（役員）直下にて、戦略立案から実行まで裁量を持って取り組む （4）マーケティング強化は経営の重点テーマであり、必要な投資は積極的に行う方針 （4）アプリ・EC・SNS・店舗をつなぎ、顧客との新たな関係構築を実現  ■組織構成 ・2027年より新たなマーケティング部を立ち上げ予定 title: Customer Quality Manager
description: Job description:   We are looking for a  Customer Quality Manager  to join our Products and Technologies organization within Vaisala Industrial Measurements, at our headquarters in Vantaa, Finland. This is a strategic, highly visible role: you'll turn field and customer insight into real product decisions, and unite R&D, Operations, Service and Sales around shared customer quality goals.      Vaisala is a global leader in measurement instruments and intelligence helping industries, nations, people, and the planet to thrive. From predicting hurricanes to optimizing renewable energy production, our technology is used where it matters the most – from data centers, windfarms and laboratories to airports, the Arctic and even the surface of Mars. For a second year running, Vaisala got recognized in TIME Magazine's World's Best Companies in Sustainable Growth 2026 study. Our team of close to 2,500 experts and 62 nationalities around the world is committed to taking every measure for the planet. Driven by our shared purpose, curiosity, and pioneering spirit, we stay ahead and make a difference. At Vaisala, you don't have to fit in to belong.         Why join us?     •    Join a growing, profitable business at the heart of critical industries like semiconductors, data centers, batteries, power transmission and life sciences. •    Work with market-leading products, backed by continuous innovation and strong investment in new development. •    Take on a genuinely end-to-end, cross-functional role spanning the full value chain, in close partnership with the business.          What's your role?     You will be part of our Products and Technologies organization, working alongside experienced, cross-functional professionals in R&D and product management. Together, you will have an excellent opportunity to define what quality means for our customers, and make sure that what we learn from the field – complaints, returns and failures – is turned into real improvements in our products, processes and ways of working. You'll work closely with R&D, Operations/Manufacturing, Service & Support, Sales/Account management, and the wider Quality organization. You will report to Vice President, VIM Products and Technologies.    •    Own customer quality requirements and be the trusted, customer-facing voice on quality — including negotiating quality agreements.  •    Own complaint handling and the 8D process end-to-end: lead the cases that matter and keep every ticket moving to closure.  •    Lead root cause analyses and equip teams with structured problem-solving tools.  •    Turn returns and failure data into strategic input for R&D and product management — this is what sets the role apart: your insight shapes design decisions and the roadmap, not just closes tickets.  •    Prepare and host customer audits, and drive closure on internal audit findings.  •    Drive yield improvements with Operations and R&D, and continuously sharpen our q

title: Product Coordinator (Manager)

Deine Herausforderung    Führung, Teamintegration und Veränderung (ca. 30–40%)    Du führst und entwickelst ein Team von ca. 10–12 Mitarbeitenden und begleitest das Zusammenwachsen der beiden bisherigen Servicecenter zu einer gemeinsamen Einheit.  In der Veränderungsphase schaffst du Orientierung, klärst Verantwortlichkeiten und stärkst eine gemeinsame, wertschätzende Teamkultur.  Bestehendes Fach- und Prozesswissen sicherst du gezielt und begleitest Veränderungen bei Rollen, Aufgaben und Kapazitäten transparent, empathisch und verbindlich.  Ziele, Leistung und Entwicklung steuerst du verbindlich. Konflikte gehst du frühzeitig und konstruktiv an.    Operative Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung (ca. 50%)    Du stellst sicher, dass das Tagesgeschäft und die im Servicekatalog definierten Leistungen zuverlässig, termingerecht und in der geforderten Qualität erbracht werden.  Du setzt die harmonisierten Prozesse um und entwickelst sie kontinuierlich weiter. Qualität, Mengen und Kapazitäten steuerst du anhand geeigneter Kennzahlen.  Gemeinsam mit den Fachbereichen entwickelst du den Servicekatalog entlang der strategischen Ziele weiter. Zudem verantwortest du Budget und Controlling deiner Kostenstelle.  Du treibst Digitalisierung und Automatisierung voran, insbesondere bei der automatisierten Dokumentenzuordnung und einer neuen digitalen Posteingangslösung. Dabei übernimmst du fachlich die Product-Owner-Rolle und arbeitest gemeinsam mit der internen Applikationsverantwortlichen in der IT.    Steuerung externer Partner (ca. 10–20%)    Du steuerst die externen Partnerunternehmen für Posteingang, Archiv, Druck und Postausgang und stellst gute Übergaben sicher.  Leistungsvorgaben, Mengen, Fristen und Qualität überwachst du anhand von Kennzahlen und Auswertungen. Bei Abweichungen leitest du konkrete Verbesserungen ein.  Die Zusammenarbeit entwickelst du zu einem professionellen Lieferan

title: Customer Service Manager
description: Overview della posizione    Sede:  Assago (MI)   Contratto:  Full Time – Tempo Indeterminato   Retribuzione:  Fino a 40.000€ + Bonus annuale + Ticket Restaurant     Se cerchi un ruolo in cui la tua funzione è una delle leve strategiche per la crescita aziendale, Horizon Automotive è il contesto ideale per mettere in gioco le tue competenze e contribuire a un progetto innovativo.      Chi siamo   Horizon Automotive, società Gruppo Facile.it, è la principale Tech Mobility Company e il più grande aggregatore di mobilità in Italia. Fondata nel 2020, opera con un approccio Phygital, collaborando con le Case Automobilistiche (OEM) e 11 partner di Noleggio a Lungo Termine (NLT). Vanta una rete distributiva composta da 70 Dealer soci e 20 Horizon Store. In soli quattro anni ha venduto 18.000 auto e conta su un team in crescita di circa 80 persone. Scopri di più su www.horizonautomotive.com      Chi cerchiamo   Per il potenziamento del dipartimento Operations & Mobility Services presso la nostra sede centrale di Assago siamo alla ricerca di un Customer Service Project Manager che, riportando all’ Head of Operations & Mobility Services e in stretta collaborazione con tutti i dipartimenti interni e con i fornitori esterni, avrà l’obiettivo di progettare, avviare e mantenere il servizio di assistenza clienti. Partendo dall’analisi delle esigenze e delle richieste oggi gestite dalla forza vendita, definirà processi, strumenti e modello di servizio, coordinando un partner esterno. Valuterà soluzioni basate su strumenti digitali, operatori o un modello integrato, con l’obiettivo di migliorare l’esperienza del cliente.      Di cosa ti occuperai    Analizzare le richieste dei clienti e mappare i processi attuali con Sales e Operations, identificando volumi, casistiche ricorrenti, criticità e attività di competenza dei noleggiatori.  Definire con l’Head of Operations & Mobility Services il perimetro e il modello del servizio, valutando canali digitali ed eventuali operatori in funzione di esigenze, qualità attesa e sostenibilità operativa.  Disegnare i flussi di presa in carico, risposta ed escalation, chiarendo responsabilità e passaggi tra partner esterno e reparti interni.  Coordinare il progetto di avvio: tradurre le esigenze in requisiti, concordare attività, tempi e livelli di servizio, organizzare test e verificare la qualità del servizio al lancio.  Definire procedure, contenuti di assistenza e requisiti di CRM e ticketing con i referenti coinvolti, assicurando tracciabilità delle richieste e coerenza delle risposte.  Fornire indicazioni e procedure precise per la forza vendita interna nell’adozione dei nuovi canali; coordinare il fornitore e le eventuali risorse dedicate, monitorandone attività e prestazioni.  Raccogliere feedback e analizzare i KPI per migliorare il servizio dopo l’avvio; contribuire, nelle successive evoluzioni, a strutturare le interfacce con le società di noleggio.       Quali esperienze e requisiti ti chiediamo    Esp

title: Chargé de clientèle
description: Contexte :       RENATER recrute un chargé de clientèle qui est l’interlocuteur privilégié des établissements utilisateurs de la communauté Enseignement Supérieur et Recherche : établissements publics, réseaux d’accès en régions, infrastructures de recherche et datacentres publics. Vous accompagnez les clients dans leurs besoins et contribuez à leur satisfaction sur l’ensemble du cycle de vie de la relation, en assurant le suivi technique (en lien avec les équipes métiers) et administratif des prestations fournies (essentiellement dans les réseaux de télécommunications et les services numériques collaboratifs).      Compétences professionnelles :       • Maîtrise des techniques de relation client, d’écoute et de conseil ;  • Bonnes capacités rédactionnelles et organisationnelles ;  • Maîtrise des outils bureautiques et collaboratifs (ticketing, CRM, suivi d’activité).      Aptitudes professionnelles :       • Aisance relationnelle et sens du service client ;  • Appétence appréciée du secteur informatique en général ;  • Diplomatie, pédagogie et capacité d’adaptation ;  • Esprit d’équipe et capacité à travailler en transversal ;  • Rigueur et autonomie dans le suivi des dossiers.      Formation :       • Bac +2 minimum, avec expérience dans la relation client, le support ou la gestion de comptes, idéalement dans un environnement numérique ou éducation-recherche ;  • Niveau équivalent à la branche d’activité professionnelle (BAP) du RÉFérentiel des Emplois-types de la Recherche et de l'Enseignement Supérieur : E4X41 - Technicien-ne d'exploitation, d'assistance et de traitement de l'information.      Conditions et avanatages :       • Possibilité de télétravailler de 1 à 2 jours flexibles par semaine ;  • Environnement de travail polyvalent au sein d’une équipe à taille humaine ;  • Protection sociale complémentaire attractive :  o Participation employeur de 70% pour la mutuelle et de 100% pour la prévoyance ;  o Retraite sur-complémentaire avec une participation employeur de 75% (pour les CDI) ;  • 25 jours ouvrés de congés payés et 23 jours de RTT ;  • Lieu de travail agréable dans le 13ème arrondissement de Paris ;  • Titres-restaurant avec une participation employeur de 60% ;  • Compléments de formation possibles à l’entrée en fonction.      Détail des missions :       • Accueillir, écouter et analyser les besoins des utilisateurs des réseaux et services RENATER ;  • Conseiller et proposer des solutions adaptées à partir du catalogue de services RENATER ;  • Accompagner la mise en œuvre et la mise en service des solutions ;  • Assurer le suivi de la satisfaction et de la qualité de service, via notamment les outils utilisés pour le support utilisateurs, et l’organisation de comités ad-hoc, de visites terrain et autres évènements dédiés ;  • Réaliser le suivi administratif de la relation client en lien avec les services de la DGS : conventions, bons de commande, facturation, reporting etc... ;  • Contribuer à la mise à jour des bases de donné

description: Über uns   Intonate ist ein Tech-Startup aus Zürich mit einer klaren Mission: Wir wollen die neuesten Entwicklungen im Bereich der Künstlichen Intelligenz nutzen, um das europäische Gesundheitssystem nachhaltig zu verbessern.     Unsere Technologie reduziert den administrativen Aufwand im medizinischen Alltag. Intonate erstellt medizinische Berichte in Echtzeit – direkt aus Arzt-Patienten-Gesprächen und integriert in führende Praxis- und Klinikinformationssysteme. So gewinnen Ärzt:innen mehr Zeit für das, was wirklich zählt: ihre Patient:innen.     Wenn du die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens aktiv mitgestalten, Verantwortung übernehmen und gemeinsam mit einem ambitionierten Gründerteam etwas aufbauen möchtest, bist du bei uns richtig.     Wer bei Intonate einsteigt, entscheidet sich für drei Dinge:       Wir übernehmen Verantwortung:  Verantwortung zählt mehr als Titel, Ergebnisse mehr als Absichten.   Wir streben nach Exzellenz:  Wir setzen hohe Standards und geben direktes, konstruktives und egofreies Feedback.   Wir wachsen gemeinsam:  als Team und zusammen mit unseren Kund:innen.      Unsere Mission steht über dem Ego. Alle leisten ihren Beitrag, übernehmen Verantwortung und gestalten die Zukunft von Intonate aktiv mit.      Deine Aufgaben   Als zentrale Ansprechperson für Customer Success bringst du die Zufriedenheit und den Erfolg unserer Kund:innen auf ein neues Niveau. Du begleitest medizinische Institutionen von den ersten Gesprächen über das Onboarding bis zur langfristigen Nutzung unserer Lösung.  Dabei arbeitest du eng mit dem Gründerteam von Intonate sowie mit Entscheidungsträger:innen in Arztpraxen und Kliniken zusammen. Du stellst sicher, dass unsere Kund:innen den grösstmöglichen Nutzen aus Intonate ziehen, und trägst entscheidend dazu bei, unsere Präsenz in der Schweiz und darüber hinaus auszubauen.      Was du bei uns bewegst       Kund:innen erfolgreich machen   Du begleitest neue Kund:innen durch den gesamten Onboarding-Prozess und führst massgeschneiderte Trainings durch. Dabei stellst du sicher, dass Intonate schnell, sicher und gewinnbringend in den medizinischen Alltag integriert wird.  Du bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für fachliche und produktspezifische Fragen und sorgst für einen schnellen, verlässlichen und hochwertigen Support.      Langfristige Beziehungen aufbauen   Du entwickelst vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Stakeholdern in Arztpraxen und Kliniken. Durch regelmässige Check-ins, Feedbackgespräche und Produkt-Updates stellst du sicher, dass wir die Bedürfnisse unserer Kund:innen verstehen und langfristig erfüllen.  Du übersetzt das Feedback unserer Nutzer:innen in konkrete Erkenntnisse und arbeitest eng mit dem Produktteam zusammen, um Intonate kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.      Intonate überzeugend präsentieren   Du identifizierst relevante Entscheidungsträger:innen in medizinischen Institutionen und sprichst sie gezielt an.  In Produktdemos, Präsentationen und persönlichen Gesprächen vermittel

description: We’re looking for entry level graduates, non-graduates and career changers as Tangent’s network grows globally across Europe. The starting salary is €30-€60k + commission.      What is Tangent      Tangent has created a new way to apply for jobs where industry expert mentors already working in the best companies provide free mentoring and support through the application process. On Tangent jobseekers sign-up and then connect with mentors for help with their CV, applications, industry advice and even support with salary negotiations. In today’s job market it’s almost impossible to get hired without the help of a mentor, they’ve been through the process in their career and want to give back by volunteering.     Tangent is a social impact platform built to help socially diverse backgrounds break into tech. Only 9% of tech employees come from low socioeconomic backgrounds, despite them making up 39% of the total population! That's worse than law, consulting and banking! We’re on a mission to change this and we need your help! title: Talent Programs Lead
description:
Grove Collaborative is a sustainability-focused consumer products company creating household and personal care essentials that are effective, beautifully designed, and healthier for people and the planet. We are a certified B Corp, plastic-neutral, and on a mission to transform the CPG industry for good.

Most companies can't tell you why one person is a Senior and another isn't, or what either one should be paid. We're hiring the person who makes Grove able to answer that — and then builds the programs that make the answer real.

The Pitch

  • Grove is rebuilding its leveling guidelines from the ground up. Not adjusting bands — defining what a level actually means, across every function, in a company that looks nothing like it did two years ago. You'll help shape that framework alongside the Director of PX and People Ops leadership, and you'll own getting it out into the company and making it stick.
  • We want comp analysis that arrives with the data already attached. Benchmark the role, build the band, model the offer, show your work. Leaders should be able to act on your recommendation without relitigating it.
  • We want onboarding and talent management that actually connect. A new hire should know what their level means in week one, and their manager should know what growth into the next one looks like.
  • On recruiting: talent acquisition is a small part of this role. You'll run a search when a req opens, and your hiring judgment matters — but reqs are episodic here, and the programs are the job. If you're looking for a full-cycle recruiting seat, this isn't it.
  • The honest version: this is a lot of program surface area for one person, held together by judgment and leverage rather than headcount. That's the trade. You get unusual scope, unusual autonomy, and a direct line to decisions that normally sit two levels up. You don't get a team to hand it to.
  • If you need the process to already exist before you can work, this will be miserable. If you've spent your career being the person who builds the thing that was missing, this is the seat.

What You'd Actually Do

  • Run Grove's compensation analysis (in partnership with Director of People Experience) — benchmark roles against market survey data, build and maintain bands, model offers and internal equity, and bring leaders a recommendation they can act on.
  • Help build Grove's leveling framework and own the rollout: train managers, calibrate real roles against it, answer the hard edge cases, and maintain it as the company changes.
  • Own onboarding end to end, so a new hire's first ninety days are structured, useful, and consistent no matter which team they land on.
  • Administer talent management programs — performance cycles, calibration, career pathing, and development planning — so growth conversations are grounded in the leveling framework instead of vibes.

About Ceros

At Ceros, you’ll help ambitious brands create digital experiences that people actually want to explore. Our platform gives marketers and designers the flexibility to design, build, and publish immersive content. All without code. With Ceros, teams move faster, scale smarter, and deliver work that makes a real impact.

Sr. SDRs at Ceros are high-performing outbound sellers who blend grit, creativity, and AI-powered tools to build pipeline at scale. Having mastered the core skills of the Outbound SDR role, you are now ready to operate at the intersection of human strategy and machine efficiency.

Functionally, you are given full autonomy to drive opportunities within your pipeline through proactive outbound prospecting. You will be responsible for managing AI agents - helping to build, test, and refine their outputs - while sharing fresh insights to help the team evolve. You aren't just using ChatGPT to "fix your grammar"; you are a curious architect of AI workflows, comfortable oscillating between 5-6 different AI-driven platforms to amplify your output.

Your role will work closely with New Business Directors to help them close and win business on a set of industry-specific target accounts. While you are responsible for the top of funnel pipeline sourcing, your NBD will focus on running calls and closing deals.

This role is designed for those who have ambition to progress into Sales, Customer Success, or Strategic Accounts within 12-24 months by demonstrating they can lead in the new era of AI-integrated sales. This is a fully outbound SDR role.

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
At Dscout, we’re building the most flexible and powerful UX research platform on the market—trusted by the world’s top brands in finance (JP Morgan Chase, Intuit, Charles Schwab, PayPal), healthcare (Aya, Headspace), consumer goods (Keen, Verizon, Target, Northface), and tech (Google, Amazon, Facebook, Meta, Spotify, AirBnB). Our tools help teams deeply understand the humans behind their products, so they can build better ones. We are expanding our smart and driven team and would love for you to join us.

We are always looking for Sales Development Representatives and we would enjoy hearing from you! Submit your resume and our Recruiting Team will review it. When an opportunity arises, and if there is a fit, you will hear from us. This means that you will only hear from us in case we have an opportunity that matches your profile.

The SDR, Strategic Accounts is responsible for generating new business opportunities across both prospective and existing customer accounts. The role focuses on strategic account development, identifying high-value opportunities within complex organizations and creating meaningful engagement with the right stakeholders.

For prospective accounts, the SDR owns outbound prospecting efforts to identify and create new opportunities within high-priority strategic accounts. This includes researching accounts, identifying key stakeholders and buying groups, leveraging intent and account signals, and developing personalized outreach that creates meaningful sales conversations.

For customer accounts, the focus shifts toward expansion. The SDR partners closely with Account Directors and other customer-facing teams to identify whitespace, new teams or business units, additional use cases, and other signals that may indicate an opportunity for growth. The SDR helps create new relationships within existing customers and generates qualified expansion opportunities for the account team.

Across both motions, the SDR is expected to take an account-based approach rather than simply prospecting individual contacts. This means understanding the broader organization, mapping relevant stakeholders, identifying business priorities and potential use cases, and coordinating outreach across multiple personas where appropriate.

The role also supports strategic account planning by surfacing relevant insights, engagement signals, and prospect intelligence that can help Account Directors prioritize where to focus their efforts.

Core responsibilities include:

  • Prospect into high-priority strategic accounts to create net-new business opportunities.
  • Identify and engage decision-makers, influencers, champions, and other members of relevant buying groups.
  • Develop account and stakeholder maps to understand organizational structure, priorities, and potential opportunities.

title: Customer Success Manager
description: Customer Success Manager       Are you skilled in driving meaningful engagement to achieve client success?       Would you like to join a company that helps advance science, technology and health?       About our Team      Our Academic & Government team helps our communities accelerate knowledge for a better world by helping to establish, discover and advance knowledge. We do this by turning scientific discoveries into peer reviewed knowledge, hosting the world’s richest corpus of knowledge, allowing users to unlock insights from content and by measuring the quality and impact of research - turning insights into outcomes.      About the role      Customer Success Managers are the primary post-sales point of contact for customers. As such, they are responsible for onboarding, enablement, and value realization across Solutions and Research Sales portfolios and are expected to be fluent in all portfolio offerings. They work closely with Account Managers, Account Support, and other support functions to ensure strategic goals within the account are achieved. For certain product sets, they may coordinate with a technical onboarding team during implementation, after which they become the main point of contact through adoption, ongoing engagement, and renewal.     The Customer Success Manager (CSM) is focused on customer engagement, success, and satisfaction in adopting Elsevier solutions. The CSM serves as a trusted advisor to customers while protecting the existing revenue base and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities. The primary role of a CSM is to drive value realization and effective use of solutions and products to ensure successful adoption, continuously improve customer satisfaction, and maximize customer outcomes. Their focus is on customer retention, renewal growth, and identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities, supported by trainer, implementation, and consulting functions.      Responsibilities        Build and Nurture Customer Relationships -  Establish trusted partnerships, identify and develop champions, facilitate feedback between customers and product teams, and address organizational requirements and queries.   Drive Customer Satisfaction & Success -  Deliver tailored value stories, demonstrate ROI, and reinforce the benefits of digital solutions to enhance customer engagement.   Support Retention & Renewal -  Collaborate with Sales to highlight value, address customer needs, and advocate for solution renewals.   Identify Cross-sell & Upsell Opportunities -  Analyze customer data and ambitions to uncover growth opportunities, adding value through personalized insights and experience.   Deliver Scalable Digital Training -  Conduct effective online and face-to-face training sessions, including product demos and workshops, aligned with customer needs.   Foster Cross-Functional Collaboration -  Share success stories, insights, and best practices across customer-facing teams and the broader organization

title: Manager Customer Care (MT)
description: Met jou als aanvoerder richting een optimale klantbeleving   PinkRoccade Informatievoorziening levert software waar ruim 200 gemeenten dagelijks op vertrouwen. Wij stellen gemeenten in staat een betrouwbaar antwoord te bieden op elke informatievraag – of die nu van een inwoner of een ambtenaar komt. Hiervoor leveren we oplossingen om informatie veilig en verantwoord uit te wisselen. Innovatieve technologie en veranderende wetgeving stellen hieraan steeds weer nieuwe eisen.      De impact van jouw werk   Als Manager Customer Care ben je verantwoordelijk voor een cruciaal onderdeel van onze organisatie: de manier waarop ruim 200 gemeenten onze dienstverlening dagelijks ervaren.  Je stapt in een goed functionerende operatie met een betrokken team en een stevige basis. Je gaat deze organisatie verder ontwikkelen naar een volwassen, klantgerichte en proactieve dienstverlening. Je brengt daarin structuur, scherpt de manier van werken aan en zorgt dat klanten consistent, professioneel en voorspelbaar worden ondersteund.     De rol biedt ruimte om daadwerkelijk impact te maken op de kwaliteit van dienstverlening en klantbeleving. Je vertaalt signalen uit naar structurele verbeteringen in de keten en zorgt dat Customer Care een stevige en zichtbare positie inneemt richting productmanagement, development, projectmanagement en het managementteam.  Tegelijkertijd bouw je verder aan een team dat zich ontwikkelt, kennis opbouwt en steeds zelfstandiger opereert. Je creëert een werkwijze waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en continue verbetering centraal staan.     Je doet dit in een organisatie die volop in ontwikkeling is, waar ruimte is om keuzes te maken en waar je als MT-lid direct invloed hebt op de richting en het resultaat.  Wat je concreet doet  Je bouwt aan een optimale customer experience met jouw team die bekendstaat om haar voorspelbare dienstverlening, heldere communicatie en sterke klantgerichtheid. Door signalen uit de dagelijkse praktijk om te zetten in verbeteringen, versterk je zowel de kwaliteit van de dienstverlening, de zelfstandigheid van het team en de duurzaamheid van klantrelaties.       Om klantverwachtingen te overtreffen    stuur je op een klantbeleving waarin heldere communicatie, eigenaarschap en proactieve ondersteuning centraal staan en benut je signalen als aanjager voor verbetering van dienstverlening en ontwikkeling richting customer success.  borg je een stabiele en voorspelbare operatie door actief te sturen op processen, prioriteiten en keuzes binnen en tussen teams.  zorg je voor een dienstverlening waarin klanten zich geholpen en geïnformeerd voelen, servicelevels worden gerealiseerd en klantgerichte ondersteuning centraal staat. Kwaliteit, continuïteit en verdere ontwikkeling van de dienstverlening staan bij jou centraal.       Je werkt niet alleen   Je maakt onderdeel uit van het managementteam en werkt nauw samen met 2 Team Leads, 6 Customer Care specialisten, 4 consultants Functioneel beheer (4 FTE) en de Service

Manage program communications, including announcements, newsletters, founder updates, and the internal knowledge base. title: Kommunvägledare/samordnare
description: Då vår nuvarande samordnare går vidare till nytt uppdrag söker vi nu en ny kollega till vårt  kontaktcenter.     Din roll     Som kommunvägledare/samordnare ansvarar du för den dagliga driften i kontaktcenter, samordning och utveckling.     Det innebär bland annat att:   leda, fördela och följa upp arbetsuppgifter.  coacha och stötta övriga kommunvägledare i deras arbete.  dagligen hantera ärenden som rör bemanning och hur det påverkar den dagliga driften.  arbeta med schemaläggning, planering vid frånvaro och kontakt med vikarier.  med hjälp av statistik, analys och dagliga insikter följa upp arbetet i kontaktcenter och stämma av med kommunens verksamheter.  utveckla arbetet med medborgarservice och kontaktcenters uppdrag i de olika verksamheterna.  planera och genomföra utbildningsinsatser för såväl kommunvägledarna som för kommunens verksamheter.  samordna införandet av nya och förändrade uppgifter i kontaktcenter.   En viss del av ditt uppdrag innebär även att tillsammans med övriga kommunvägledare besvara frågor som kommer in till kommunen via telefon, e-tjänster och mejl. Du tar emot besökare till kommunhusets reception och hjälper dem med deras ärenden samt arbetar med support av kommunens självservicetjänster. Du kommer även hantera en mängd information i våra olika verksamhetssystem samt utföra viss handläggning inom olika områden. Allt arbete i kontaktcenter sker i nära samarbete med verksamheterna och övriga kommunvägledare.    Tjänsten innefattar inte något personalansvar då detta ansvar ligger hos enhetschefen på Kommunikationsenheten där kontaktcenter ingår.      Din kunskap och erfarenhet       Vi söker dig som:    har eftergymnasial utbildning inom ekonomi, samhälls­vetenskap, IT eller annan teoretisk inriktning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.  har arbetslivserfarenhet av arbete med kundkontakter/medborgarkontakter och kommunikation.   förstår värdet av god kommunikation och har lätt för att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på både svenska och engelska.  har vana av arbete i olika IT-relaterade system.  har erfarenhet av teamarbete och en mycket god förmåga att samarbeta och bygga relationer.  har förmåga att arbeta strukturerat och med tydlighet.  kan agera lugnt och samlat även i stressiga situationer.  har arbetat med och är intresserad av grupp- och verksamhetsutveckling.  har ett gott bemötande, naturlig serviceanda och ett flexibelt och lösningsfokuserat förhållningssätt.     Det är meriterande om du har viss erfarenhet av arbetsledning och beslutsfattande. Har du arbetat i en offentlig organisation ser vi även det som meriterande.    Vi vill att du i ditt personliga brev anger vad god kundservice innebär för dig och vad ditt främsta bidrag skulle vara i din nya roll.    Stor vikt kommer läggas vid personlig lämplighet. Olika former av tester kan bli aktuellt vid rekryteringen. Även provanställning kan komma att tillämpas.    Har du frågor kring lön, kontakta rekryterande chef.     Din arbetsplats     Kontaktcentr

Totalt marknadsför Biltema mer än 19 000 artiklar. Våra värdeord Enkelhet, Sparsamhet, Handlingskraft, Ordning och Reda samt Flexibilitet genomsyrar hela vår verksamhet. Precis som övrig ledningsgrupp arbetar du även praktiskt tillsammans med teamet i både café, kundservice och i varuhuset.  Du leder dina medarbetare genom din närvaro i den dagliga driften och säkerställer att de är väl utbildade i rutiner för kundbemötande, reklamationshantering och kontanthantering. I caféet ansvarar du för övergripande försäljning, livsmedelshygien och att övriga regelverk efterlevs. Du arbetar nära varuhuschefen i den gemensamma uppgiften att driva varuhuset framåt.  Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning som inleds med 6 månaders provanställning. Sysselsättningen är heltid, 40 timmar/veckan. Eller så har du arbetat i ledande befattning med ansvar för personal, försäljning eller drift, utan att vara ytterst ansvarig, men känner dig nu redo för att ta nästa steg i din utveckling. En förutsättning är att du är trygg i ditt ledarskap, van att fatta beslut och har ett starkt driv att utveckla både människor och rutiner.  Det är meriterande om du har arbetat med kundservice och kassa tidigare, men det viktigaste är att du har en god förståelse för hur man skapar effektiva team genom ett inkluderande och tydligt ledarskap som leder till hög servicekvalitet. Through real-time interactivity and clear visualizations, we get people to participate, engage and become more productive. Transforming all those passive meetings, airless classrooms and drawn out trainings into valuable and memorable moments.  We truly believe that you achieve the best results by doing things together. And that successful leaders need to adopt a curious and collaborative mindset in order to get there. So with you at Mentimeter, you’ll be a big part of the ambition to help over 1 billion people listen, learn and work better together. They own the negotiation; you help make the case worth saying yes to.  Higher Education has its own rhythm. You’ll work with lecturers, administrators and faculty leaders across departments and campuses, navigating academic years, different stakeholder groups and different levels of adoption.  We’re looking for someone proactive, commercially minded and genuinely curious about their customers – someone who gets energy from seeing what could be better and making it happen. title: Technical Account Manager
description: Avnet Abacus   Avnet Abacus is a pan-European distributor committed to supporting customers from design to fulfilment. Avnet Abacus is a regional business unit of Avnet with European headquarters in Belgium (Avnet Europe Comm. VA). Do you have experience supporting product development, design activities or electronics solutions? If so, Avnet Abacus has an exciting opportunity to join our team in Finland, combining technical expertise with customer engagement and business development.   What is in it for you?   Along with offering a competitive salary package, we also offer:    A supportive team environment where everyone really is working toward the same goal. title: Serviceleder til rengøring ved Forsvarets Etablissementer i København

description: Vi søger en erfaren serviceleder til København. Har du lyst til at gøre en forskel for medarbejdere og gæster på Forsvarets Etablissementer? Er du serviceminded og fleksibel leder, og besidder stor fagekspertise indenfor rengøringsområdet, så er du måske en af vores nye serviceledere i København.   Om os   Forsvarets Etablissement- og Terrænkommando leverer og udvikler de fysiske rammer for de militære operative enheder og de øvrige myndigheder under Forsvarsministeriet. Det gælder alt fra vedligehold af bygninger og arealer, sovepladser til soldaterne, skriveborde til kontorer, mad i kantinerne og rengøringsservice  Forsvaret har flere store faciliteter i København og omegn. Bl.a. Svanemøllens Kaserne, Nyholm, Kastellet, Frederiksberg Slot, Forsvarsministeriet og Forsvarskommandoen på Holmens kanal og hertil en del større og mindre faciliteter, som ligeledes understøttes af Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoen.  Disse understøttes af flere decentrale partnerelementer i Københavnsområdet, og Etablissement- og Terrænkommandoens rengøringsteams i København støtter disse partnerelementer med facility management opgaver inden for rengøring.   Om stillingen   Rengøringsområdet på Forsvarets Etablissementer i København er organiseret ud fra en model, hvor samtlige rengøringsassistenter er organiseret under én organisation, således der kan prioriteres og lægges tyngde i rengøringen på tværs af de forskellige faciliteter og partnerelementer. Den enkelte medarbejder har som udgangspunkt faste opgaver og steder, men for at sikre en ensartet service så vil der til tider være behov for midlertidige omfordelinger.  Til at lede dette er der to serviceledere som står for den formelle ledelse, tilrettelæggelse og gennemførsel af opgaveløsningen samt at sikre den nødvendige faglighed.  Den ene stilling er nu ledig og forventes besat i forbindelse med denne rekrutteringsproces.  Ansættende og ansvarlig chef er chefen for partnerelementet på Svanemøllens Kaserne, hvor du også vil have din gang. Men arbejdsstedet er Forsvarets etablissementer i København.  Som serviceleder indenfor rengøringsområdet i Forsvarets Etablissement- og Terrænkommandofår du ikke alene et spændende job i historiske omgivelser, du er med til at kvalitetssikre driften og rengøringsservicen til vores brugere.   Du Har/er     Dokumenteret erfaring med ledelse og relevant erfaring med rengøring (minimum 3 år).  Du trives i en virksomhed, hvor to dage ikke er ens.  Du sætter en ære i, at aftaler overholdes.  Du er en teamplayer.  Du har overenskomstmæssig forståelse, og er vant til at udarbejde arbejdsplaner og forestå daglig koordinering.     Dine Kerneopgaver Er     At lede og motivere egne medarbejdere  At være Samtaleleder og følge op på indhold af samtaler, herunder Fokus, Nyløn, ansættelser, sygefravær og de svære samtaler m.v.  At sikre Budgetansvarlighed i forhold til eget timeforbrug  At varetage opgaver effektivt og professionelt, både baseret på kundeønsker og Forsvarets krav

Mit Deinem Organisationstalent und Deiner ausgeprägten Teamorientierung steuerst Du unsere Baustellen eigenverantwortlich, koordinierst interne sowie externe Teams und stellst sicher, dass Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsstandards jederzeit auf höchstem Niveau eingehalten werden. Durch Dein technisches Know-how, Deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Deine Hands-on-Mentalität leistest Du einen entscheidenden Beitrag zum erfolgreichen Abschluss unserer Projekte bis zur Übergabe der Anlage an die Betreibergesellschaft. B. title: Biotech Portfolio Lead
description: Work Schedule   Standard (Mon-Fri)   Environmental Conditions   Office  As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.   Description   As a Senior Manager, Key Accounts at Thermo Fisher Scientific, you will foster strategic growth and build lasting partnerships with our most valuable customers across multiple market segments. You will serve as the primary point of contact for key accounts, developing and executing comprehensive strategies to expand our commercial relationships while delivering exceptional value through our industry-leading portfolio of products and services.  Working in a collaborative, multi-team environment, you will partner across divisions to identify opportunities, develop innovative solutions, and ensure effective execution of account plans. You will establish and maintain executive-level relationships with customers while coordinating internal resources to achieve profitable growth and customer satisfaction. This role offers the opportunity to make a significant impact by helping our customers advance scientific discovery and improve healthcare outcomes.   Requirements      Masters Degree plus 12 years of relevant commercial experience in life sciences, healthcare, or related industries   Preferred Fields of Study: Business, Life Sciences, Engineering, or related field   Additional relevant professional certifications valued   Demonstrated success managing strategic customer relationships and achieving revenue growth   Experience working effectively in multi-team organizations   Advanced negotiation and contract management skills for complex, high-value agreements   Strong financial acumen and analytical capabilities   Excellent presentation, communication and interpersonal skills   Ability to build and maintain executive-level customer relationships   Experience coordinating cross-functional teams and resources   Proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office suite   Strategic thinking and planning capabilities with focus on results   Ability to travel 40-60% for customer engagement   Comprehensive understanding of customer needs, market dynamics and competitive landscape   Demonstrated success developing and implementing strategic account plans   Strong project management and organizational skills   Commitment to Thermo Fisher's values of Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement

title: Responsable de projet Microsoft Business Central
description: Dans le cadre du développement de son activité Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central, un intégrateur Pure Player reconnu dans l’écosystème Microsoft renforce son équipe et recrute un Chef de Projet afin de piloter plusieurs projets d’intégration et de déploiement de l’ERP.     Cette opportunité s’adresse à un profil expérimenté sur Business Central, avec une bonne maîtrise des environnements Supply Chain, souhaitant conserver une proximité avec les sujets fonctionnels tout en prenant la responsabilité de projets et des équipes associées.      Vos responsabilités   En lien avec les équipes fonctionnelles, techniques et les clients, vous assurez le pilotage de plusieurs projets Business Central en parallèle.     • Piloter deux projets majeurs Business Central, ainsi que plusieurs projets de taille plus réduite  • Prendre en charge les projets de bout en bout : cadrage, conception, suivi du paramétrage, recette, déploiement et accompagnement au démarrage  • Manager et coordonner les consultants fonctionnels et techniques ainsi que les développeurs intervenant sur vos projets  • Accompagner les clients sur leurs processus Supply Chain, notamment Achats, Ventes et Stocks  • Assurer le suivi des plannings, des charges, des budgets et des engagements projets  • Être l’interlocuteur principal des clients et garantir la qualité des projets et des livrables  • Participer aux phases de cadrage et d’avant-vente      Votre profil   Vous disposez d’une expérience confirmée sur Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central, idéalement acquise au sein d’un intégrateur ou d’un environnement conseil.     Vous avez déjà piloté des projets ERP et coordonné des équipes fonctionnelles et techniques. Vous disposez également d’une bonne compréhension des processus Supply Chain, notamment sur les périmètres Achats, Ventes et Stocks.      Rémunération jusqu’à 75 000 € brut annuel    Full Remote – France    Déplacements limités

title: Technical Solution Manager - French Speaking (all genders)

Worldwide, more than 500 customers in some 150 countries with more than 45,000 workstations already trust our know-how and proven experience.  Within our Public Transport business, we deliver mission-critical communication solutions for some of Europe's largest railway operators. Proven experience coordinating multidisciplinary engineering teams and driving technical project execution in international customer environments.   Strong understanding of software-intensive systems, system security, system integration, deployment, and operational environments.   Experience working with customers, suppliers, and distributed engineering organisations across multiple countries. title: Puestos vacantes: Jefe/a de Proyectos SAP (9969)
description: Humanizando la Tecnología.      Somos una gran empresa con alma de start-up. Nos organizamos por unidades de conocimiento expertas que colaboran entre sí.  Por ello buscamos  personas inquietas,  que les  motiven los retos y con ganas de crecer personal y profesionalmente , que se unan a nuestro equipo para tener un  impacto positivo  en el mundo a través de la tecnología.   ¿TE APUNTAS AL RETO?   Como  Responsable de Proyecto Técnico de   SAP  formarás parte de la unidad de  Consultoría SAP  de SEIDOR.  En esta unidad ayudamos a las organizaciones en su transformación hacia una empresa inteligente, conectando procesos, departamentos y funciones mediante soluciones integrales de gestión empresarial. Además, optimizamos los procesos y operaciones internas, y facilitamos la toma de decisiones a través de herramientas avanzadas para la obtención y explotación del dato.   ¿QUÉ HARÁS EN TU DÍA A DÍA?   Serás la persona responsable de liderar y gestionar proyectos relacionados con la implementación, mantenimiento y optimización de soluciones SAP.   Entre sus funciones estarán:     Liderar proyectos SAP de principio a fin, definiendo la estrategia funcional, alcance, planificación y modelo de ejecución.  Actuar como interlocutor principal con clientes y áreas de negocio, entendiendo sus necesidades y transformándolas en soluciones SAP viables y escalables.  Coordinar y supervisar equipos funcionales y técnicos, garantizando la correcta ejecución de cada fase del proyecto.  Diseñar y validar procesos de negocio en áreas logísticas como Compras, Aprovisionamiento, Gestión de Almacenes, Ventas, Distribución o Producción, asegurando la adopción de mejores prácticas SAP.  Liderar talleres de toma de requerimientos, análisis de gaps y definición de soluciones funcionales.  Asegurar la coherencia funcional entre los distintos módulos SAP implicados, identificando dependencias e impactos cruzados.  Supervisar actividades de parametrización, pruebas funcionales, integraciones y puesta en marcha, asegurando la calidad de las entregas.  Gestionar riesgos, desviaciones, cambios de alcance y prioridades, proponiendo planes de acción y mitigación.  Identificar oportunidades de mejora continua y evolución de procesos, proponiendo nuevas funcionalidades o soluciones SAP que aporten valor al negocio.      ¿QUÉ ESPERAMOS DE TI?      Título universitario en Informática, Ingeniería, Ciencias Empresariales, Economía o carrera afín.  Certificaciones en gestión de proyectos como PMP (Project Management Professional, Agile)   Nivel avanzado de inglés, especialmente para proyectos internacionales.  Experiencia de al menos 7 años en funciones similares como jefe de proyecto con especialización en soluciones SAP, preferentemente trabajando con grandes clientes a nivel internacional.  Conocimientos Técnicos y Funcionales:    Conocimiento profundo y comprensión de los módulos y productos SAP, incluyendo S/4HANA y otros módulos específicos como FI, CO, MM, SD, entre otros.  Gest

title: Customer Success Manager, Enterprise (Missouri Valley)
description:
Headquarters:  Remote - USA
 

 About the Role 
 As a Customer Success Manager   at Abnormal AI, you will serve as the primary liaison between customers and internal teams, focusing on successful onboarding, adoption, and ongoing value delivery. You will build and nurture strong customer relationships, align on business goals, and drive measurable outcomes through best practice adoption and strategic planning. You will proactively identify opportunities and risks to help customers maximize their investment and contribute valuable feedback for product improvements. Your role involves collaboration with cross-functional teams and maintaining customer satisfaction and retention. 
 Who you are 
 
 Skilled at building trust and maintaining relationships with stakeholders at various organizational levels, including executives 
 Action-oriented, analytical, and collaborative in approach to customer success and issue resolution 
 Dedicated to delivering measurable customer value and ensuring satisfaction throughout the customer lifecycle 
 Strong verbal and written communication skills, comfortable handling both strategic discussions and technical conversations 
 Solid technical understanding of SaaS products, including internet technologies, networking, and email security solutions 
 Proven track record of driving product adoption and supporting long-term customer growth 
 
 What you will do 
 
 Act as the main point of contact for assigned customers, developing strategic relationships and guiding platform adoption and success planning 
 Deliver regular business reviews (QBRs/EBRs), clearly communicating ROI and aligning on success metrics to support retention and expansion 
 Understand customers’ industries, goals, and challenges to provide tailored recommendations and align internal and external stakeholders on success objectives 
 Promote awareness and usage of key platform features, provide ongoing education, and identify opportunities for expanded adoption 
 Proactively monitor customer health, manage escalations, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, Support, and Sales teams to resolve issues and share actionable insights 
 Maintain expert knowledge of the product roadmap and communicate relevant updates and enhancements to customers 
 Coordinate with internal teams to develop and execute customer success plans, addressing risks before they impact engagement or satisfaction

 5+ years of experience in enterprise SaaS, with at least 3+ years in Customer Success, TAM, or support roles 
 Proven ability to manage large customer portfolios and develop long-term relationships, including at the executive level 
 Excellent communication, presentation, and organizational skills, capable of managing both strategic and technical conversations effectively 
 Strong problem-solving skills and experience resolving escalations while maintaining a positive customer experience 
 Proficiency with CRM and case management tools such as Sales

Das bedeutet: Wir haben keinen fetten VC-Topf, aus dem wir jetzt einfach ein Marketingteam einkaufen. Und genau deshalb suchen wir auch nicht einfach einen klassischen Marketing Manager.

Wir suchen jemanden, der Lust darauf hat, etwas mit aufzubauen.

Produkt, erste große Kunden, Markt, Vertrieb und Proof sind da. Was uns fehlt, ist ein systematischer Marketingmotor. Deine Aufgabe wäre, genau diesen aufzubauen.

LinkedIn. E-Mail. Newsletter. Landingpages. Webinare. Social Media. Content. SEO. Automatisierung.

Aber bitte nicht sechs Kanäle und sechs Excel-Listen.

Wir wollen Marketing AI-first denken. Wie kann ein kleines Team mit Agenten, Automationen und guten Prozessen die Schlagkraft einer deutlich größeren Marketingorganisation entwickeln?

Das ist Dein Spielfeld.

Aufgaben

Was Du bei uns aufbauen kannst

Du entwickelst gemeinsam mit dem Founder unsere komplette Marketingarchitektur. Du entscheidest mit:

• Welche Kanäle funktionieren?

• Welche Zielgruppen reagieren?

• Welche Inhalte erzeugen Nachfrage?

• Was können wir automatisieren?

• Welche Agenten brauchen wir?

• Wo entsteht Pipeline?

• Und was davon sollten wir sofort wieder einstellen?

Wir wollen nicht einfach mehr Content produzieren. Wir wollen ein System entwickeln, das aus Aufmerksamkeit Opportunities und Umsatz macht.

Die ersten 90 Tage

Dein Ziel ist nicht: „Wir haben jetzt einen Content-Kalender.“

Sondern: Wir haben erste reproduzierbare Marketingmechaniken gefunden, die qualifizierte Nachfrage für Accessful erzeugen.

Dabei darfst Du testen. Du darfst Dinge verwerfen. Du darfst neue Tools ausprobieren. Du darfst Agenten bauen. Du darfst bestehende

title: CENTRALE LYON ENISE - Post doctorat - Modélisation et optimisation de la sphéroïdisation de poudres métalliques par plasma RF
description:
Le poste est basé à Centrale Lyon ENISE, sur le campus stéphanois, qui accueille plus de 1250 élèves et 160 personnels, dans un environnement exceptionnel aux portes du Pilat. Centrale Lyon ENISE forme des ingénieurs de spécialité Génie mécanique, Génie civil, Génie sensoriel sous statut étudiant (FISE) ou sous statut apprenti (FISA).

DESCRIPTIF

Contexte scientifique :

Dans le cadre d'un projet ANR consacré au traitement et à la fonctionnalisation de poudres métalliques par plasma radiofréquence, le laboratoire souhaite recruter un post-doc pour développer une approche couplant modélisation physique, expérimentation et optimisation des paramètres de procédé.

Le travail portera principalement sur la sphéroïdisation de poudres d'AlSi10Mg par plasma RF inductif, réalisée sur une torche TekSphero40 (40 kW). Le procédé vise à transformer des particules initialement irrégulières en particules sphériques adaptées notamment aux procédés de fabrication additive métallique.

Le projet s'intéresse à un problème scientifique fortement couplé. L'augmentation de l'énergie apportée aux particules favorise leur fusion et leur sphéroïdisation, mais peut simultanément accentuer l'évaporation du magnésium, la formation de nanoparticules et la coalescence des particules en vol. L'objectif est donc de rechercher un compromis optimal entre plusieurs critères de qualité de la poudre.

Verrous scientifiques :

La fabrication additive métallique par fusion laser sur lit de poudre (L-PBF) nécessite des poudres très sphériques, coulables et chimiquement homogènes. Le procédé de sphéroïdisation par plasma à couplage inductif radiofréquence (RF) est une voie industrielle intéressante pour répondre à ces besoins. Dans ce procédé, la poudre traverse un plasma d'argon à 10 000 K, fond en vol (~ 5 -150 ms) et se resolidifie en gouttelette sphérique sous l'effe

title: Senior Controller (m/w/d)
description:
Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst unser Controlling gemeinsam mit dem Management auf das nächste Level – mit klaren Kennzahlen, intelligenten Reports und einer Steuerung, die frühzeitig die richtigen Impulse setzt.

Dein Profil

Your Role

We ship fast, and we intend to keep shipping fast. The consequence is that our system is outgrowing the amount of deliberate design that went into it. We run AI agents over customer documents in a domain where being wrong is expensive, and a lot of the load-bearing decisions about how those fit together are still implicit.

You will be making those decisions explicit and then making them hold. That means codifying golden paths, building the shared primitives and APIs that product engineers work on top of, owning the architecture of the system as a whole, and establishing what our reliability actually needs to be before an incident establishes it for us.

Platform at Cortea sits between software engineering, DevOps and SRE. Its customers are other engineers. This is not a DevOps role under a different name: you will spend more time in application code than in YAML, and the reason we want infrastructure experience is that we don't believe you can design a system well without being able to run it.

The bar we are hiring against is someone who has taken a system from nothing to production and owned it end to end. You picked the technology, argued the tradeoffs in writing, provisioned the infrastructure, and were responsible for it when it broke.

We use AI heavily and we want you to. What we are not looking for is someone who outsources their judgment to it.

We’re looking for  Key Account   Managers  on the  Key Account Management  team to join our incredible Sales department!  Jobber exists to help people in small businesses be successful. We work with small home service businesses, like your local plumbers, painters, and landscapers, to transform the way service is delivered through technology. With Jobber they can quote, schedule, invoice, and collect payments from their customers, while providing an easy and professional customer experience. Running a small business today isn’t like it used to be—the way we consume and deliver service is changing rapidly, technology is evolving, and customers expect more. That’s why we put the power and flexibility in their hands to run their businesses how, where, and when they want!  Our culture of transparency, inclusivity, collaboration, and innovation has been recognized by Great Place to Work, Canada’s Most Admired Corporate Cultures, and more. Jobber has also been named on the Globe and Mail’s Canada’s Top Growing Companies list, and Deloitte Canada’s Technology Fast 50™, Enterprise Fast 15, and Technology Fast 500™ lists. With an Executive team that has over thirty years of industry experience of leading the way, we’ve come a long way from our first customer in 2011—but we’ve just scratched the surface of what we want to accomplish for our customers.   The Team:   Our Key Account Management team spends their day obsessing over our largest customers, helping them improve how they run their business and delivering on our mission to make the people in small businesses more successful.  This team lives the values of Be Humble, Be Supportive and Give a Shit in everything they do. They celebrate, motivate, and challenge each other daily. They are never satisfied, always looking for ways to improve their skills, build relationships with our customers, and drive success and value for Jobber and its customers. Supporting growth, development, and driving performance is where this role comes in.   The Role:   Reporting into the Manager, Key Account Management, as a Key Account Manager you will own the long-term partnership with Jobber's largest customers. While inbound sales and onboarding create the initial relationship, you take it from there: driving retention, growing payment processing volume (GPV), and expanding the value customers get from Jobber over time.  You'll act as a trusted business advisor, helping clients achieve their goals and maximize their ROI on Jobber and you'll do it with confidence, curiosity, and authenticity. You bring real expertise from working with many similar businesses, while staying genuinely curious about each SP's specific situation and tailoring your approach accordingly. As the Customer Relations Lead at Geely Australia, you will lead and mentor the Customer Relations team ensuring the delivery of premium customer experiences alignment to regulatory requirements, manufacturer standards whilst ensuring performance expectations are met.        Key responsibilities:   • Lead and mentor the Customer Relations team ensuring the delivery of premium customer experiences alignment to regulatory requirements, manufacturer standards whilst ensuring performance expectations are met.   • Lead the Customer Relations Department with the establishment of case management platforms, procedures, campaigns and policies ensuring alignment with the manufacturers strategic direction and standards, ensuring consistent application across the organization including business partners.  • Analysing customer behaviour and its impact on business outcomes to refine strategies and continuously improve customer engagement and retention.  • Respond, action and resolve customer enquiries or complaints in a timely, accurate and premium manner. Identifying at-risk customers and creating strategies to win them back as brand ambassadors.  • Handling and attendance of regulatory cases complying with requirements, manufacturer standards with the support of the Legal Department.  • Develop & implement customer strategic initiatives through collaboration with the internal key stakeholders and business partners to achieve a positive brand experience ensuring customer satisfaction and engagement.  • Develop targeted strategies and processes to drive customer communication opportunities linking outbound interactions to sales offers, seasonal campaigns, dealer marketing events to drive business growth opportunities.  • Ensure customer data accuracy and management through quality measures in accordance with laws, regulations, policies, procedures and guidelines.  • Cultivate a customer centric and focused team culture whilst seeking improvement opportunities through ongoing monitoring & analysis of key performance indicators (KPIs). Provide feedback and improvement recommendations to key stakeholders to grow customer and dealer reputational excellence.  • Provide detailed analysis and reporting of all customer experience related opportunities, costs, programs and business measures to ensure financial, product or operational risks are mitigated.  • Undertake duties or contribute to projects that are related to the Company's business operations, including but not limited to providing leadership or support as reasonably required and consistent with the responsibilities of the role. title: Customer Support & Operations Lead (m/w/d), Mobility Startup Berlin
description: Wir bei  GETAWAY  gestalten die Zukunft der Mobilität und Flottensteuerung. Unser Ziel ist es, den Betrieb unserer Flotte reibungslos zu gestalten und unseren Kunden den besten Service zu bieten. Um unsere operativen Prozesse weiter zu stärken, moderne KI-Technologien einzubinden und sowohl Endkunden als auch Flottenprozesse exzellent zu betreuen, suchen wir ab sofort einen talentierten und motivierten  Customer Support & Operations Lead (m/w/d) .  Aufgaben     Endkunden- & Technical Support:  Du betreust unsere End- und Flottenkunden direkt bei Anfragen, löst komplexe technische Problemstellungen und bearbeitest Incidents strukturiert über unser Ticketing-System.    Flotten-Operations & Backoffice:  Du steuerst und betreust operative Backoffice-Tätigkeiten im Flottenmanagement – dazu gehört unter anderem die eigenverantwortliche Abwicklung der Schadensbearbeitung und Flottenprozesse.    Einsatz & Einbindung von KI:  Du nutzt moderne KI-Tools zur Automatisierung von Support- und Operation-Abläufen und hilfst aktiv mit, neue KI-gestützte Workflows in unsere täglichen Prozesse einzubinden.    Prozessoptimierung:  Du analysierst bestehende Betriebsabläufe, identifizierst Schwachstellen und entwickelst effiziente Lösungen zur Skalierung unserer Operations.    Schnittstellenfunktion:  Du arbeitest eng mit Produkt-, Entwicklungs- und Flottenteams zusammen, um Feedback aus dem Tagesgeschäft direkt in die Optimierung unserer Produkte und Prozesse einzubringen.    Qualifikation     Erfahrung in der Teamleitung:  Mehrjährige praxiserprobte Erfahrung in der Teamleitung oder als Lead (z. B. als Teamlead, Senior Specialist oder Shift Lead) im Bereich Customer Support, IT-Service oder Operations ist bei uns Pflicht.    Steuerung & Organisation:  Fundierte Erfahrung in der Schichtplanung, der Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen sowie in der Betreuung und Überwachung externer Dienstleister (z. B. Callcenter).    Sprachkenntnisse:   Ausgezeichnete Deutschkenntnisse  in Wort und Schrift sind zwingend erforderlich. Gute Englischkenntnisse sind ein Plus.      Nice-to-have:       Technisches & Digitales Verständnis:  Affinität zu digitalen Tools sowie großes Interesse an der Einbindung und Nutzung von KI-Lösungen zur Prozessoptimierung.    Flotten- & Backoffice-Know-how:  Erfahrung oder starkes Interesse an operativen Flottenprozessen (z. B. Schadensabwicklung, Fuhrpark-Backoffice).    Benefits     Flexibilität:  Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Möglichkeiten für [Homeoffice / Hybrid Work].    Zukunftsorientiertes Arbeiten:  Ein innovatives Umfeld, in dem der Einsatz moderner KI-Tools gefördert und gelebt wird.    Verantwortung:  Abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben an der Schnittstelle zwischen Endkunden, Technik und Flotten-Operations.    Kultur & Entwicklung:  Flache Hierarchien, kurze Entscheidungswege, ein dynamisches Team sowie persönliche Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten.     Wir freuen uns auf deinen Kontakt! title: Client Relationship Manager - Community Trusts
description: We are currently seeking a Client Relationship Manager to join our growing Community Trusts team. Based in Perth, this full-time role works closely with First Nations communities, Aboriginal organisations, and local advisory groups across WA.      Reporting to the Lead, Community Trusts, you will represent Equity Trustees as Trustee across a portfolio of Native Title and community trusts. You will build trusted relationships with clients and stakeholders while supporting the ongoing governance, administration and operational needs of each trust.      A key aspect of the role involves presenting and discussing trust financial information, including budgets, expenditure, investment performance and trustee decisions, with advisory groups and community representatives. Success in the role requires strong financial acumen, excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex information in a clear and accessible way.      This is a unique opportunity for someone who enjoys relationship management, stakeholder engagement and working with diverse communities. We are open to candidates from a range of backgrounds including financial services, banking, wealth management, advisory, trust administration, governance or community-focused roles. Your ability to build trusted relationships and communicate confidently will be critical to your success.       What you'll do:       Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with clients, communities and stakeholders.  Represent Equity Trustees at meetings, AGMs and advisory group meetings, delivering presentations on trust activities and financial matters.  Present and explain trust financial information, including budgets, expenditure and allocations, in a clear and practical manner.  Support trust decision-making processes, governance activities and committee operations.  Coordinate trust administration, compliance obligations and stakeholder engagement activities.  Work closely with internal teams and external providers to deliver positive outcomes for trust beneficiaries and communities.  Identify opportunities to improve processes, communication and service delivery.        What you'll need to succeed:       Strong financial acumen with the ability to interpret and discuss financial information confidently.  Experience communicating financial, business or governance information to a range of stakeholders.  A confident communication and presentation style, with the ability to adapt your approach to different audiences.  Strong stakeholder and relationship management experience in complex environments.  The ability to navigate sensitive and confidential discussions with empathy, professionalism and cultural awareness.  Excellent organisational skills and attention to detail.  A continuous improvement mindset and practical approach to problem solving.  Perth-based and willing to travel locally for client meetings and community engagement activities. title: Client Manager (Loan Administration)
description: Company Description   We’re a leading Investor Services group offering end-to-end services in administration, accounting, reporting, regulatory and compliance needs of the investment sector worldwide. We employ a global workforce of 6,500+ people across 24 jurisdictions and have assets under administration (AUA) exceeding US$857 billion. We work with 13 of the world’s top-15 private equity firms.  Our services are underpinned by a Group-wide commitment to ESG and best-in-class technology including a global data platform and innovative proprietary tools supported by in-house experts.  Above all, what makes us different is our people. Operating as trusted partners to our clients, we deliver intelligent solutions through a combination of technical expertise and strong relationships based on deep client understanding.   We’re driven by our Group purpose, to power people and possibilities.   Job Description   As a Client Manager, you will play a key role in delivering exceptional loan administration services to a portfolio of debt and credit clients. You will lead client onboarding, oversee day-to-day loan administration activities, manage a high-performing team, and ensure the delivery of accurate, timely, and high-quality client services. Working closely with senior leadership and key stakeholders, you will help drive operational excellence, strengthen client relationships, and support the continued growth of the Loan Administration business.   What You Will Do     You will manage a portfolio of loan administration clients, overseeing onboarding, operational delivery, and ensuring exceptional client service throughout the client lifecycle. You will support business growth by contributing to new business opportunities, client demonstrations, process design, and the continuous enhancement of loan administration services. This role is being recruited at a pivotal stage in the evolution of the Digital Learning function. The introduction of a new Learning Experience Platform (LXP) in 2027 will provide the foundation for this growth, supporting the expansion of Digital Learning services from approximately 50,000 Civil Service learners to a wider Public Service audience of more than 110,000 learners by 2030. title: Lead Customer Success Manager

This role also serves as a methodology leader, coaching resource, and execution standard-setter for the broader CSM team. The Lead CSM is accountable, not only for their own portfolio outcomes, but for the quality of AI adoption, change-management practice, and domain expertise that CSMs in their orbit deliver. This role shapes what excellence looks like. Lead renewals across different products and platforms for both direct customers as well as customer renewals that vary across any of our Solution Partners in each region we support  Increase customer awareness of Atlassian’s product portfolio to identify cross-sell and up-sell opportunities during the renewals cycle  Maintain a deep understanding of product updates and new offerings and articulate those improvements to customers and our solution partners  Maintain a consistently healthy pipeline by logging sales and renewal activities, customer data, and customers’ status within internal systems      About You     Three or more years of proven experience in account management, software renewals, customer success, or other relevant business areas  Ability to establish rapport, form relationships, and build trust on the phone and on video across a wide variety of countries and cultures  Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding performance goals  German language proficiency is required      Compensation   At Atlassian, we strive to design equitable, explainable, and competitive compensatio
