title: Workday Functional HCM Manager, Functional Transformation
description: Workday Functional HCM Manager     Position Summary   Our Human Capital practice helps organizations address the changing nature of work, workforce, and workplace. We bring sector experience and cross-domain insight to help clients solve complex workforce challenges and align talent strategies to business priorities. Join our team and help organizations transform work in ways that make work better for humans and humans better at work.  Recruiting for this role ends on 06/11/2027.   Work you'll do   As a Workday Functional Manager on the HR Strategy & Technology team, you will be responsible for:    Lead a multi-functional implementation team in planning and executing discovery, design, configuration, and deployment activities, ensuring superior quality delivery for client projects  Manage project timeline, communications and, risk identification and mitigation  Act as point person for all functional consultants, providing direction and guidance to team and coordinating with integrations and data consultants as needed  Use your experience and knowledge of Workday implementations to support sales activities  Build relationships internally and externally to strengthen your and the firm's reputation as a leading Workday implementation partner    A successful candidate would possess these skills:    Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team  Effective written and verbal communication skills  Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product  Ability to build and sustain professional relationships  Ability to lead projects or workstreams  Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment  Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor  Ability to meet deadlines  Ability to provide clear guidance to others     The team   Our HR Strategy & Technology Offering is dedicated to developing leading global HR strategies and implementing cutting-edge HR technologies. We drive transformation and maximize the workforce experience, ensuring sustained HR effectiveness and value. In a world of disruption, our solutions empower organizations to navigate challenges seamlessly, enhancing their HR capabilities and fostering a resilient workforce.   Qualifications   Required:    6+ years of experience implementing Workday HCM Cloud with at least 4 full life cycle implementations  Bachelor's Degree or equivalent years of relevant experience required  6+ years' hands on experience in multiple Full Life Cycle implementations of the Workday HCM product, from planning through design, build, testing and go-live  6+ years' experience leading a project team, including managing workstream leads to drive their work towards project deadlines and deliverables that are on target and beyond client expectations  4+ years' managing project financials, including monitoring and managing project risks/issues and taking appropriate action to ensure an exceptional project completion for the client  Ability

title: Head of Marketing
description:
Headquarters:  Remote
      URL:   http://onthegosystems.com 
 

 At  OnTheGoSystems  (creators of  WPML  and  PTC ), content is a key driver of how hundreds of thousands of people discover, understand, and choose our translation and localization products. 
 AI is already a core part of how we work. We use it to move faster, automate work, research, analyze, build, and improve our products and processes. 
 We’re looking for  a hands-on marketer  who works the same way. We’re looking for someone who uses AI agents, automation, integrations, and structured workflows to get real marketing work done – and can show us the results. 
 You won’t be joining to follow a fixed marketing playbook. You’ll have the opportunity to bring your ideas and help shape how marketing works at OTGS, reaching hundreds of thousands of users worldwide.

 Find marketing and growth opportunities and turn them into concrete actions. 
 
 
 Work hands-on across content, SEO/GEO, email, product marketing, acquisition, conversion, and other areas where you can make an impact. 
 
 
 Use AI agents and automation as a core part of your everyday work. 
 
 
 Build and improve workflows that help us achieve more with AI. 
 
 
 Use data and business results to understand what works, what doesn’t, and what we should improve. 
 
 
 Work directly with product, development, and support teams to understand our products, customers, and opportunities. 
 
 
 Take ownership from identifying an opportunity through execution, measurement, and improvement. 
 
 
 What We’re Looking For 
 
 
 You already use AI agents, automation, or advanced AI workflows in your everyday work, own the quality of what they produce, and can show us the results. 
 
 
 You adapt quickly when priorities change and can work effectively even when not everything is clearly defined from the beginning. 
 
 
 You combine strategic thinking with strong hands-on execution. You can identify what needs to be done and turn ideas into action. 
 
 
 You understand how marketing connects to business results and can share specific examples of your impact. 
 
 
 You enjoy working across different areas of marketing, wearing different hats, and learning new things as needed. 
 
 
 You have experience marketing technical products. A background in software, SaaS, WordPress, or a similar industry would be especially relevant. 
 
 
 You work independently, make decisions, and move things forward without needing detailed instructions. 
 
 
 Why Join Us 
 
 
 We’re a profitable, self-funded product company growing since 2007. 
 
 
 WPML powers more than 1.5 million websites worldwide, giving you a large audience to work with. 
 
 
 Your work will directly influence how people discover our products, understand their value, and choose to use them. 
 
 
 You’ll have real ownership and the freedom to shape our marketing approach, not simply execute an existing plan.

title: Enterprise Customer Success Manager, Asia

We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.   About The Role    Position Overview:  The Manager, Customer Success role is responsible   Location: Philippines / Indonesia / Malaysia    About This Role   Own the success, retention, and growth of Wiley’s Enterprise customers across Asia. This role will help customers achieve value from their investment, strengthen usage and satisfaction, support renewals, and identify expansion opportunities across the region.   How You Will Make An Impact     Manage a portfolio of Enterprise customers across Asia and serve as a trusted post-sale partner.  Lead onboarding, adoption planning, customer reviews, and success plans to ensure customers achieve strong outcomes.  Track usage, engagement, satisfaction, risks, and renewal readiness across assigned accounts.  Partner with Sales to support renewals, expansions, upsell opportunities, and long-term account growth.  Build strong relationships with customer stakeholders, including administrators, librarians, faculty leaders, and institutional decision-makers.  Proactively identify and resolve adoption barriers, service issues, and account risks. title: Customer Success Manager
description: Why now   Companies are building their sales and marketing workflows on incomplete information. We've spent a decade building and classifying 30 million pages of Nordic business data. But having clean information is just the start. Making it work in their processes and matter to their business is the real challenge. That's where you come in.  We're looking for a business-savvy, forward-looking Customer Success Manager who learns fast. Start as soon as possible. Q4 is peak season: companies are reviewing the year, making budget calls, planning ahead. You'll jump into real conversations from day one. That's where the actual learning happens.   The role   You work with roughly 120 mid-market customers. This isn't account management. It's about being a thought partner who helps them actually get value from Vainu.  They bought Vainu because they have a specific problem they want to solve. Your job is helping them out to do that.  That means    Understand what they actually need. What did they buy Vainu for? What's the pain they're trying to fix in their revenue process?  Help them think it through. Work with them to identify which parts of their workflow are worth automating and where Vainu's data creates real value. Often this means helping them see opportunities in their own internal processes.  Steer and inspire. You're not just checking in on your customers, but actively helping them imagine what's possible when they combine Vainu's data with their expertise. Showing them how other customers are using Vainu in interesting ways.  Hold them accountable (and yourself too). Getting value from Vainu usually requires work from both sides. Sometimes it's changes they need to make, and sometimes it's work we need to do. You help drive forward that partnership.    Here's the reality: you don't have 120 equal relationships. You need to be smart about where you spend time. Look at the real value each customer is getting from our data. Focus your energy on conversations that make a difference. You need business sense and the ability to have honest conversations about what it actually takes to succeed.   What We Need From You     Experience: 1–2 years of Customer Success in a high-churn, high-growth SaaS environment where you had to fight for retention and prove value. Or equivalent: someone from a broader TAM SaaS business who's learned to be scrappy and resourceful with a large customer base. You have a track record of hitting retention targets and growing accounts in competitive conditions.  Tech mindset: You build things to save yourself time: agents, automations, whatever works. You constantly ask: Am I actually adding value here, or could a machine do this? You understand CRMs (HubSpot, Salesforce, Dynamics, Pipedrive) and how RevOps works. You're genuinely curious about how data flows through a customer's workflow, and you're not afraid to tell them "here's what I'd try". PERCHÉ CERCHIAMO QUESTA FIGURA  Stiamo preparando l'offerta per una gara pubblica in Alto Adige che mette a  contratto la nostra piattaforma per tre anni presso un ente del settore turistico.  Il capitolato chiede espressamente un Customer Success Manager dedicato per tutta  la durata del contratto, con esperienza nel settore turistico o nell'area DACH, che  segua la formazione degli utenti e le revisioni periodiche sull'uso della  piattaforma. Gli utenti finali sono in larga parte di lingua tedesca, quindi il  tedesco è per noi un requisito reale e non una formalità.     COSA FARAI  - Accompagnerai il cliente nell'avvio della piattaforma, dalla configurazione ai   primi risultati.  - Terrai le sessioni di formazione agli utenti, in tedesco o in italiano, comprese   alcune giornate in presenza a Bolzano.  - Sarai il punto di riferimento del cliente per tutta la durata del contratto da remoto.  - Preparerai e condurrai le revisioni trimestrali: come viene usata la piattaforma,   quali risultati sta producendo, cosa migliorare.  - Proporrai casi d'uso concreti per aumentare conversioni e coinvolgimento degli   utenti sui siti del cliente, lavorando insieme al nostro team tecnico.     REQUISITI  - Tedesco fluente, scritto e parlato. Italiano buono. L'inglese è utile ma non necessario.  - Esperienza nel settore turistico oppure con clienti dell'area DACH.  - Dimestichezza con l'analisi del comportamento degli utenti sui siti web: web   analytics, tassi di conversione, imbuti, test A/B. Non serve saper programmare.  - Capacità di stare davanti a un cliente e di spiegare i dati a persone che non   sono tecniche.  - Disponibilità a trasferte in Alto Adige, poche giornate all'anno.     TIPO DI COLLABORAZIONE  Il ruolo nasce legato a questa gara, quindi siamo trasparenti sui tempi. Ti  proponiamo due strade, a tua scelta:     1) Collaborazione con partita IVA.     Se la gara viene aggiudicata, l'incarico parte per i tre anni di contratto    con un impegno part-time concordato e un compenso a giornata o a canone mensile.     2) Assunzione a tempo determinato. Se preferisci il rapporto di lavoro dipendente,    attiviamo il contratto all'aggiudicazione, con durata allineata alla commessa e    possibilità di trasformazione a tempo indeterminato se il rapporto funziona e    nel frattempo cresce il resto del portafoglio.     In entrambi i casi il lavoro è prevalentemente da remoto.     COME CANDIDARSI

title: Teamleder kundeservice
description: Vil du lede med engasjement, retning og kundefokus? title: Customer Service Team Manager
description: ABOUT QUINCE   Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.  What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.   OUR CULTURE   Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.    We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.  Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.   Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.     If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you. title: Guest Experience Manager
description: Company Description   Pullman Kuching is centrally located in the Kuching Golden Triangle, enjoying pride of place on Jalan Mathies hill, with panoramic city and river views. The first Pullman hotel in this vibrant city, Pullman Kuching features 389 spacious, contemporary rooms and offers easy access to renowned Borneo national parks. The hotel is ideal for business guests, offering an abundance of conferencing space, state of the art facilities and technology, plus a range of trendy restaurants and bars, and a high-end spa.   Job Description   Job Summary  The Guest Experience Manager is responsible for ensuring guests receive a warm, personalised and memorable experience throughout their stay. The role focuses on guest engagement, service recovery, feedback management and maintaining high guest satisfaction standards.  Key Responsibilities    Oversee and enhance the overall guest experience throughout the hotel.  Welcome and engage with guests, especially VIPs, repeat guests and special occasions.  Proactively identify guest needs and ensure appropriate follow-up during their stay.  Handle guest feedback, complaints and service recovery professionally and promptly.  Monitor guest satisfaction scores and online guest reviews, including TrustYou feedback.  Coordinate with Front Office, Housekeeping, F&B and other departments to resolve guest concerns.  Ensure guest preferences and special requests are properly communicated and followed up.  Conduct regular guest interaction and gather feedback to identify areas for improvement.  Maintain accurate records of guest feedback, complaints and recovery actions.  Support the Front Office team in delivering consistent service standards.  Coach and guide team members on guest engagement and service recovery.  Assist in creating guest engagement initiatives and personalised experiences.  Ensure compliance with hotel and Accor guest experience standards, policies and procedures.  Prepare and share guest experience reports and highlight recurring issues to management.  Perform other duties as assigned by the Rooms Division / Management.     Qualifications     Diploma or Degree in Hospitality Management or a related field.  Minimum 3 years of experience in Front Office, Guest Relations or Guest Experience in a hotel environment.  Strong guest service and communication skills.  Confident in handling guest complaints and service recovery.  Good understanding of hotel operations and guest journey.  Strong interpersonal and problem-solving skills.  Positive, friendly and approachable personality.  Able to work independently and coordinate effectively with different departments.  Good command of English; additional languages are an advantage.  Willing to work shifts, weekends and public holidays.

title: Process & Journey Manager
description: Great customer journeys are built behind the scenes   At If, we're working to make insurance simpler, smarter and more connected across channels. To make that happen, we need to bring together customer journeys, business processes and digital capabilities in a more structured and scalable way.  We're now looking for a  Process and Journey Manager  to help drive that work. You'll help connect lifecycle management, journey orchestration and process development into a seamless end-to-end experience. From identifying improvement opportunities and designing solutions to implementation, optimization and governance, you'll play a central role throughout the process. Liderar reuniones de seguimiento y presentar resultados, conclusiones y propuestas de evolución. Participar en la planificación y valoración económica de nuevas necesidades, iniciativas y evolutivos.   Impulsar la incorporación de soluciones digitales y tecnológicas aplicadas al Contact Center.   Trabajar con herramientas de analítica, Business Intelligence y cuadros de mando para facilitar la toma de decisiones.   Coordinar proyectos orientados a mejorar la experiencia de cliente, calidad y productividad.   Asegurar el correcto cumplimiento de los procedimientos y estándares establecidos para la prestación del servicio.   Identificar nuevas oportunidades que permitan aportar mayor valor al cliente y evolucionar la operación.     ¿Qué ofrecemos?      Jornada de trabajo de 9:00 a 18:00 horas de Lunes a Jueves y los Viernes de 9 a 17 h   Convenio Contact Center y Categoría Responsable de Servicio   Salario en función de valía del candidato   Proyecto estable dentro de una compañía consolidada y en crecimiento. title: Service Manager
description: ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra.     Vi växer och behöver nu stärka upp teamet i Stockholm med en Service Manager!   Till vår verksamhet för mellanstora kunder i Stockholm söker vi på ISS en serviceinriktad och engagerad Service Manager som vill utveckla människor och kundernas verksamhet. Vi erbjuder dig en utmanande roll i ett bolag och bransch under ständig utveckling!      Om rollen     Vi söker dig som ska arbeta mot en stor statlig säkerhetsklassad kund.     Du kommer att ha ett helhetsansvar för ca 10 adresser med varierande tjänster såsom driftledare, vaktmästare, post & gods, receptionister & lokalvård.    Som SMR har du ekonomiskt ansvar och personalansvar för ditt driftområde.     I rollen som SMR ansvarar du vidare för de lokala kundrelationerna och att arbetet bedrivs i enlighet med gällande kundavtal. I samarbete med kund strävar du efter ständiga förbättringar och utveckling av ISS leverans. Här har du stora möjligheter att lyfta leveransen från att vara bra till att bli en av ISS bästa siter!     För oss på ISS är ledarskap viktigt. Genom ditt goda ledarskap förväntas du skapa förutsättningar för dina medarbetare att kunna utvecklas och prestera. Som Service Manager har du direktansvar för 50 medarbetare, varav 2 driftledare. Du leder verksamheten mot uppsatta mål i nära samarbete med kunden, medarbetare och närmaste chef.    Du ansvarar för att verksamheten är optimalt dimensionerad och bemannad. Dessutom är du inte rädd för att själv kliva in i den dagliga driften för att stötta dina medarbetare när så behövs. Att arbetet bedrivs i överensstämmelse med lagar och övriga avtal samt ISS policys och värderingar är en självklarhet för dig.     Du har din bas ute på siterna, och sitter med i regionsledningsgruppen tillsammans med 7 andra Service Manager.     Tjänsten är på heltid och tillsvidareanställning med start så snart som möjligt, samt med en inledande provanställning i sex månader.     Vi erbjuder      Du kommer att arbeta nära kompetenta medarbetare som du får stort utbyte av, då vi värnar om att hjälpa och utveckla varandra. ISS storlek och breda tjänsteutbud bidrar till att det finns goda utvecklingsmöjligheter såväl nationellt som globalt. Vårt fokus ligger i att ta hand om och utveckla våra medarbetare, för vi tror på att ”People make places”. ISS erbjuder bland annat utbildningar och utvecklingsmöjligheter – allt för att du ska engageras och växa med ISS på lång sikt.    Vi värderar mån

title: Service Manager
description: Do you want to lead a skilled accounting team, build trusted customer relationships, and help shape Staria’s growth in Norway? Are you energized by a role that brings together people leadership, customer satisfaction, and service quality?    We are looking for a proactive, growth-minded Service Manager to lead our Norwegian accounting team and take ownership of key customer relationships. This is your opportunity to make a visible impact – shaping how we lead our team, serve our customers, and grow our operations in Norway. As the key link between your team, our customers and Staria’s delivery teams, you will build trusted partnerships and shape scalable services that help both our accounting team and customers succeed. You will also work closely with Sales to help accelerate Staria’s growth in Norway. While there is no individual sales target, you will act as a trusted subject-matter expert, uncovering customer needs, identifying opportunities to expand partnerships, and ensuring our solutions create value for both customers and Staria.  In practice, you will:    Lead and develop your team, fostering performance, collaboration, wellbeing, and professional growth.  As the team expands, you will be responsible for recruiting and onboarding new team members.  Have direct customer contact and build strong customer relationships through regular, proactive communication and clear expectation management.  Oversee service delivery, deadlines, risks, and commitments, translating customer needs and feedback into clear actions for the delivery team.  Guide escalations to smooth resolutions while using customer insights, team feedback, and recurring patterns to drive measurable improvements in delivery, continuity, and ways of working.  Oversee customer profitability, contracts, pricing, scope, and invoicing together with the Service Director.  Work together with sales and contribute with your expertise to find additional service opportunities, proposals, renewals, contract changes. Nscale are developing cutting-edge sovereign generative AI solutions, powered by a new generation of high-performance, sustainable data centres and GPUs built specifically for AI workloads. description: We, at Leggett Dynamics, are searching for a  Supply Chain Manager (m/f/d)  within our branch leadership team to help support our Automotive business in  Berndorf . Monitor and review ongoing due diligence (ODD) processes for existing customers, ensuring records and risk ratings remain current.  Keep the team updated on changes to sanction lists and regulatory requirements, adjusting screening procedures as needed. Up-to-date knowledge of global sanctions regimes and regulatory updates.

description: Transfer your healthcare knowledge into a career in project management and operational commissioning . Inovo has a reputation for a professional, collaborative approach, drawing on our invaluable knowledge and extensive experience across the wider team. Strong planning, coordination and organisational skills, with the ability to manage risks, issues, dependencies and competing priorities.  Confidence working across clinical, operational, technical and project teams and engaging with senior stakeholders.  A practical, adaptable and solutions-focused approach

title: Client Relationship Manager
description: Your job      Be the person your clients trust to make Get-e work for them. You'll take on a portfolio of clients and become their dedicated point of contact: the person who knows their business, anticipates what they need, and makes sure every interaction with Get-e feels handled, not handed off.  This isn't ticket resolution. It's relationship ownership. You're accountable for how your clients feel about Get-e, not just how fast their tickets close.      What you'll do      Getting clients off to a strong start   Be your client's guide from day one, the person who makes their first weeks with Get-e feel effortless, not administrative  Understand each client's business well enough to set them up in a way that actually fits how they operate, not just how our systems are configured  Catch and fix friction before the client feels it      Knowing your clients better than anyone else at Get-e   Be the one person your clients can call who already knows their history, their preferences, and what matters to them. No re-explaining, no hand-offs  Run regular check-ins that are worth the client's time, not status updates, but a genuine read on how things are going and what could be better  Spot when a client is quietly struggling before they have to complain about it      Making things right when they go wrong   Take full ownership of complaints and disputes for your clients: investigate properly, resolve them, and communicate in a way that leaves the client feeling looked after, not processed  Be proactive about bad news. Clients should hear it from you before they have to ask  Handle escalations yourself wherever you can. The goal is your clients never have to go around you to get something fixed      Helping clients get more out of Get-e   Look for chances to make the relationship more valuable, not just less painful: new routes, better service fit, smoother processes for their team  Bring the client's voice back into Get-e. If something about our product or process is making their life harder, that's information the business needs      Outcomes   Clients say you know their business and treat you as a trusted partner, not a support line  New clients feel confident and set up for success within their first weeks, not confused or chasing you for basics  Clients experience fewer surprises and faster, more human resolutions when something does go wrong  Retention and satisfaction improve within your portfolio because clients feel owned, not queued  Clients see you proactively bringing them value, not just responding when asked      Your profile   5+ years in client services, customer success, account management, or client-facing operations (travel, mobility, or service industry a plus)  You build real relationships. title: Butiksleder / Team Manager til Vintage Smykke-Showroom

description: Er du den strukturerede og tillidsskabende leder, der kan sikre en fantastisk kundeoplevelse og en stærk holdkultur i et af Danmarks mest spændende luksus-showrooms? Vi søger en Team Manager, der kan tage det daglige ansvar for drift, kundeservice og medarbejderudvikling — og som brænder for at skabe et sted, folk glæder sig til at komme hen til hver dag.    Om Another's Legacy   Another's Legacy er et dansk luksusbrand inden for vintage guld-, sølv- og diamantsmykker, hvor kvalitet, storytelling og personlig kundeoplevelse står centralt. Showroomet på H.C. Andersens Boulevard danner samtidig ramme om salget af Archive38's tasker og Lumavie's diamanrt smykker, så du bliver en del af et flerbrandet, kommercielt showroom i udvikling.  Another's Legacy er en del af virksomheden Nofipa, der driver en portefølje af hurtigt voksende brands inden for smykker, luksus og investering. Udover Another's Legacy står Nofipa bl.a. bag NordiskGuld, Archive38, Lumavie og ChronoCollective. I hele virksomheden er vi i dag over 100 medarbejdere fordelt på 16 afdelinger rundt om i Danmark, og har på bare ét år vokset os fra 50 til 100+ medarbejdere — drevet af et stærkt fokus på eksekvering, læring og fælles ambitioner. Vores gennemsnitsalder er ung, og kulturen er præget af energi, åbenhed og samarbejde på tværs af brands og fagområder.    Dine ansvarsområder    Være den daglige leder for 5 fuldtidsansatte og +10 deltidsansatte — synlig og til stede, med tæt sparring og løbende feedback til den enkelte medarbejder.  Sikre en stærk og positiv teamkultur, hvor kerneværdierne leves, medarbejderne hjælper hinanden på tværs, og alle trives med at gå på arbejde.  Levere 5-stjernet kundeservice ved showings, der skaber gennemførte køb, naturligt mersalg og kunder, der kommer igen.  Sikre hurtig og professionel besvarelse på mail/chat og telefon.  Have styr på den daglige drift: et showroom der altid står skarpt, ordrer der pakkes og afsendes hurtigt, og reklamationer der håndteres inden for få dage.  Sikre en strømlinet proces fra modtagelse af smykke til at de er lagt op på webshop (data indtastning, foto, smeltevurdering etc.) og fuldt overblik over lageret.  Udvikle medarbejderne, så de kan tage ejerskab for deres egne ansvarsområder.     Hvem er du?    Har erfaring med daglig ledelse af et team og trives med tæt, løbende sparring med dine medarbejdere.  Er struktureret — du har styr på flere parallelle opgaver ad gangen, uden at noget falder mellem to stole.  Er pligtopfyldende og en stabil, forudsigelig tilstedeværelse, dine kolleger kan regne med.  Skaber tillid gennem ærlig, direkte og retfærdig ledelse, og gør det trygt for medarbejdere at sige deres mening.  Har et kommercielt mindset og ser naturligt mersalgsmuligheder i kundemødet — uden at det føles pushy.  Trives i et miljø med fokus på kvalitet, service og en god kultur.     Hvad tilbyder vi? title: Software Engineer, Platform - Berlin, Germany
description:
The mission of Speechify is to make sure that reading is never a barrier to learning.

Over 50 million people use Speechify's text-to-speech products to turn whatever they're reading – PDFs, books, Google Docs, news articles, websites – into audio, so they can read faster, read more, and remember more. Speechify's text-to-speech reading products include its iOS app, Android App, Mac App, Chrome Extension, and Web App. Google recently named Speechify the Chrome Extension of the Year and Apple named Speechify its 2025 Design Award winner for Inclusivity.  

Today, nearly 200 people around the globe work on Speechify in a 100% distributed setting – Speechify has no office. These include frontend and backend engineers, AI research scientists, and others from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google, leading PhD programs like Stanford, high growth startups like Stripe, Vercel, Bolt, and many founders of their own companies.

Overview

The responsibilities of our Platform team include building and maintaining all backend services, including, but not limited to, payments, analytics, subscriptions, new products, text to speech, and external APIs.

This is a key role and ideal for someone who thinks strategically, enjoys fast-paced environments, is passionate about making product decisions, and has experience building great user experiences that delight users.

We are a flat organization that allows anyone to become a leader by showing excellent technical skills and delivering results consistently and fast. Work ethic, solid communication skills, and obsession with winning are paramount. 

Our interview process involves several technical interviews and we aim to complete them within 1 week. 

What You'll Do

title: (Senior) Collection Merchandiser Shoes (f/m/d)
description:
What you will do:

As the (Senior) Collection Merchandiser for the Shoes category, you will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategic direction of the footwear assortment. 

This role requires a deep understanding of luxury fashion, strong collaboration skills, and the ability to drive innovation while maintaining the brand's identity. You will work closely with the design, product development, sales, marketing, and operations teams to create a cohesive and successful shoe collection that meets the needs of both direct-to-consumer (D2C) and business-to-business (B2B) channels.

Assortment Strategy:

  • Develop and implement a long-term assortment strategy for the Shoes category, aligning with the brands product vision and catering to the unique requirements of D2C and B2B channels.
  • Analyze market trends, competitor activity, and consumer insights to inform strategic decision-making.
Collection Creation:
  • Lead the seasonal collection creation process for Shoes, working in close partnership with the design and product development teams.
  • Ensure the collection reflects the brand's DNA, resonates with target customers, and meets commercial objectives.
  • Own the range and the line plan and ensure they are constantly updated.
Critical Path Management:
  • Own the critical path for the Shoes category, ensuring all key milestones and deadlines are met.
  • Schedule and coordinate all relevant meetings, ensuring appropriate stakeholders are involved and prepared.
Cross-Functional Collaboration:
  • Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to develop compelling campaigns and product stories that enhance the visibility and desirability of the Shoes category.
  • Work with sales teams to gather feedback from wholesale partners and clients, ensuring their needs are reflected in the assortment.

description:

Arsenaalissa pääset vauhdikkaaseen kaupalliseen rooliin, jossa yhdistyvät myynti, asiakkuudet ja ihmiset. Tässä työssä et jää odottamaan, että puhelin soi. Arsenaali on luotettava, vakavarainen ja moderni henkilöstöpalveluyritys. Työllistämme päivittäin 250–300 rakennus-, kuljetus- ja ravintola-alan ammattilaista Uudenmaan alueella. Vuonna 2025 liikevaihtomme oli 10,9 miljoonaa euroa.      Nyt etsimme joukkoomme tavoitteellista ja energistä asiakkuuspäällikköä, joka haluaa tehdä tulosta – ja menestyä yhdessä muun joukkueen kanssa. Samalla pidät silmät auki uusille kaupallisille mahdollisuuksille.     Yksi tärkeimmistä tehtävistäsi on huolehtia henkilöstöpoolimme mahdollisimman korkeasta käyttöasteesta. Kun työntekijän toimeksianto päättyy, tavoitteena on löytää hänelle nopeasti seuraava työ. Kun asiakkaalle syntyy äkillinen tarve, meidän tehtävämme on ratkaista se. Työssä tulee vastaan päiviä, jolloin monta asiaa tapahtuu yhtä aikaa. Asiakkaan tarve muuttuu, työntekijä vapautuu ennakoitua aikaisemmin tai sovittu henkilö ei pääsekään töihin. Tähän etsimme ihmistä, joka ei jää ihmettelemään ongelmaa vaan miettii:  miten tämä ratkaistaan?       Tunnistatko itsesi?   Emme etsi ensisijaisesti tietyn toimialan osaajaa tai tietyn tutkinnon suorittanutta. Etsimme ennen kaikkea oikeanlaista draivia.     Saatat olla etsimämme henkilö, jos:    haluat voittaa ja saavuttaa tavoitteesi   saat energiaa kaupoista ja onnistumisista  raha ja mahdollisuus vaikuttaa omaan ansaintaasi motivoivat sinua  tartut puhelimeen mieluummin kuin jäät odottamaan  pystyt tekemään päätöksiä nopeasti myös paineen alla  osaat hahmottaa, missä on hyvä kauppa ja mihin ei kannata käyttää aikaansa  olet järjestelmällinen ja tarkka, vaikka ympärillä olisi kiire  uskallat olla jämäkkä asiakkaiden ja työntekijöiden kanssa  epäonnistuminen tai muuttunut tilanne ei pysäytä sinua – siirryt nopeasti seuraavaan ratkaisuun  olet energinen, ahkera ja nautit korkeasta tekemisen temposta. description: Vil du være med til at forme oplevelsen for millioner af passagerer hvert år? Med ’Passenger First, Always’ som ledestjerne arbejder vi for at skabe en rejseoplevelse i verdensklasse. Du anvender også din forståelse for sammenhængen af det fysiske og digitale rum. description: La direction Industrielle et du Grand-Est assure l’exploitation et la surveillance des centres de stockage et la mise en œuvre de toutes les composantes permettant la prise en charge industrielle des déchets radioactifs bénéficiant d’une solution de gestion.  Au sein de la direction, le service Relations et solutions clients assure notamment l’interface entre l’Andra et ses clients producteurs électronucléaires de déchets radioactifs.     En tant que Référent clients, vous serez la porte d'entrée et l'interlocuteur généraliste d’un des clients principaux. Vous aurez à cœur de développer avec ce client une relation de confiance et de répondre au mieux à ses besoins, tout en veillant au respect des enjeux propres à l’Agence (sûreté, contraintes d’exploitation des centres, équilibre financier des contrats, …). Votre positionnement sera celui d’un facilitateur/coordonnateur, doté d’une culture technique pour appréhender des sujets parfois complexes avec le client et les experts internes. Votre valeur ajoutée sera de permettre aux équipes de l’Andra d’apporter efficacement des solutions aux besoins du client.     Vos principales missions consisteront notamment à :   Assurer l’interface avec le client et organiser les échanges réguliers avec lui (réunions bilatérales, comités, échanges au fil de l’eau, …),  Comprendre ses besoins, les analyser, les faire remonter et proposer des solutions permettant d’y répondre en considérant le contexte et les enjeux propres à chaque cas,  Conseiller le client, tant sur les aspects techniques de la prise en charge de ses déchets radioactifs que sur les processus de l’Andra et les aspects contractuels,  Suivre le traitement de ses demandes et pour certaines coordonner les actions entre les différents services,  Recueillir et analyser les retours du client, proposer des actions d’amélioration,  Elaborer des propositions techniques et commerciales pour des prestations spécifiques puis en suivre la réalisation,  Assurer l’animation de la relation clients : visites des centres, organisation d’événements, enquête de satisfaction, …  Eventuellement, contribuer aux formations dispensées par l’Andra auprès des producteurs de déchets.      De formation Bac+5, ingénieur ou universitaire, vous disposez d’une expérience d’a minima deux ans dans le milieu nucléaire. Vous êtes déjà dans le métier de la relation clients ou vous avez déjà pu démontrer votre capacité à coordonner une activité ou un projet.  Une culture de la sûreté et une connaissance de la réglementation applicable au domaine nucléaire sont nécessaires.  Des expériences dans la gestion des déchets radioactifs ou dans la gestion de contrats seront des plus.   Pour réussir pleinement à ce poste, vous devez faire preuve d’une aptitude au pilotage transversal, d’un sens du service auprès des clients ainsi que de bonnes capacités relationnelles et de diplomatie. Votre appétence pour les sujets techniques et les enjeux de terrain ainsi que vos capacités d’argumentation

Company & Role Overview 

About Hilo by Aktiia 

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health. 

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. In July, we launched in the US. 

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation.

As Post-Market Surveillance Manager, you'll build and run our global post-market surveillance system — from complaint handling and adverse-event reporting to data trending and governance — and lead its rollout across Customer Support, QA, Regulatory, Engineering, Clinical, and Product. title: Communications Lead

Orbital Industries is an AI Industrial company, with frontier AI embedded at every step in the production of critical physical products - from creating advanced materials to engineering and manufacturing.

Was wir lösen

Die Energiewende ist relevanter denn je: Solaranlagen, Wärmepumpen und Wallboxen werden in Deutschland so schnell gebaut wie noch nie. Aber es gibt eine Bremse, die kaum jemand kennt - Bürokratie.

Was heißt das konkret? Jede einzelne Anlage muss beim Netzbetreiber angemeldet werden, bevor sie laufen darf.
Klingt einfach? Ist es nicht: In Deutschland gibt es über 850 Netzbetreiber - jeder mit eigenen Formularen, eigenen Prozessen, eigener Auslegung der Regeln. Kein Standard.
Für Installationsbetriebe heißt das drei bis vier Stunden pro Anlage, in denen ein Handwerker Formulare ausfüllt statt zu bauen.

Wir lösen das mit Software. Unsere Plattform erzeugt die Unterlagen aus den Daten des Installateurs und reicht sie automatisiert beim richtigen Netzbetreiber ein.
Unter unseren Kunden sind die größten Player der Solar- und Wärmepumpenbranche in Europa.
Und weil dieses Problem den Installationsbetrieben so weh tut, konnten wir im letzten Jahr von null auf über 1 Mio. € Umsatz gewachsen - bootstrapped, profitabel und ohne Investorengeld.

Deine Rolle

Du arbeitest im operativen Kern unseres Produkts und trägst Ownership für einen ganzen Bereich.
Dort sorgst du dafür, dass alles sauber durchläuft: Du behandelst die Edge Cases, kommunizierst mit allen relevanten Stakehold

title: Backend Engineer (Golang) - Transfers EU
description:
At SumUp, we empower small businesses with simple, affordable tools to start, run, and grow. Our Global Bank teams build the financial services that help merchants manage their money and keep their businesses moving.

For merchants, a transfer should feel simple. Behind that experience is a complex network of payment schemes, banks, providers, messages, certificates, reconciliations, and edge cases—all of which need to work together reliably.

Transfers Europe squad is the integration layer connecting SumUp's internal systems with the financial networks that move money across Europe and the UK. We build and run the backend services behind SEPA and UK transfer flows, helping move money accurately and reliably across external networks.

As a Backend Engineer, you'll take ownership of services that process real money. You'll work on complex systems problems to ensure seamless integrations as we scale, while seeing a direct connection between your engineering decisions and merchant trust.

If you enjoy understanding how systems behave under real-world conditions while improving them over time, we'd love to hear from you.

Our tech stack includes Golang, AWS, Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis and Kubernetes, supported by a strong observability toolchain with Prometheus, Grafana, and Honeycomb. We also actively use AI‑assisted development tools such as Cursor, GitHub Copilot, and others.

What you'll do 

  • Build and maintain production money movement backend services, contributing to their delivery, observability, and ongoing maintenance.
  • Own and deliver well‑defined tasks and features, and contribute to larger projects within the team's domain.
  • Contribute to technical design and implementation, following established architectural patterns and best practices.
